Sr. Software Engineer (Remote Eligible from Bulgaria)

For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smartsheet is a tech company with a human story to tell. We’re here to empower teams to manage projects, automate workflows, and rapidly build new secure solutions, using simple no-code tools. We’re revolutionaries – so for us changing the way the world works is all in a day’s work.

As a global leader in Intelligent Work Management with a market cap of $10bn, we’ve continued to scale our engineering presence internationally. Since expanding into Bulgaria in October 2024, we’ve grown to a team of 75+ engineers. As we continue building this operation, we’re looking for a talented and motivated Senior Software Engineer who are passionate about continuous learning and excited to grow in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

Smartsheet runs on a modern SaaS stack hosted on AWS, with infrastructure defined and managed as code using Terraform and strong engineering best practices. Our core platform includes a legacy Java monolith alongside a growing ecosystem of microservices, primarily built in Java and Go (with a small number of Kotlin services). On the front end, product teams that deliver UI experiences use React.

You will work remotely from Bulgaria and will be reporting to an engineering leader.

You Will:

  • Work on all aspects of software development, including back-end, front-end, cloud infrastructure, and test automation.
  • Drive high standards for internal services and open-source tools, ensuring reliability and scalability.
  • Deploy services and infrastructure changes frequently in an agile environment using full CI/CD pipelines.
  • Contribute to product development across ideation, customer engagement, planning, design, execution, and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, UX designers, and UX researchers.
  • Mentor junior engineers, balancing customer delivery with high coding and infrastructure standards.
  • Apply innovative problem-solving approaches and validate both your ideas and those of your teammates.
  • Define success for your team and the features you help build and ship.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

You Have:

  • Proficiency in Java or Golang
  • Experience designing, building and operating highly available, fault-tolerant, low-latency distributed systems serving millions of users
  • Familiarity with algorithms, data structures, and coding best practices.
  • Curiosity and a desire to understand how things work, with the ability to get to the root of complex problems.
  • Strong communication skills, able to convey technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A supportive mindset, willing to mentor and help colleagues get unstuck.
  • Passion for quality, taking pride in building reliable, high-performance software.
  • Empathy for users, able to translate customer feedback into effective solutions.
  • A growth mindset, viewing bugs, mistakes, and challenges as learning opportunities.
  • Legally eligible to work in Bulgaria on an ongoing basis.
  • Fluency in English is required.

Smartsheet is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment where all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristics as specified in applicable law. We believe a diverse team enhances our company and are dedicated to promoting equality and inclusion within our workforce. If you need any adjustments to the application process due to a disability, please contact us, and we will work to accommodate your needs.

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees.   • Lead requirements analysis, solution design discussions, and technical feasibility assessments, ensuring product requirements are clearly defined, measurable, and implementable.

  • Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle, from requirements gathering and prioritization to development, testing, release, and post-launch optimization.

  • Knowledge of product analytics, user behavior analysis, and data-driven product optimization.

jobs.title: Embedded Engineer
jobs.description:
Embedded Engineer

Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Embedded Engineer, you will own the firmware that runs on that hardware, from the first register write to the moment data leaves the device, so that what reaches our ML team is clean, synchronized, and trustworthy.

What You Will Do

  • Write and own the firmware for our data-capture hardware: sensors, motion-capture rigs, custom IoT setups, and prototype robots.

  • Build real-time data acquisition: drivers, DMA, buffering, and streaming from many sensors at once without dropping a sample.

  • Solve multi-sensor synchronization, calibration, and time-stamping so every data point lines up across devices and modalities.

  • Bring up new boards with our Electrical Engineer and turn fresh hardware into working devices fast.

  • Build the path from device to dataset: communication protocols, on-device logging, and handoff into our data pipeline.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with ML engineers. Your firmware decides what their training data looks like, and a timing bug can quietly ruin months of data.

  • Make firmware reliable in the field: testing, OTA updates, error handling, and diagnostics that tell us what went wrong.

Requirements

  • Up to 5 years writing production firmware for embedded or IoT systems.

  • Strong C/C++, experience with an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar), and deep familiarity with microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, NXP, or similar).

  • Hands-on experience with peripheral interfaces and protocols: SPI, I2C, UART, USB, BLE, CAN, or similar.

  • Experience integrating sensors in firmware: IMUs, cameras, depth sensors, force sensors, or similar.

  • A strong understanding of how firmware decisions affect data quality, especially for EMG/EEG sensing: ADC configuration, sample rate, jitter, filtering, and buffering. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you write code accordingly.

  • Comfortable debugging at the hardware boundary with a logic analyzer, oscilloscope, and debugger.

  • Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.

  • High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. You are comfortable in 0-to-1 ambiguity, where the spec is "figure out what the spec should be".

  • Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.

  • Fluent in English. German is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • A background in robotics, motion capture, or wearable devices.

  • Experience with real-time or hard-deadline systems: audio, video sync, or robotic control loops.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, time-sync protocols (PTP or similar), or low-power design.

  • Familiarity with ML training pipelines. Even if you don't run them, you can read a training script.

  • Open-source firmware contributions.

  • Experience taking firmware from prototype to small-batch production: test fixtures, provisioning, and certification support.

Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

Embedded Control Engineer

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.


BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

In this role, you will play a key part in developing the embedded control platform and will translate functional and control requirements into embedded hardware and software architectures, select appropriate microcontrollers, DSP, FPGA, or other controller technologies, and develop real-time software close to the hardware implementation. Your work will directly influence the performance, reliability, safety, and will require close collaboration with power electronics, integrated electronics, mechanical, thermal, and system engineers.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Define embedded controller architectures for power electronic converters and select suitable microcontrollers, DSP, FPGA.

  • Translate power electronics and control requirements into efficient, deterministic, and robust real-time software implementations.

  • Develop, test, debug, and validate embedded software on target hardware, from individual software blocks through complete controller implementations and automated testing environments to validate the design.

  • Explore new controller technologies, embedded architectures, and software implementation concepts to improve converter performance, flexibility, reliability, functionality, and maintainability.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You hold a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • You have a strong understanding of embedded architectures, and the practical considerations involved in selecting controllers for demanding real-time applications.

  • You are an expert in embedded software development for real-time applications, preferably in power electronics, industrial automation, or similar applications, spanning FPGA programming, systems programming, hardware interfaces and communication protocols.

  • You are experienced in monitoring and debugging software directly on target hardware

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with model-based development, hardware-in-the-loop testing, automated testing, or safety-critical software development is a plus.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in.

We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision.

Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves.

That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey—and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more.

Maze is a Series B company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values.

Location: Remote, preference for Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Spain or Portugal.

Key engineering and product teams are based in these locales.

About the Role

Maze customers need to reach the right participants and trust the quality of the people taking part in their studies. Recruitment is a critical part of research.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the recruitment and panel experience at Maze. You’ll help shape how customers recruit and manage participants across unmoderated, moderated, AI-moderated and future research experiences.

This is a highly cross-functional product area that sits at the intersection of product, operations and our panel partner ecosystem. You’ll work in a trio with Engineering and Design while partnering closely with our Panel Operations team, GTM, Customer Success, Research Partners and other product teams.

You’ll own the customer and participant experiences as well as the systems behind them, helping Maze deliver a recruitment experience that is high-quality, reliable and able to scale with increasingly complex customer needs.

You’ll work on:

  • Own and evolve the roadmap for recruitment and participant management across Maze.

  • Improve participant quality by building stronger feedback loops, quality signals, filtering and experiences that reduce confusion for participants.

  • Make it easier for customers to recruit the audiences they need across different study types, including more complex enterprise use cases.

  • Use data and customer insights to understand panel performance and identify gaps in participant supply, quality and fulfillment.

  • Partner with Panel Operations to continuously improve the tools, workflows and handoffs used to fulfill recruitment requests.

  • Help evaluate and onboard new panel partners and identify where deeper integrations can improve quality, coverage or efficiency.

  • Develop smarter ways to route studies to the right participant supply based on customer and study needs.

  • Stay close to the operational side of recruitment so product decisions are grounded in how participant fulfillment actually happens.

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success and Research Partners to understand customer needs, recruitment feasibility and opportunities to improve the recruitment experience.

  • Define and measure success across participant quality, fulfillment and the overall recruitment experience.

  • You have experience as a Product Manager or Senior Product Manager owning meaningful product areas from discovery through execution.

  • You’re highly autonomous and comfortable taking a problem, creating structure around it and driving it forward without waiting for perfect direction.

  • You’re a clear, structured communicator who can bring others along in how you think about a problem, recommendation or decision.

  • You’re comfortable working on products that span software, operations and external partners rather than living entirely within a single product surface.

  • You’re comfortable getting close to operational workflows and using what you learn to make better product decisions.

  • You have strong product judgment and can make thoughtful tradeoffs when there isn’t a perfect answer.

  • You’re experienced partnering closely with Engineering and Design to take products from discovery through delivery and iteration.

  • You think in systems and look for scalable product solutions rather than one-off workarounds.

  • You’re comfortable balancing customer experience, business needs, operational realities and technical constraints.

  • You thrive in an environment where you can move quickly, make decisions with imperfect information and continuously learn from customers and internal teams.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Strong data fluency and experience using data to understand problems, prioritize opportunities and measure product outcomes.

  • Experience building products with a meaningful operational component.

  • Marketplace or supply-and-demand product experience.

  • Experience in operations, business development or other roles that required you to work across product and business problems.

  • Experience managing stakeholders across multiple teams or functions.

  • Experience working with external partners, vendors or integrations that are critical to the customer experience.

  • Experience with user research or research participant recruitment.

Inclusivity and Pay

At Maze, we are dedicated to building an equitable, inclusive, and authentic workspace. Unique and diverse perspectives are welcomed, and continuous growth is encouraged. We believe that people are more than their resumes, so if your past experience looks different than the criteria listed, we'd still love to hear from you. We appreciate and celebrate non-traditional life routes and encourage you to apply should you connect with a job description or the Maze culture. 

Maze values transparency and it enables us to approach compensation equitably across the world. We are informed by data and regularly check our salary ranges (either United States or Rest of World) against other venture backed companies. Additionally, we are proud of our holistic and generous benefits offerings, included in every compensation package.

Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations.

Why Maze is unique

  • Market disruption: We believe that the way companies build products is fundamentally broken and the user research market is ripe for disruption. For too long, companies have been forced to choose between rapid development without user insights or investing months into research before bringing products to market. But there's finally a groundswell building around a path forward that eliminates this compromise - and Maze is leading the charge.

Product Analytics Chapter Lead
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

About the Role

Product decisions at Finom are made fast, and we want them made on evidence. You join the Growth & Activation product stream as its analyst, working with PMs and engineers on how new customers discover the product, start using it, and grow with it.

There is no established way of doing product analytics here yet, so you define it: how experiments are designed, how metrics are named and counted, what a readout looks like. You come with your own approach rather than waiting for one to be handed to you.

What you'll do

Work with the product managers and other stakeholders in the stream. Agree priorities with them, and look for the problems worth solving instead of waiting for a request to arrive.

Bring recommendations to the business, including opportunities it does not see on its own.

Define the metrics for the stream: what activation means, what we expect from the funnel, how each number is counted, and how it stays consistent with the way the rest of the company counts the same things.

Design the tests. Hypothesis, primary metric, audience split, duration, and how the result gets read once it lands.

Automate that work, so running a test is routine and not a small project every time.

Build the infrastructure for testing at scale, with external tools or our own, so a testing culture can spread across the product teams.

 

 



What you bring

  • Product analytics done end to end, with decisions that changed the roadmap behind it.

  • Fluent in SQL, confident in Python, and solid on experimentation and causal methods/

  • You have chosen or built tooling for tests and metrics before.

  • You use AI tools in your daily work, not occasionally.

  • A partner to stakeholders rather than a person who executes tickets.

  • Proactive, you bring the problems and the hypotheses yourself.

  • You take an ambiguous problem, structure it, and explain your reasoning to product and business people.

  • English at C1 or above

    • Nice to have

    • Product analytics built from scratch

    • Experience where conversion volumes are low: B2B, long sales cycles, small samples.



What You Will Get In Return
 
Make a genuine impact on the product
 
Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
 
Work in the EU
 
Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
 
Become a stock options holder
 
Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
 
Receive unwavering support and care
 
Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
 
Work & Swim program
 
Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
 
Equal Opportunity Statement 
 
At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Deployment Lead - ERP Solutions
jobs.description:
Deployment Lead - ERP Solutions

What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

Who We Need

We are building industry-defining accounting and finance software. We are looking for an experienced Deployment Lead to guide complex customer implementations and help finance teams successfully transition onto Rillet.

This role is ideal for someone who has led ERP implementations and understands how to turn complex accounting and operational requirements into practical systems solutions. You may come from an ERP implementation firm, Big 4 finance transformation practice, systems consulting team, or a SaaS company serving finance organizations. You are comfortable owning multiple workstreams, advising senior stakeholders, and navigating the details of configuration, data migration, integrations, testing, and go-live.

You will combine strong implementation judgment with a customer-first mindset—bringing structure to ambiguity, identifying risks early, and keeping customers and internal teams moving toward a successful launch.

We’re primarily looking for teammates who are based near our New York City or San Francisco offices, or open to relocating. For this role, we’re also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States. Our hybrid schedule brings office-based team members together in person on Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day each week. Some roles may spend more time in the office depending on the needs of the team.

What You'll Do

  • Lead key parts of customer onboarding and deployment, helping ensure a smooth and timely implementation experience

  • Partner with internal teams across Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to execute implementation plans and solve customer problems quickly

  • Learn and analyze client accounting and finance workflows, then translate those needs into clear requirements and practical solutions

  • Guide customers through onboarding, training, change management, and adoption

  • Support data migration, reconciliations, systems setup, and integration coordination

  • Track milestones, drive follow-through, and keep internal and external stakeholders aligned throughout the onboarding process

  • Identify risks early, escalate issues quickly, and help keep customer launches on track

  • Build trust with customers by being responsive, thoughtful, and solutions-oriented

  • Maintain clear documentation and provide regular status updates to customers and internal stakeholders

Who We're Looking For

  • 4–7 years in ERP implementation, systems consulting, or finance transformation (e.g., Big 4 or implementation firms)

  • Background in SaaS, high-growth technology companies, or implementation/consulting environments is strongly preferred

  • Hands-on ERP experience (NetSuite, SAP, Workday, etc.), including requirements, configuration, data migration, and go-live

  • Strong understanding of core accounting workflows (close, reconciliations, ASC 606) and how they translate into systems

  • Customer-facing with strong communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Systems-minded with solid project management skills; able to run multiple workstreams

  • Comfortable in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and highly detail-oriented

  • Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams

The expected base salary range for this role varies by location:

Tier A: $100,000 – $150,000
Tier B: $100,000 – $140,000
Tier C: $100,000 – $130,000

Your compensation tier is based on your primary work location. You can view Rillet’s compensation zones here.

Final compensation within the applicable range will depend on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.

 

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.

Life at Rillet

  • Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

  • Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

  • Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

jobs.description:
Senior Detection Analyst

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Detection Analyst to join our team. This is a remote role (in Costa Rica), reporting to the Manager, Detection Analyst in the Detection Operations Team. You will utilize our detection platform to analyze telemetry, alerts, and log sources across several detection domains including Endpoint, Identity, Network, and Cloud to publish threats for our Managed Detection and Response customers. Additionally, by leading projects to improve the Detection Operations workflow through orchestration and automation, you will ensure our customers receive high-fidelity threat analysis and concisely written communication regarding emerging threats at scale.

What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)

  • Analyze EDR telemetry, alerts, and log sources across several detection domains including Endpoint, Identity, Network, and Cloud/SaaS
  • Publish and review threats for customers using concisely written communication to effectively convey key indicators and remediation context
  • Improve and innovate Detection Operations workflows through orchestration and automation to manage high volumes of telemetry

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You act like an owner with a passion for our mission, operating with integrity and navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator who embraces a challenge culture through clear, respectful feedback to build trust and elevate the team.
  • You are customer-obsessed, anchoring decisions in solving real-world problems and championing customer needs from start to finish.
  • You are data-driven, using analytics to measure what matters, replace assumptions with evidence, and guide informed decisions.
  • You think at scale, connecting daily work to the global mission while building resilient solutions designed to last in a high-growth organization.

Seit 40 Jahren entwickeln wir digitale Lösungen für Rechtsabteilungen – von Mittelstand bis hin zu internationalen Konzernen wie Lufthansa oder Haribo - mit uns können sie mit KI mehr aus ihrem juristischer Datenschatz 🚀 holen und vor allem den Überblick über all die wichtigen Anliegen, die sie verantworten, behalten!

🏆 Dabei sind wir deutscher Marktführer. Unser Erfolgsrezept? Kontinuität, Kompetenz und vertrauensvolle, partnerschaftliche und langfristige Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden.

Aufgaben

  • Netzwerk- und Infrastrukturverwaltung: Du betreust unsere interne Netzwerk- und Serverinfrastruktur und stellst deren zuverlässigen Betrieb sicher.

  • Serveradministration: Du wartest und aktualisierst unsere Linux- und Windows-Systeme und behältst Betriebssystemversionen, Supportzeiträume und notwendige Migrationen im Blick.

  • Wartungs- und Lifecycle-Planung: Du planst notwendige Aktualisierungen und Erneuerungen frühzeitig und koordinierst deren Umsetzung.

  • IT-Sicherheit: Du überwachst den Sicherheitszustand unserer internen IT, identifizierst Handlungsbedarf und koordinierst bzw. realisierst geeignete Schutzmaßnahmen.

  • Schwachstellenmanagement: Du organisierst regelmäßige Sicherheits- und Schwachstellenscans, bewertest die Ergebnisse und koordinierst notwendige Maßnahmen.

  • Backup, Monitoring und Verfügbarkeit: Du pflegst Backup- und Wartungskonzepte, behältst das technische Monitoring im Blick und stellst sicher, dass Auffälligkeiten und notwendige Maßnahmen nachverfolgt werden.

  • Cloud- und Hosting-Infrastruktur: Du administrierst unsere Systeme bei externen Hosting- und Cloud-Anbietern (z. B. IONOS, Yellowhost und Portrix). Dazu gehören neben der eigentlichen Systemadministration auch Zugänge und Berechtigungen, Domains/DNS, Zertifikate, Backups und Monitoring sowie die laufende Bewertung der dort betriebenen Systeme.

  • Cloud-Weiterentwicklung und Migration: Du prüfst, wo standardisierte Cloud-Umgebungen und Cloud-Dienste bestehende Systeme sinnvoll ablösen oder vereinfachen können, bewertest diese Möglichkeiten technisch und wirtschaftlich und bereitest Migrationen vor bzw. begleitest sie.

  • Benutzer- und Berechtigungsverwaltung: Du administrierst Benutzerkonten, Gruppen, Rollen und Berechtigungen für unsere internen Systeme und unterstützt die weitere Zentralisierung der Benutzerverwaltung über SSO.

  • Lizenz- und Systemverwaltung: Du verwaltest Softwarelizenzen, technische Accounts, Zertifikate, Domains und weitere für den IT-Betrieb relevante Ressourcen.

  • Inventar und Dokumentation: Du hältst unsere Dokumentation zu Servern, Netzwerkkomponenten, Betriebssystemen, Lizenzen, Ports und sonstiger IT-Infrastruktur aktuell.

  • ISO 27001 und Informationssicherheit: Du wirkst an der Erstellung, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung der für unsere interne IT relevanten ISO-27001-Dokumentation mit und sorgst dafür, dass technische und organisatorische Maßnahmen nachvollziehbar dokumentiert werden.

  • Audits und Qualitätsmanagement: Du bereitest technische Informationen für interne und externe Prüfungen auf, unterstützt bei Audits und verfolgst daraus resultierende Maßnahmen.

  • IT-Budget und Beschaffung: Du planst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung den Bedarf und das Budget für interne IT, holst Angebote ein und koordinierst die Beschaffung bzw. Verlängerung von Hardware, Software, Lizenzen und Wartungsverträgen.

  • Vorausschauende Weiterentwicklung: Du beobachtest den Zustand unserer IT-Landschaft und schlägst eigenständig Verbesserungen hinsichtlich Sicherheit, Wartbarkeit, Standardisierung und Wirtschaftlichkeit vor.

Qualifikation

Muss-Kriterien:

  • Ausgezeichnete Deutsch- und fließende Englischkenntnisse

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im IT-Bereich oder vergleichbare praktische Berufserfahrung

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Administration von Windows- und Linux-Systemen

  • Gute Kenntnisse grundlegender Netzwerktechnologien und -dienste, beispielsweise TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Routing und Firewalls

  • Erfahrung mit Benutzer-, Rechte- und Berechtigungsverwaltung

  • Erfahrung in der Administration von Systemen bei externen Hosting- oder Cloud-Anbietern

  • Grundlegendes Verständnis aktueller Anforderungen an IT-Sicherheit und sicheren Systembetrieb

  • Fähigkeit, technische Systeme strukturiert zu dokumentieren und Wartungsbedarf frühzeitig zu erkennen

  • Selbstständige, sorgfältige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

  • Bereitschaft, Verantwortung für den zuverlässigen Betrieb und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der internen IT zu übernehmen

Wünschenswert:

  • Erfahrung mit Microsoft 365, Active Directory bzw. Entra ID und Single Sign-on

  • Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung, Docker und vergleichbaren Infrastrukturtechnologien

  • Kenntnisse in AWS, Microsoft Azure oder vergleichbaren Cloud-Plattformen

  • Erfahrung mit der technischen und wirtschaftlichen Bewertung von Cloud-Lösungen sowie mit Cloud-Migrationen

  • Erfahrung mit Schwachstellenscannern und Security-Werkzeugen

  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Backup, Monitoring und Disaster Recovery

  • Erfahrung mit Zertifikats-, Domain- und DNS-Verwaltung

  • Kenntnisse der ISO 27001 oder praktische Erfahrung mit Informationssicherheitsmanagementsystemen (ISMS)

Was uns bei dieser Rolle wichtig ist

Du sollst die interne IT als eigenen Verantwortungsbereich verstehen, technische und organisatorische Risiken erkennen und notwendige Maßnahmen aktiv vorantreiben.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Entwicklung, Geschäftsführung und weiteren internen Ansprechpartnern zusammen. Bei grundlegenden Entscheidungen oder größeren Investitionen erfolgt die Abstimmung gemeinsam; den laufenden Betrieb, die Dokumentation und die Vorbereitung notwendiger Maßnahmen organisierst du eigenständig.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Traffic Event Detections
jobs.description:
Engineering Manager, Traffic Event Detections

Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What We Do

We build the mission-critical engine that powers real-time navigation for global customers like BMW, Porsche, DoorDash, and Instacart. We process petabytes of geospatial data through a sophisticated blend of high-scale backend services, data pipelines, and AI Agentic workflows to detect, validate, and deliver live road updates - from traffic jams to road closures. The intelligent AI agents we build enhance our core algorithms, ensuring Mapbox maps are as dynamic as the roads themselves and that millions of drivers reach their destinations in the most optimal way possible.

 

Engineers on this team develop and deliver of every stage of the event detection lifecycle:

  1. Intelligent Ingestion and Detection: Building automated agents to gather data and discover closures using proprietary Mapbox signals.

  2. Validation and Conflation: Leveraging algorithms to invalidate stale data and merge duplicate reports into a single, high-fidelity source of truth.

  3. Strategic Delivery: Designing the systems that expose this data across the entire Mapbox ecosystem.

  4. AI Collaboration: Partnering with the MapGPT team to evolve our Feedback Agent, allowing us to refine the map using real-time customer insights.

 

As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow.

What You'll Do

As an Engineering Manager supporting our Traffic Events Detection organization, you will lead innovative and high-performing multi-disciplinary teams who are building the Events Detection product using a blend of high-scale backend services, data pipelines, and AI Agentic workflows to detect, validate, and deliver live road updates.

You will be responsible for driving your team’s day-to-day work, fostering the growth and development of the people on the team, and aligning the team’s work with the company's priorities. Thousands of customers rely on Mapbox services to seamlessly handle billions of requests every day and scale in real-time to global events. You will drive solutions that remain robust, reliable, and innovative in a fast-evolving technological landscape.

  • Deliver complex, high-impact projects while providing technical expertise and mentorship to your team.

  • Operate your team’s day-to-day and be hands-on in project management and sprint planning.

  • Manage operational best practices for on-call and related responsibilities.

  • Empathize with internal and external customers delivering features that address their needs.

  • Manage and develop the team through hiring, retaining, mentoring, and continually building the team’s capabilities.

  • Drive company, product, and team objectives, carrying your team and relevant stakeholders along in the decision-making.

  • Work with Product and Engineering teams to develop the long-term business strategy driving the team’s work.

  • Establish, track, and iterate on operational metrics to ensure the team is delivering products that meet or exceed customer expectations.

  • Determine best engineering practices and promote them within the team and across Mapbox.

  • Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, diversity, and data-driven decisions on the team.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • Required Education/Certification: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical hands-on engineering experience.

  • Technical Skills & Tools (Must-Haves):

    • 5+ years of people management experience: You have managed remote engineering team(s) leading to product execution and business outcome while growing and developing a team of engineering talent.

    • Hire & Develop: You understand the importance of hiring the best diverse talent and creating a culture where your team members can learn & grow with the organization.

    • Technical Expertise: You have deep knowledge and experience of building scalable web services and data pipelines in AWS.

    • Operational Excellence: You drive a culture of quality and continuous improvement within your team and personally embody a passion for monitoring, metrics, triage, resolving customer issues, and iterative improvement. You help foster the end to end development of clearly designed interfaces, documentation, thorough test coverage, and effective code reviews.

    • Ownership & Execution: You own the vision, lead the strategy, and guide the team to execute towards building the future of your product.

    • Customer Focus: You care deeply about your customers and their problems, and you work tirelessly to innovate on their behalf.

    • Strong written and verbal communication: You can talk and write about complex ideas concisely to a wide audience.

  • Core Competencies & Scope:

    • Experience leading cross-functional teams of 5+ people

Employment Requirements

  • Employment Type: Full-time

  • Weekly Hours: Full-time

  • Location/Hybrid Policy: Remote

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

How We Support You

jobs.title: Sr. Growth Marketing Manager (a)
jobs.description:
Sr. Growth Marketing Manager (a)

Why Oviva?

At Oviva, we’re on a mission to make sustainable, personalized, clinically effective care accessible to everyone as we build Europe’s leading AI-powered chronic care platform. Our digital programmes help people manage weight-related illnesses by focusing on what matters most: improving health, building confidence, and enhancing quality of life.

To date, we have supported over one million people across the UK, Switzerland, and Germany. Our mission is powered by a dedicated team operating across four countries, including our hub in Poland. Every conversation, coaching session, and line of code brings us closer to a healthier future.

Our journey is accelerating: In 2026, we secured €200 million in Series D funding led by Kinnevik and a group of leading global investors. This investment fuels our next phase of growth, allowing us to scale our AI-enabled chronic care platform across Europe and expand our support to even more people living with chronic conditions.

Join us, and be part of the team making that future possible!

The role

The Senior Growth Marketing Manager (a) designs, tests, and expands rapid marketing growth initiatives across Europe to accelerate patient acquisition for our digital health applications (such as our obesity and hypertension programs in Germany). Acting as an entrepreneurial growth hacker, this individual identifies novel acquisition channels, maximizes existing platform performance, and elevates land-to-lead conversion rates (in close collaboration with our dedicated product & engineering squad). This position directly advances our mission of making personalised, clinical care accessible to everyone by building a robust, repeatable pipeline of new patient leads.

In this role, you will enjoy a high degree of autonomy, balancing strategic planning with a hands-on approach to executing initiatives. You will act as a subject matter expert within the Marketing team, fostering a culture of high performance and evidence-based decision-making.

You will find and involve the right experts and agencies for new channels and initiatives to ensure we learn best practices as a key part of our expansion strategy.

Requirements:

Essential

  • Growth Hacking & Rapid Experimentation Mastery: A proven track record of managing data-driven marketing initiatives and scaling paid digital acquisition channels from inception to maturity. This includes executing rapid experimentation frameworks across new channels,and driving conversion rate optimization where it makes sense.

  • Commercial Acumen & Financial Modeling: Strong capability to build data-driven financial business cases that translate long-term commercial goals into clear, actionable roadmaps. Demonstrated experience balancing aggressive customer acquisition scale with strict Cost Per Lead targets to continuously improve core business metrics based on analytical insights.

  • Advanced Analytics & Growth Architecture: Exhibit a deeply analytical mindset with the technical expertise to design growth automation workflows, manage complex data visualisation tools, and leverage AI tools to maximise cross-functional efficiency

  • Agile Problem-Solving & Resourcefulness: Exceptional agility to navigate highly ambiguous, fast-moving environments and drive immediate execution ("today rather than next week"). Proven ability to identify and collaborate with external expert networks or specialized agencies to integrate state-of-the-art testing practices, combined with the resourcefulness to independently source freelance talent or AI tools when internal team capacity is stretched.

  • Minimum Viable Product Testing & Lifecycle Handover: Ability to launch nimble, unpolished baseline experiments to validate initial growth hypotheses without demanding perfect workflows upfront. Possesses the strategic capability to transition successful pilots into structured future-state processes, followed by sourcing, onboarding, and training internal talent to fully own the mature channel long-term.

Desirable

  • Experience navigating performance marketing regulations within the healthcare or German digital health application sector.

  • An established professional network of digital marketing experts, freelancers, and agile agencies.

Education & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in economics, statistics, (business) informatics, or a related field

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in performance marketing or growth hacking, preferably in a B2C startup environment

  • Language Qualifications: German C1+ and fluency in English

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and Validate Growth Opportunities: Discover and map new acquisition channels (e.g., partnerships, influencer marketing, programmatic), aggressively expand existing channels, and execute conversion rate optimization strategies through deep personalization of landing pages and lead surveys (where needed). This role stays up to date on new trends in existing channels & potential new channels by monitoring ad platform changes, competitors and the overall market.

  • Construct Robust Business Cases: Build high-level commercial business cases for every new testing initiative, establishing clear parameters for target scale and acceptable Cost Per Lead boundaries that successfully transition channels from experimentation to maturity.

  • Own and Establish State-of-the-Art Testing Protocols: Architect world-class testing methodologies and integrate automated tools or AI applications, establishing institutional best practices that elevate the performance marketing capabilities

  • Execute Minimum Viable Product Experiments: Launch fast, agile experiments to validate core hypotheses without demanding flawless internal processes initially, moving rapidly to define the long-term operational vision once lead volume and scalability are proven.

  • Drive Fast-Paced Execution: Maintain an exceptional bias for action to push initiatives forward today rather than tomorrow, breaking through resource bottlenecks by independently sourcing freelance talent or leveraging AI tools when internal capacity is stretched.

  • Lead Channel Lifecycle & Strategic Handover: Drive the end-to-end strategy for scaling promising initiatives from ad view to conversion. Define the future-state operational infrastructure, build training documentation, and seamlessly onboard team members to manage mature channels

  • Stakeholder Engagement: Foster strong collaboration with key stakeholders, both within Oviva’s marketing team to share insights and best practices, and with external teams and stakeholders, driving and contributing to cross-functional projects.

Job benefits

  • The opportunity to drive meaningful, life-changing impact through your work.

  • A high-growth environment with strong development opportunities.

  • Flexible working options – including remote working.

  • Personal learning budget and development plans.

  • A home working allowance to create your ideal workspace.

  • Competitive salary (shared in the first screening call) and benefits

jobs.title: Senior Sales Executive - New Business
jobs.description:
Senior Sales Executive - New Business
About Smartnumbers

We are on a mission to stop fraud and improve customer authentication. Fraud is a huge problem affecting millions of people, it costs the UK nearly £7bn and represents 40% of all crime. Too often the solution has been to put in place cumbersome authentication processes that frustrate genuine customers, cause inefficiencies for organisations and fail to prevent fraud. 
 
We are changing this by providing organisations with real-time insight into the risk of a caller. We combine patented machine learning technology with our industry consortium to help identify and prevent contact centre fraud. We also provide clients with real-time insight into the authenticity of the call by leveraging our unique network access and relationships. 
 
We recognise that we need to work together to fight fraud, that is why we have fostered strategic partnerships with leading global organisations like Amazon, BT, and Genesys. Together, we protect some of the UKs largest banks, insurance companies and emergency services. We also believe in developing our people into high performing teams.


What you'll be working on

We're looking for someone to build out a long term 2–3 year strategic pipeline. As part of the role, you will be expected to do the following: 
 

  • Build and maintain a 12–18 month active pipeline to support business objectives
  • Build and maintain relevant market awareness through client discussions, market research and industry events
  • Provide senior management with clear updates, progress and forecasts as evidenced through the company CRM
  • Nurture the customer advocacy program in support of our broader business goals
  • Prioritise activities to meet quarterly business targets while maintaining a longer-term strategic pipeline

What you’ll achieve 

You’ll be helping us achieve our mission by enabling fraud investigators across organisations to collaborate in their fight against fraud using our SaaS platform. The types of areas you’ll look at include: 
  • New Business Development
  • Leading client facing discover conversations to establish key business issues
  • Understanding and navigating the different approaches to fraud prevention across different sectors
  • Helping Clients build business cases for Smartnumbers adoption
  • Sharing intelligence and best practice across organisations
  • Increasing market awareness by supporting events, posts or other GTM activities
  • Building trust and a network of advocates among your client base

How you’ll work 

You’ll be part of an empowered cross functional go to market team that leverages best practice and seeks continual improvement. You’ll be given the freedom to manage your own time with support and guidance from senior sales leadership. You’ll be expected to build, maintain and report on a clear 12–18 month runway of pipeline with dedicated time set aside each week for strategic focus and execution on new business development.


What you'll need for the role

Smartnumbers values diversity of experience. Candidates should have a strong combination of several of the following skills, competencies and experience: 
 

  • Numbers Obsessed – You live and breathe your pipeline and progress and take pride in its resilience and accuracy.
  • Curious - You want to understand the problems our customers face and how we might solve them. You’re always looking for new opportunities to learn about our customers, the market, competitors, technology, etc.
  • Customer Focused - You start with the customer and work back whilst understanding that solutions have to work for our business
  • Outcome focused - You can define what success looks like and measure progress towards it
  • A clear communicator - You’re capable of explaining things regardless of whether it’s to a software engineer, salesperson, customer support agent or CEO


What we can offer you

As well as a competitive salary of circa £100,000 per annum, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, covering a variety of areas, both professional and personal. These benefits include:  

  • Hybrid working style, with the expectation of two days in the office (with a great City of London office base!)
  • Family friendly benefits including paid parental leave policies
  • An extensive health insurance policy for you, with an option to add your family members 
  • A workplace pension with Hargreaves Lansdown 
  • Life insurance of 4 x your salary 
  • Weekly self-development time to spend exploring your professional development interests
  • 25 days of annual leave (plus bank holidays), your birthday off, and an opportunity to buy up to 5 days annual leave per year
  • A holistic wellbeing support plan encompassing a variety of offerings to assist you. We provide you with a monthly £50 allowance to fund activities to best support your wellbeing as well as workshops and training to provide tools and guidance. Additionally, there is a wide-ranging employee assistance programme available to advise on personal, family or financial matters, and fun social events during the year.


The application process

We have a simple 3 stage application process: 

  1. 30-minute phone call with the hiring manager
  2. 1 hour interview and presentation
  3. HR and Bar Raiser Interview

You will receive equal treatment regardless of age, disability, neurodiversity, gender, gender identity, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation. We welcome all applications for this role.  
 
We are committed to providing reasonable support/adjustments in our recruiting processes. If you need support, please reach out to the hiring contact.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to own and improve the security of our internal environment — the identities, SaaS apps, endpoints, AI tooling, and networks our employees use every day. This is a hands-on senior role: we expect you to design controls, find the gaps, and drive the changes that close them — and to build the automation that makes it scale.

We’re an EMI-licensed fintech in a fully cloud-native AWS environment, we use AI heavily, and we’re growing fast. We need someone who can lead technical initiatives independently, influence our security architecture, challenge approaches that no longer fit, and explain it clearly to engineers and leadership.


Your Mission

Detection & Response (SIEM) — our top priority

  • Own SIEM alerting end-to-end: ship logs from endpoints, IdP, VPN, SaaS, and cloud; write and tune detection rules; cut false positives.
  • Act as first responder for security incidents — investigate, contain, drive to closure with clear runbooks — and feed recurring issues back into preventive controls.
Identity, Access & SaaS
  • Administer the IdP (SSO via SAML/OIDC, MFA, conditional access) and run access recertification end-to-end across IdP, SaaS, AWS, and internal tools — scope, evidence, follow-through on revocations.
  • Hunt down over-permissive and stale access, enforce least privilege and PAM, catch SoD gaps, and make JML and third-party access work in practice.
  • Improve SaaS security posture (Google/Microsoft, Slack, GitHub, others) and apply DLP controls to limit data leakage.
Endpoint, Email & Phishing Defense
  • Keep the endpoint stack healthy and well-tuned — MDM, XDR/AV, device-compliance checks for VPN/ZTNA — and define posture requirements (disk encryption, EDR present, OS version) with automated remediation.
  • Defend against phishing and spoofing — secure email gateway rules, DMARC/SPF/DKIM — and run phishing simulations and security awareness, acting on the results.
Automation & Ownership
  • Build internal tooling and automate repetitive operations — reduce manual work, don't just operate it.
  • Own the roadmap for your areas: identify gaps, lead initiatives independently, and raise the bar rather than just maintain it.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in security operations, corporate/IT security, or endpoint engineering.
  • Strong with a SIEM (Splunk, Elastic, Panther, Sumo Logic) — detection engineering and incident response — plus an identity provider (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace), access recertification, and least-privilege / PAM.

Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

The Maps API team builds and maintains the applications and infrastructure responsible for creating and distributing Mapbox maps. Thousands of customers rely on our services to seamlessly handle billions of requests every day, scale in real-time to global events, and enable designers, developers, and analysts to make and share maps we’ve never dreamed of.

Delivering maps means delivering a model of the world that’s changing all the time and needs to automatically support the world’s edge cases – writing systems, fonts, local regulations, and global boundary disputes.

Our team maintains the highest-traffic read APIs at Mapbox and the distributed ETL pipelines used by internal and external customers to turn data into maps. We’re building new ways for people to visualize location data. Check out our Mapbox maps!

As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow.

What You’ll Do

As a Software Development Engineer III on the Maps API team, you will be responsible for balancing rapid development of new mapping tools against the reliability of our services as they scale into new request volumes, markets, and use cases. In a single week on the Maps API team, you might write application code robust to a world’s worth of data, build and deploy microservices, diagnose complex system behavior as global markets drive traffic in unexpected ways, or facilitate continuous delivery at Mapbox.

In this role, you can expect to:

  • Lead your engineering team to identify and scope out well-defined tasks.

  • Execute on the scope and be accountable for delivering on time with quality.

  • Design systems and make architectural decisions that will keep pace with the rapid growth of Mapbox’s customer base.

  • Mentor your peers through 1:1s, facilitating design and code reviews, and providing continuous guidance to foster professional growth and technical excellence.

  • Promote a culture of operational excellence by meticulously testing and monitoring our systems and code, writing documentation, and being on-call to support the health of our services.

  • Reduce technical debt, share your knowledge, and invest in your teammates’ health and happiness, while optimizing application performance and accelerating feature velocity.

  • Uphold a culture of collaboration, transparency, creativity, inclusion, and data-driven decisions.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • 8-10+ years of experience building scalable high volume low latency backend services.

  • Proficiency with Python, NodeJS, and native AWS (CDK, ECS, Step Functions, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, CloudFront).

  • Experience building mapping and geospatial related products.

  • Familiarity with code versioning tools, such as GitHub.

  • Able to perform independently all the development tasks, based on designs and specs.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Germany
jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer - Germany

DRYFT

Ideas only change the world when you build them at scale. That’s what Dryft is here for.

Dryft builds models that automate complex human decisions in manufacturing operations. We capture the knowledge of experienced operators across supply chain, production planning, engineering and more, simulate the consequences of their decisions, and use this understanding to help run their business. Our customers include some of the largest robotics, machine and component manufacturers in the world.

We’re a small, talent-dense team with modest roots and a love for the physical world: cars, machines, planes. Our team includes graduates from Stanford, Berkeley, CDTM and TUM, winners of Stanford TreeHacks, recipients of Fulbright & Haniel scholarships, and people who have built everything from robots and race cars to software with millions of downloads.

What matters more to us than credentials is how people work: humility, hard work, speed, kindness, deep customer care, and a willingness to take on problems others avoid. Working at Dryft is hard. You get unusual ownership early on, with real responsibility. But that’s also what makes it one of the biggest learning experiences of your life.

We’re backed by founders and operators behind some of the most legendary tech companies of our time, Tier-1 U.S. venture firms, and board members of global industrial companies.

ERPs ran the physical world for half a century. Dryft is building the intelligence layer that will power the next.

​

THE ROLE

As our Forward Deployed Engineer, you split your time 50/50 between engineering and customer interaction. No role will teach you more about becoming a great founder, listener & builder. One day you're integrating a legacy ERP, the next you're on a flight to a shop floor in Mexico, and in between you ship the fix. You'll navigate stakeholders from IT to the C-level, all at once, and nothing really prepares you for it.

  • Lead full-stack rollouts – own implementations end-to-end, from scoping and onboarding to integration and training, and align IT teams, engineers and C-level execs across Germany, the EU and the US

  • Design the product backbone – work hands-on with users, translate their pain into product improvements, and prototype features yourself, ideally writing production code when needed

  • Turn operations into product – every deployment becomes a blueprint for scale: you turn what you learned into reusable product features, data models and playbooks, and grow into roles like CPO or COO

This is a high-ownership, zero-handholding role, and only for someone who loves turning complexity into clarity and ships working solutions under pressure.

​

YOU

  • Fast-paced experience – 2+ years in a top-tier role (e.g., consulting), as a founder, or as an early employee in a high-growth startup, with a technical degree or background

  • Engineer first – you write production code, understand systems end-to-end, and when something breaks at a customer, you find the root cause

  • Industrial background – experience in manufacturing, industrial software, procurement, supply chain or another industrial domain is a plus

  • Product-minded – you listen to rants about ERP, nod wisely, and somehow turn them into product features that feel like magic

  • Quality-obsessed – you hold yourself to a high bar, dive deep into problems, and care about getting it right, not just getting it done

  • Ultra-professional & detail-obsessed – you earn trust with structure, polish, and docs so clean even a CTO stops asking questions

  • Crisis communicator – when things get hard, people look to you; you calm an impatient exec, win over a skeptical IT leader, and still crack a joke in the middle of it

  • Down-to-earth & relatable – you bond with shop-floor operators as easily as with boardroom execs, and you'll put on the safety shoes without being asked

  • Language – you're fully fluent in German and English

  • Relocation – you're ready to work onsite in Munich (we support visa), with 10 to 30% travel

​

TECH STACK

  • FE (TypeScript): React, Chakra UI v3, TanStack Router, TanStack Query, Vite

  • BE (Python): FastAPI with Pydantic v2, Temporal, Postgres with pgvector, dagster

  • AI: Pydantic AI, Langfuse
