jobs.title: Technischer Projektmanager (m/w/d) – Industrial Innovation & Systems Integration
jobs.description:
Technischer Projektmanager (m/w/d) – Industrial Innovation & Systems Integration

Gemeinsam aus industriellen Herausforderungen neue Lösungen entwickeln.

Wie gestalten wir die Fabrik der Zukunft – mit zuverlässigeren Produktionsprozessen, intelligenter Automatisierung, höherer Effizienz und flexibleren Fertigungssystemen? Welche Technologien schaffen dabei einen echten Mehrwert und wie entstehen daraus funktionierende Lösungen?

Beim Smart Systems Hub beantworten wir solche Fragen gemeinsam mit Industrieunternehmen, Entwicklern und Technologiepartnern. In interdisziplinären Teams entwickeln und erproben wir innovative Lösungen – von der ersten Idee bis zum funktionsfähigen Prototypen.

Dafür suchen wir dich: einen technisch versierten Projektmanager (m/w/d), der industrielle Problemstellungen versteht, unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenbringt und technische Innovationsprojekte mitgestaltet und vorantreibt.

Über uns

Der Smart Systems Hub in Dresden ist ein Co-Innovationszentrum für industrielle Automatisierung und Digitalisierung. Gemeinsam mit Unternehmen, Forschungseinrichtungen und Technologiepartnern entwickeln und erproben wir neue Lösungen für die vernetzte Produktion.

Unsere Projekte verbinden Technologien aus den Bereichen Software, Hardware, Industrial IoT, Datenökosysteme, Robotik und künstliche Intelligenz.

Deine Rolle bei uns

Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen Industriekunden, Engineering und Technologiepartnern. Dabei verbindest du technisches Projektmanagement mit Requirements Engineering, Systemverständnis und einer ausgeprägten Hands-on-Mentalität.

Dein Arbeitsalltag ist vielfältig: Mal begleitest du ein mehrmonatiges Entwicklungsprojekt, mal konzipierst du einen Technologiesprint, baust gemeinsam mit dem Team einen Demonstrator auf oder unterstützt einen dreitägigen Thin[gk]athon.

Deine Aufgaben in der technischen Projektleitung

  • Industrielle Entwicklungsprojekte leiten: Du koordinierst gemeinsam mit Kunden und Entwicklungsteams mehrmonatige Projekte mit passenden agilen oder hybriden Vorgehensweisen – von der Anforderungsanalyse über die technische Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung und Validierung.

  • Technologiesprints gestalten: Du strukturierst industrielle Use Cases, bewertest technologische Lösungsoptionen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams erste Lösungsansätze und Prototypen.

  • Demonstratoren aufbauen: Du konzipierst mit unseren Technologiepartnern funktionsfähige End-to-End-Demonstratoren und integrierst dabei auch selbst Hardware, Software, Schnittstellen und bestehende Open-Source-Komponenten.

  • Co-Innovationsformate begleiten: Du bereitest Thin[gk]athons und Hackathons technisch vor, unterstützt Entwicklungsteams und hilfst, innerhalb kurzer Zeit erste funktionierende Lösungen zu realisieren.

  • Anforderungen und Architekturen erarbeiten: Du übersetzt industrielle Problemstellungen gemeinsam mit Kunden und Entwicklern in technische Anforderungen, Systemarchitekturen, Schnittstellen und Datenflüsse.

  • Technologien bewerten: Du recherchierst geeignete Lösungen, vergleichst Standardprodukte und Individualentwicklungen und beurteilst deren Machbarkeit, Integrationsfähigkeit und Entwicklungsaufwand.

  • Entwicklungsteams fachlich begleiten: Du diskutierst technische Entscheidungen auf Augenhöhe mit Spezialisten, erkennst Integrationsrisiken und unterstützt die Umsetzung und Bewertung der Ergebnisse.

  • Projekte voranbringen: Du koordinierst Arbeitspakete, Meilensteine, Ressourcen und Projektpartner, verbindest iterative Entwicklungszyklen mit verlässlicher Planung und sorgst für eine transparente, lösungsorientierte Zusammenarbeit.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung in Informatik, Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Mechatronik oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Bereich – alternativ entsprechende praktische Erfahrung.

  • Erfahrung in der agilen oder hybriden Leitung technischer Entwicklungs-, Integrations- oder Innovationsprojekte sowie in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und interdisziplinären Teams.

  • Ein ausgeprägtes technisches Systemverständnis und Kenntnisse moderner industrieller IT-/OT-Architekturen – vom Shopfloor über Maschinensteuerungen, SCADA und MES bis zu ERP-, Edge- und Cloud-Systemen. Du kannst deren Zusammenspiel sowie Hardware-, Software- und Datenarchitekturen schnell erfassen und verständlich darstellen.

  • Kenntnisse im Requirements Engineering und die Fähigkeit, aus Kundenanforderungen technische Lösungsansätze abzuleiten.

  • Solide Grundlagen in Softwareentwicklung, industrieller Netzwerk- und IoT-Konnektivität sowie Systemintegration. Du verstehst das Zusammenspiel von Softwarekomponenten, APIs und Schnittstellen und kannst bestehende Frameworks und Open-Source-Bausteine nutzen, um einfache Anwendungen und technische Prototypen selbst umzusetzen.

  • Technologische Neugier, Eigeninitiative und Freude an der praktischen Umsetzung. Du kannst auch bei unklaren oder widersprüchlichen Anforderungen strukturiert und handlungsfähig bleiben, Annahmen überprüfen und Lösungswege an neue Erkenntnisse anpassen. Du nutzt moderne KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge und kannst ihre Ergebnisse kritisch bewerten.

  • Deutsch (C1/Muttersprache) und Englisch (fließend)

Das wäre zusätzlich hilfreich

Besonders hilfreich ist, wenn du Technologien aus den folgenden Bereichen fachlich einordnen, ihre Einsatzmöglichkeiten und Grenzen bewerten und auf industrielle Anwendungsfälle übertragen kannst. Praktische Erfahrung mit einzelnen Technologien ist ein Plus – tiefes Spezialwissen in allen Bereichen erwarten wir nicht.

  • Industrial IoT & Embedded Systems: Sensorik, Mikrocontroller wie ESP32, industrielle Kommunikationsprotokolle wie OPC UA und MQTT sowie Maschinen- und Anlagenintegration.

  • Software & Rapid Prototyping: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Open-Source-Frameworks und -Bibliotheken wie Angular, React oder Bootstrap sowie Node-RED, REST APIs, Docker und Cloud-Dienste wie AWS oder Azure.

  • Industrielle Zukunftstechnologien: Computer Vision, Industrial AI, Datenräume und Manufacturing-X, Robotik, Simulation oder digitale Zwillinge.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Abwechslungsreiche Innovationsprojekte mit Industrieunternehmen, unter anderem aus Halbleiterfertigung, Maschinen- und Anlagenbau.

  • Die Möglichkeit, neue Technologien praktisch zu erproben und gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Spezialisten in die Anwendung zu bringen.

  • Ein interdisziplinäres Team, ein starkes Technologie- und Industrienetzwerk und viel Raum für eigene Ideen und Gestaltung.

Benefits

Wir möchten, dass du dich bei uns von Anfang an wohlfühlst — fachlich, persönlich und im Arbeitsalltag. Deshalb bieten wir dir neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz auch attraktive Zusatzleistungen und flexible Rahmenbedingungen.

Flexibles Arbeiten

  • Remote-Arbeit
    Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, flexibel remote zu arbeiten und deinen Arbeitsalltag eigenverantwortlich zu gestalten.

  • Arbeitstechnik wird gestellt
    Die für deine Tätigkeit notwendige Arbeitstechnik stellen wir dir selbstverständlich zur Verfügung.

Urlaub & freie Tage

  • 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr

jobs.title: Working Student Finance (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Working Student Finance (m/w/d)
Westbridge-Gruppe | Was uns antreibt

Gebäude und Immobilien müssen heute mehr leisten als je zuvor: effizienter werden, Ressourcen schonen und gleichzeitig wirtschaftlich betrieben werden. Dafür braucht es nicht nur intelligente Lösungen und transparente Daten, sondern auch eine leistungsfähige finanzielle Steuerung. 

Als einer der führenden Energie- und Nachhaltigkeitsberater für die Immobilienwirtschaft in Europa treiben wir diesen Wandel aktiv mit. Wir unterstützen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden dabei, Gebäude und Portfolios fit für die Zukunft zu machen – von der strategischen Beratung über die technische Planung bis hin zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. 

Finance ist heute weit mehr als Buchhaltung und Reporting: Prozesse, Systeme und Anforderungen entwickeln sich kontinuierlich weiter und eröffnen immer neue Möglichkeiten, Finance effizienter und zukunftsorientierter aufzustellen. Für unser Team in Frankfurt am Main suchen wir daher einen Working Student Finance (m/w/d), der Finance nicht nur aus dem Studium kennt, sondern die unterschiedlichen Bereiche in der Praxis kennenlernen und aktiv an operativen Themen, Transformationsprojekten und M&A-bezogenen Fragestellungen mitarbeiten möchte.


Deine Aufgaben

Als Teil unseres Finance-Teams lernst du die unterschiedlichen Facetten von Finance aus nächster Nähe kennen und arbeitest an operativen, analytischen und projektbezogenen Fragestellungen mit. Dabei bist du eng mit unseren Funktionen Accounting & Tax, FP&A und Finance Transformation sowie den jeweiligen Directors im Austausch. Neben dem laufenden Finance-Tagesgeschäft wirkst du auch an Transformationsprojekten, M&A-bezogenen Themen und der Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Strukturen und -Prozesse mit. 

  • FP&A & Reporting: Du unterstützt bei der Analyse von Umsatz-, Kosten- und Ergebnisentwicklungen sowie bei der Aufbereitung relevanter Kennzahlen und Management-Auswertungen. Dabei erhältst du einen direkten Einblick in unsere Planungs-, Forecasting- und Reporting-Prozesse und lernst, finanzielle Entwicklungen einzuordnen und ihre wesentlichen Treiber zu verstehen.
  • Finance Transformation: Du unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Prozesse und wirkst bei der Konzeption und Umsetzung konkreter Verbesserungsmaßnahmen mit. Dabei begleitest du unter anderem die Automatisierung wiederkehrender Abläufe sowie die Einführung und Weiterentwicklung neuer Systeme und Technologien im Finance-Bereich.
  • M&A & PMI: Du unterstützt bei M&A-bezogenen Finance-Fragestellungen und erhältst Einblicke in Transaktionen und Due-Diligence-Prozesse. Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Post-Merger-Integration: Hier wirkst du dabei mit, neu erworbene Gesellschaften in unsere Finance-Strukturen zu integrieren und Prozesse, Daten und Systeme zusammenzuführen.
  • Accounting: Du unterstützt unser Accounting-Team im operativen Tagesgeschäft und lernst dabei die zentralen Prozesse der Finanzbuchhaltung aus erster Hand kennen. Darüber hinaus wirkst du bei Monats-, Jahres- und Konzernabschlüssen mit und entwickelst so ein fundiertes Verständnis dafür, wie Accounting und Reporting in der Praxis zusammenspielen.
  • Strategische Finance-Projekte: Du arbeitest an bereichsübergreifenden Finance-Projekten und aktuellen Fragestellungen mit und übernimmst dabei eigene Teilaufgaben. So erhältst du die Möglichkeit, Themen von der Analyse und Konzeption bis zur konkreten Umsetzung zu begleiten und zunehmend Verantwortung zu übernehmen.


Das bringst du mit

Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für Zahlen und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge, denkst analytisch und arbeitest dich schnell in neue Themen ein. Gleichzeitig packst du gerne selbst mit an, kommunizierst offen und klar und fühlst dich in einem dynamischen Umfeld wohl, in dem sich Themen und Prioritäten auch kurzfristig verändern können. Dabei bringst du die nötige Flexibilität und Eigeninitiative mit, um Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Themen aktiv voranzubringen. 

  • Du bist in einem Masterstudiengang oder mindestens im vierten Fachsemster eines Bachelorstudiengangs der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang eingeschrieben und hast deinen Studienschwerpunkt im Bereich Finance, Accounting oder Controlling gesetzt.
  • Idealerweise hast du bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen im Finance-Umfeld gesammelt, beispielsweise im Accounting, Controlling, FP&A, in der Wirtschaftsprüfung oder Beratung.
  • Auch bei mehreren parallel laufenden Themen behältst du den Überblick und arbeitest strukturiert, sorgfältig und zuverlässig.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Du bist digital affin, verfügst über sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse – insbesondere in Excel und PowerPoint – und arbeitest dich schnell und gerne in neue Tools und Finance-Systeme ein. Erste Erfahrungen mit Anwendungen wie DATEV, LucaNet oder Power BI sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss.
  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Umgang mit KI-basierten Tools und setzt diese gezielt ein, um Aufgaben effizienter zu bearbeiten, Informationen zu strukturieren und die Qualität deiner Arbeitsergebnisse zu verbessern.


So arbeiten wir

Bei uns bist du nicht auf einen einzelnen Finance-Bereich festgelegt. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Teams aus Accounting & Tax, FP&A und Finance Transformation zusammen und erhältst dadurch einen umfassenden Einblick in unterschiedliche Finance-Disziplinen und deren Zusammenspiel. Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen sowie den jeweiligen Directors zusammen. 

Dabei kannst du dein Wissen aus dem Studium unmittelbar in der Praxis anwenden und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterentwickeln. Wir arbeiten dich strukturiert in deine Aufgaben ein, erwarten aber gleichzeitig, dass du dich proaktiv einbringst, mitdenkst und Themen eigenständig vorantreibst. Mit zunehmender Erfahrung geben wir dir die Möglichkeit, mehr Verantwortung und eigene Aufgabenpakete zu übernehmen. Uns ist wichtig, dass du nicht nur zuschaust, sondern von Beginn an aktiv mitarbeitest und einen echten Beitrag zu unserem Finance-Team leistest. 

Was uns besonders auszeichnet, ist unser Team: Wir sind ein junges, ambitioniertes Finance-Team mit hoher Dynamik, kurzen Abstimmungswegen und einem starken Zusammenhalt. Wir arbeiten fachlich anspruchsvoll, unterstützen uns gegenseitig und haben gleichzeitig Spaß daran, gemeinsam Dinge voranzubringen. Dabei schätzen wir den direkten und offenen Austausch und geben guten Ideen unabhängig von Rolle oder Erfahrung den nötigen Raum. 

Dein Studium steht weiterhin im Mittelpunkt: Während des Semesters kannst du uns bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen, in der vorlesungsfreien Zeit nach Absprache auch in Vollzeit.


Dein nächster Schritt

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und mit dir darüber zu sprechen, wie dein nächster beruflicher Schritt aussehen soll – und ob wir der richtige Partner dafür sind.

About Nebuly

Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI.

Every enterprise function, sales, customer support, HR, finance, is deploying AI agents at scale, and budgets are following fast. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working? Every enterprise deploying AI agents is asking the same question: is this actually delivering value? Today, almost none of them can answer it. The signal that could answer it is right there: millions of conversations happening every day between employees, customers, and these agents, but it's unstructured, high-volume, and invisible without the right infrastructure. So the ROI question stays unanswered, not because the answer doesn't exist, but because no one can see it. Nebuly makes that signal visible. It sits on top of any enterprise AI deployment, turns those conversations into a clear answer, is this working, and where, and connects the dots back to ROI. Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value, with no data ever leaving your environment.

Every new data category has created a new software category. CRM turned customer interactions into pipeline accountability. Product analytics turned user behavior into growth accountability. Nebuly is building that same layer for AI, turning millions of invisible conversations into a clear answer on value.

Our customers include Oura, CNH Industrial, Vodafone, and Moncler. Demand is accelerating fast, and we're building the team to match.

Winning enterprise deals is hard. Turning it into a long-term, expanding contract is harder, and that's where this role lives.

You own the technical side of the customer journey, from first demo to expansion. You convince technically skeptical enterprise teams that Nebuly works in their environment, then make sure it does. Above all, you translate technical data into a meaningful value proposition for C-level audiences.

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

Our clinics depend on technology that simply works: the network, the devices and the rooms members walk into for their scan and debrief. As Lead Corporate Engineer in London, you’ll work alongside the Corporate Engineering team to provide industry-leading support services and build solutions.

You’ll provide generalist support to the company at our London HQ and, on top of that, be Corporate Engineering’s domain expert for network and security, the key contact for our network and AV partners, and the person on site when a clinic opening or incident needs hands-on ownership.   • Strong networking fundamentals (LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, DHCP, DNS, Wi-Fi), hands-on Cisco Meraki (MX/MS/MR) troubleshooting, and working knowledge of Azure networking (VPN, Point-to-Site, VNets, NSGs).

  • PowerShell scripting for administration and repeatable operations, and confident use of AI to draft scripts, document incidents and speed up diagnosis, with clear judgement on where hands-on verification is needed.

  • Clear documentation and communication: you can explain a technical issue to a clinic lead or a non-technical leader, and hold your ground with a vendor.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Clinic or venue AV systems (Sonos amplifiers, Soundtrack, Dante audio, meeting-room displays and NUCs), including coordinating AV vendor access for testing and handover.

  • Microsoft Graph or API experience for workflow and operational automation.

  • New office or site launches in a fast-scaling company, from build to first day of business.

  • Experience migrating between platforms or bringing outsourced services in-house.

Senior Digital IC Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Digital IC Design Engineer
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team

Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.

This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company.

Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London).


Functions of the Role

This senior position operates at the critical intersection of sub-Kelvin sub-system electronics and quantum processor architectures, directly addressing the interconnect bottleneck in scalable quantum computing systems. The role spans the full digital IC design cycle—including initial microarchitecture specification, RTL development, Verilog-AMS co-simulation, physical implementation (PnR/CTS), low-power synthesis, static timing analysis (STA), and full tape-out signoff. The ultimate objective is the realization of ultra-low-power, high-density cryogenic control ICs tailored for fault-tolerant quantum computing scale-out.


  • Position Title:  Senior Digital Designer (Front-End & Back-End)

  • Domain Focus:  Ultra-Low-Power Cryogenic CMOS (Cryo-CMOS) Digital Control Sub-circuits

  • Design Scope:  Full Lifecycle (RTL Development, AMS Co-Simulation, Physical Implementation, Low-Power Synthesis, and Tape-Out Signoff)

  • Core Chip Architecture Target: Cryogenic digital logic blocks operating at sub-Kelvin regimes (<4.2 K), 


Experience - Essentials

  • Education: Master's degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Computer Engineering, or related technical discipline.

  • Chip Design Experience: 5+ years of hands-on digital and mixed-signal IC design, demonstrating successful completion of at least 2 tape-outs on advanced semiconductor nodes 

  • Hardware Coding: Proficiency in Verilog and SystemVerilog for synthesizable RTL development and Verilog-AMS/SystemVerilog-Real-Math for mixed-signal co-simulation and testbench environments.

  • Design Tools: Proven proficiency with industry-standard EDA toolchains (e.g., Cadence Virtuoso/Innovus/Xcelium, Synopsys Design Compiler) for mixed-signal simulation, synthesis, and verification.

  • Physical Layout: Demonstrated capability in transforming RTL into GDSII/OASIS physical layouts, floorplanning, power grid synthesis, clock tree synthesis (CTS), multi-corner multi-mode static timing analysis (MCMM STA), and physical signoff (DRC/LVS/ERC).

  • Communication & Logic Design: Experience architecting high-speed serial interconnect protocols (e.g., custom SPI, AXI, SerDes) and complex finite-state machine (FSM) control logic.

  • Low Power & Thermal Management: Deep expertise in low-power dissipation techniques (clock gating, power gating, dynamic voltage scaling) within stringent thermal lift budgets of cryogenic cooling systems.


Experience - Desirable

  • Cryogenic CMOS Experience: Hands-on experience designing, modeling, or characterizing CMOS circuits at sub-4.2 K temperatures and understanding cryo-specific transistor behavior.
  • Mixed-Signal & AMS Interfaces: Direct integration of digital logic with precision analog/RF front-ends (ADCs, DACs, LNAs, AWGs) for qubit control and readout.
  • Quantum Architecture Awareness: Familiarity with quantum control interfaces, pulse generation, error correction, or cryogenic spin qubit electronics
  • Low-Power Verification & UPF/CPF: Proficiency in power-aware simulation using IEEE 1801 UPF/CPF, formal LEC, and power signoff tools (Voltus, PrimePower).
  • Advanced Process Nodes: Experience with sub-28nm nodes, with a strong preference for FD-SOI or FinFET technologies.
  • EDA Scripting & Automation: Strong scripting skills (TCL, Python) to automate synthesis, physical design, and verification flows.
  • DFT & Silicon Bring-Up: Practical knowledge of DFT insertion (Scan, MBIST) and post-silicon laboratory bring-up, testing, and debug.


Benefits

  • Be part of a creative, world-leading team
  • Competitive salary and share options scheme
  • Contributory pension scheme
  • Group private medical insurance scheme
  • Choose your own laptop/kit
  • Life Assurance
  • Cycle-to-work Scheme
  • Flexible working
  • Central London location

Quantum Motion is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and does not discriminate based on age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, colour, religion, disability status, marital status, pregnancy, gender reassignment or any other protected characteristics covered by the Equality Act 2010.

  • Excellent relationnel : tu sais instaurer une confiance immédiate et créer un lien fort avec des entrepreneurs indépendants

  • Mobilité : le permis B est indispensable. Tu gères en totale autonomie la région de Genève.

  • L'opportunité de participer à une success story et d'avoir un impact tangible sur l'avenir du secteur de la beauté et du bien-être

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager
About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an AI-first way of working. You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.


Your Mission

  • Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured.
  • 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration.
  • Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build.
  • Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.
  • Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated.
  • AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it.
  • Fast prototyping: validate ideas with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agents), scripts, no-code, or whatever gets you to the answer quickest.
  • Hands-on work: write queries, dig into data pipelines, spin up prototypes, and open a PR when it makes sense.
  • Prioritisation: balance user impact, business value, effort and regulatory constraints, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and business owners to ship continuously.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in product management or product engineering with strong technical involvement, and a track record of taking products from 0 to live use with real users.
  • AI-native: you use LLMs, vibe coding and agents daily, and you've applied LLMs or agentic AI to real products.
  • Strong in Python or a similar language, enough to build things yourself. Comfortable with SQL, git, databases and evaluating system architecture.
  • Fluent in product analytics and research: you define metrics, read data yourself, and validate through interviews, usability testing and experiments.
  • Strong grasp of UX. You can take a complex flow and make it simple.
  • Experience shipping with Design and Engineering in an agile environment.
  • Clear communicator in English and self-directed. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people, write specs engineers respect, and don't wait to be told what matters.

Nice to Have
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field.
  • Experience in fintech or another regulated industry.
  • Early-stage startup background.
  • Hands-on LLM orchestration or prompt engineering.
  • Background in software engineering, QA or product analytics.


Why Join Vivid?

  • We have a hybrid model in our Limassol and Berlin offices, or fully remote outside office locations. 
  • We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
  • AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation.

Member of Technical Staff Intern - Germany

DRYFT

Ideas only change the world when you build them at scale. That’s what Dryft is here for.

Dryft builds models that automate complex human decisions in manufacturing operations. We capture the knowledge of experienced operators across supply chain, production planning, engineering and more, simulate the consequences of their decisions, and use this understanding to help run their business. Our customers include some of the largest robotics, machine and component manufacturers in the world.

We’re a small, talent-dense team with modest roots and a love for the physical world: cars, machines, planes. Our team includes graduates from Stanford, Berkeley, CDTM and TUM, winners of Stanford TreeHacks, recipients of Fulbright & Haniel scholarships, and people who have built everything from robots and race cars to software with millions of downloads.

What matters more to us than credentials is how people work: humility, hard work, speed, kindness, deep customer care, and a willingness to take on problems others avoid. Working at Dryft is hard. You get unusual ownership early on, with real responsibility. But that’s also what makes it one of the biggest learning experiences of your life.

We’re backed by founders and operators behind some of the most legendary tech companies of our time, Tier-1 U.S. venture firms, and board members of global industrial companies.

ERPs ran the physical world for half a century. Dryft is building the intelligence layer that will power the next.

​

THE ROLE

As a Member of Technical Staff Intern, you'll build the system that decides how some of the largest manufacturers in the world operate. That means combining agent-based reasoning with mathematical optimization and simulation on large-scale industrial data.

  • Build agents people trust – when an agent runs a factory's week, the largest industrial companies in the world have to trust it with their critical processes and understand every decision it makes; you build the routing, orchestration and guardrails behind that

  • Ship features end-to-end – you understand the user need, and you get the freedom to build it across the LLM pipeline, infrastructure, backend and frontend, in production in your first weeks

  • Work close to the users – sit with the planners who use it, see what would make their work 10x faster, and build it

You'll own your own features from day one, and what you ship decides what a plant does next week.

​

YOU

  • Full-stack shipper – you've shipped production code end-to-end, you build scalable backend and infra that handles massive amounts of structured and unstructured data, and you build the interface that makes it usable

  • Highly technical – you've built something technically hard, and you can walk us through every decision behind it

  • Product sense – you spot the feature hiding in a user's complaint, and you've deleted your own favorite one because nobody used it

  • You care about getting it right – you know when it has to be 100% and when to keep it simple, and when it matters, you're still chasing the root cause at 2am

  • Sense of urgency – you'd rather ship it tonight than sleep on an open PR

  • Language – you're fully fluent in German and English

  • Relocation – you're ready to work onsite in Munich (we support visa)

​

TECH STACK

  • FE (TypeScript): React, Chakra UI v3, TanStack Router, TanStack Query, Vite

  • BE (Python): FastAPI with Pydantic v2, Temporal, Postgres with pgvector, dagster

  • AI: Pydantic AI, Langfuse

In doing so, you will combine cloud infrastructure, platform architecture, and modern Data & AI technologies into solutions that create a stable foundation for analytics, data engineering, and AI use cases.

Développeur Nouveaux Projets (F/H/X)

Localisation
Poste basé à Lyon ou Dijon.  

Vous êtes passionné(e) par le développement des énergies renouvelables et vous connaissez bien le tissu économique et territorial de l’Est de la France ? Rejoignez Novar et devenez un acteur clé de la transition énergétique !

En tant que Développeur Nouveaux Projets, vous serez en première ligne pour identifier et sécuriser de nouveaux sites solaires et/ou de stockage en régions AURA et Bourgogne, tout en construisant des relations solides avec les acteurs locaux (collectivités, propriétaires fonciers, entreprises, partenaires). Grâce à votre sens du terrain et votre capacité à fédérer, vous participerez activement au développement de projets qui font sens pour le territoire et ses habitants.


Vos missions

·         Assurer une veille active des opportunités de marché (appels à projets, appels d’offres) sur votre territoire.

·         Construire et maintenir un réseau local solide, incluant partenaires, collectivités et apporteurs d’affaires.

·         Assurer le suivi des opportunités jusqu’à leur concrétisation et leur passage en phase de développement.

Votre profil

jobs.title: Head of ClinOps Data Management RWD/RWE
jobs.description:
Head of ClinOps Data Management RWD/RWE

À propos de Lifen

Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales peuvent transformer le système de santé, à condition qu’elles soient accessibles. Mieux les faire circuler, c’est réduire la charge administrative, mieux coordonner les soins et accélérer la recherche clinique.

Depuis 2015, nous développons des solutions qui aident les professionnels de santé à partager les informations médicales et les chercheurs à exploiter des données de santé. Plus de 150 personnes travaillent chez Lifen, depuis nos bureaux et à distance. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé en France.

Notre équipe

L’équipe Clinical Ops intervient au cœur de nos projets de recherche clinique fondés sur des données de santé. Elle transforme des documents médicaux en données structurées, nécessaires à la constitution de cohortes patients et à la préparation des exports utilisés dans nos projets de recherche.

Aujourd’hui, l’équipe structure environ 100 à 200 cas patients par semaine. Notre ambition : tripler cette capacité dans les 9 prochains mois, tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité des données.

Pour y parvenir, nous cherchons une personne capable de reprendre le management de l’équipe, mais surtout de piloter le flux de production, d’anticiper la charge et de porter une démarche d’amélioration continue avec les équipes Produit, IA et Engineering.

C’est un rôle à la croisée du management opérationnel, de la RWD et de l’amélioration de processus.

Ce que tu feras chez nous

Ta première mission sera de reprendre le pilotage de la production des cohortes afin d’en améliorer simultanément la qualité, la capacité de traitement et le niveau d’automatisation.

Concrètement, tu seras amené·e à :

  • Manager et faire grandir l’équipe Clinical Ops, en donnant un cadre clair aux priorités et en organisant l’activité quotidienne.

  • Anticiper la charge et piloter la capacité de production afin de limiter les bottlenecks et de mieux absorber les variations de volume.

  • Construire les outils de pilotage nécessaires pour avoir une vision fine du flux : volumes de patients, capacité de traitement, taux d’erreur, points de blocage et charge de l’équipe.

  • Construire et orchestrer une roadmap d’amélioration continue permettant progressivement d’augmenter la capacité de traitement.

  • Porter cette roadmap auprès des équipes Produit, IA et Engineering : rendre les besoins opérationnels visibles, suivre les livrables R&D et créer le rythme nécessaire pour que les améliorations soient effectivement délivrées.

  • Garantir la qualité des cohortes et contribuer à la préparation des exports de données nécessaires aux projets de recherche.

Ce que nous attendrons de toi

Dans les premiers mois, nous attendrons de toi que tu développes une compréhension très fine du flux Clinical Ops : où se trouvent les blocages, comment évolue la charge et quels leviers permettent réellement d'améliorer la production.

Ton succès se mesurera notamment à ta capacité à mettre en place un pilotage fiable de l’activité, à réduire les erreurs et les bottlenecks et à créer, avec les équipes Produit et R&D, un rythme d’amélioration continue suffisamment soutenu pour accompagner notre changement d’échelle.

À horizon 9 mois, l’objectif est clair : passer d’environ 100–200 à 300–600 cas patients structurés par semaine, sans multiplier les ressources par trois.

Ce que nous recherchons

Must-have

Nous chercherons en priorité trois éléments dans ton parcours :

  • Une expérience réussie en startup ou scale-up, dans un environnement où les process, outils et responsabilités restaient à construire.

  • Une expérience concrète de la Real-World Data / Real-World Evidence, idéalement autour de la constitution ou de l'exploitation de cohortes patients.

  • Un background santé ou scientifique te permettant de comprendre les enjeux liés aux données médicales et à la recherche clinique.

Nous attendons également :

  • Une expérience confirmée de management d’équipe opérationnelle.

  • Une expérience de structuration et de pilotage d’une activité complexe à partir de données et de KPI.

  • Une capacité à passer d’un problème opérationnel très concret à un plan d’amélioration structuré.

  • Une expérience de collaboration étroite avec des équipes Produit, Data/IA ou Engineering.

  • Une capacité à faire avancer une roadmap transverse et à créer de l’accountability autour des livrables.

Nice-to-have

  • Un parcours en data management, biostatistiques, épidémiologie ou dans un domaine scientifique proche.

  • Une expérience de structuration de registres, bases de données de santé ou cohortes RWD.

  • Une familiarité avec les enjeux de recherche clinique et les interactions avec les autorités de santé.

  • Une bonne compréhension des usages de l’IA et de l’ingénierie appliqués aux données de santé.

Ta manière de travailler

Tu as une vraie “just do it mentality” : face à un problème imparfaitement cadré, tu commences par comprendre les faits, tu structures le problème et tu mets rapidement en place les premières solutions.

Tu es particulièrement à l’aise dans les environnements où il faut créer les outils plutôt que simplement les utiliser. Si le dashboard dont tu as besoin pour piloter ton équipe n’existe pas, tu es capable de le définir et de le mettre en place.

Tu es structuré·e et organisé·e, mais pas bureaucratique. Tu sais entrer suffisamment dans le détail du flux pour comprendre les problèmes réels, tout en gardant une vision d’ensemble et en priorisant ce qui aura le plus d’impact.

Enfin, tu sais faire avancer des équipes sur lesquelles tu n’as pas nécessairement d’autorité hiérarchique. Tu rends les problèmes visibles, explicites les priorités et crées le rythme nécessaire pour transformer les décisions en améliorations concrètes.

Nos valeurs

Embrace Complexity — Tu aimes comprendre un flux de données complexe, en identifier les points de rupture et transformer cette complexité en décisions concrètes.

Bienveillance — Tu accompagnes une équipe au quotidien avec exigence, écoute et clarté.

Real Impact — Tu améliores la qualité et la disponibilité des données qui permettent de faire avancer des projets de recherche clinique.

Process de recrutement

Échange de préqualification avec Laura, Talent Acquisition Manager, 30 minutes. Nous faisons connaissance, revenons sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les grandes lignes du poste. C’est aussi le moment de répondre à tes premières questions sur Lifen, l’équipe et le contexte.

Entretien avec le VP Reasearch, 60 minutes. Nous revenons plus en détail sur ton parcours, ton expérience en RWD et en constitution de cohortes, ainsi que sur ton expérience de management et de pilotage d’activités opérationnelles. L’objectif est aussi de comprendre la manière dont tu structures et fais évoluer une organisation dans un environnement en croissance.

Use Case avec des membres des équipes Clinical Ops et Produit, 60 minutes. À partir de situations concrètes, nous échangeons sur ta manière de structurer une cohorte RWD, d’analyser des problématiques opérationnelles et de construire des plans d’amélioration. Ce sera également l’occasion d’aborder la manière dont tu gères les enjeux humains et la collaboration avec des équipes transverses.

Cultural alignment avec deux membres de Lifen, 45 minutes en visio. Ce temps permettra d’échanger sur ta façon de travailler, ton niveau d’autonomie, la collaboration au quotidien et l’adéquation avec nos valeurs.

Compensation: €65K – €75K

Design Release Engineer -Airframe

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Design Release Manager to join our Airframe Team in Lausanne. In this role, you will bridge the gap between initial mechanical concept and full-scale manufacturing, taking complete ownership of the manufacturing dossier for our composite structures and airframe modules.

From day one, you will drive Design for Manufacturability and Design for Assembly directly inside the design loop, before parts are frozen. You will set and hold the release standard, define geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, manage engineering change orders, and act as the single authority signing off on product transfer gates to manufacturing.

What You Will Do

  • Manufacturing Dossier Ownership: Own and maintain the complete transfer package for your designated airframe module, including controlled drawing packages, bill of materials structures, material and finish specifications, critical characteristics, and acceptance criteria.

  • Design Loop Integration: Collaborate directly with mechanical design engineers early in the design phase to optimize composite layups, bonded joints, tooling interfaces, and tolerance stack-ups while design changes are still fast and low cost.

  • Transfer Gate & Release Authority: Serve as the final authority on product release packages, evaluating transfer readiness against gate standards before handing hardware over to manufacturing operations.

  • Disposition & Configuration Management: Manage engineering change orders and serve as the single technical contact for drawing dispositions, non-conformance reviews, and design clarification requests from the production line.

  • Supplier & Manufacturing Alignment: Work closely with production operations and external suppliers to evaluate manufacturing constraints for composite structures and precision assemblies.

  • Feedback & Continuous Improvement: Analyze initial production build data and floor feedback to refine manufacturing dossiers and update gate standards for future design iterations.

What We Are Looking For

  • Background: B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline.

  • Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerance Analysis: Practical mastery of applying GD&T with intent, performing tolerance stack-up analyses, and defining clear acceptance criteria.

  • Composite Structures & Manufacturing: Strong working knowledge of composite materials, layup sequences, tooling limitations, cure cycles, and bonded structural joints.

  • Drawing & Package Control: Proven experience owning released drawing packages, managing structured bill of materials, and running engineering change order workflows.

  • Early Stage Execution: Demonstrated success integrating manufacturing and assembly principles directly into active design reviews rather than conducting post-design audits.

  • Language Skills: Professional proficiency in both English and French to work fluidly across design engineering and French-speaking production teams.

What We Offer

  • Direct ownership in defining the release and manufacturing transfer standards for high-performance defense airframes.

  • Active collaboration with design engineers early in the development cycle where engineering decisions carry high leverage.

  • High-visibility technical impact across fast-scaling, hardware-centric production programs.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: Analytical Chemistry Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
jobs.description:
Analytical Chemistry Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytical Chemistry Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Switzerland.

Are you an analytical chemistry expert interested in contributing to the next generation of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology.


Accountabilities
  • Evaluate AI-generated scientific content: Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications.
  • Apply specialized analytical chemistry knowledge: Develop and evaluate scenarios involving spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical analysis, quantitative chemical analysis, environmental testing, pharmaceutical analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Assess advanced analytical techniques: Challenge AI models on mass spectrometry, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), gas chromatography (GC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) interpretation, trace analysis, titrimetric methods, and related instrumentation.
  • Identify and document model weaknesses: Record reproducible errors, reasoning gaps, inaccurate interpretations, and other failure patterns to support systematic improvements in model performance.

  • Raise the bar. Challenge yourself and team Tony's to increase our ambition and to accomplish our mission. Make mistakes along the way and learn from them. 

  • Believe wholeheartedly in Tony's mission. You live our core values: Outspoken, In it together, Makes you smile, Entrepreneurial and Raise the bar. 

 

Here are the hard facts: 

  • Starting on 1 February 2027, you'll be part of our Tony's team for 6 months. 

  • We are all about being more in person than apart; this means we offer flexibility but see each other in our Amsterdam office on average 3 days a week. More is fine!

Here's what you can expect from us: 

  • You'll be part of an enthusiastic team of driven colleagues who share your love for Tony's and our commitment. We're a fast-growing international company, and we believe in doing things differently.

Sounds like you? 

If you're ready to take the chocolate industry to new heights with us, we'd love to hear from you! 

Everybody is welcome to apply. From classics to limited editions, we know that different is what makes us great. At Tony's, we welcome everyone with equal enthusiasm, regardless of race, color, age, gender, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or veteran status. Crazy about chocolate, serious about people. 

A note on AI 🤖 - AI is great at many things. But capturing what makes you you? Not so much. So when you're applying, we'd love to hear your voice. The things that excite you, the way you think, and a glimpse of your personality help us understand who you are far better than a perfectly crafted AI answer.

jobs.title: Commercial Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
Commercial Legal Counsel

Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We are hiring a Commercial Legal Counsel to lead day-to-day commercial legal support as Tailscale continues to grow. You will partner closely with Sales, Partnerships, Finance, Security, Product, and Operations to help the company close business, manage risk, and build contracting practices that scale.

This role reports to the Head of Legal. The strongest candidate may be an experienced commercial counsel ready for broader ownership, a senior counsel who has led complex transactions and programs, or a commercial legal leader who can shape the function while remaining hands-on.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements, including enterprise customer, vendor, partner, marketplace, technology, data protection, and confidentiality agreements.
  • Advise Sales and other go-to-market teams on deal structure, contracting strategy, risk, and escalation paths.
  • Translate legal issues into clear options and recommendations that help teams make timely decisions.
  • Build and improve templates, playbooks, fallback positions, approval thresholds, intake processes, and self-service resources.
  • Partner with Security, Privacy, Product, and Engineering on customer commitments involving data, security, product functionality, integrations, artificial intelligence, and emerging technologies.
  • Work with Finance and Revenue Operations on pricing terms, revenue considerations, procurement, insurance, and other commercial matters.
  • Support international transactions and coordinate with outside counsel when local or specialized expertise is needed.
  • Identify patterns in negotiations and use data to improve cycle time, consistency, and the experience of customers and internal teams.
  • Contribute to other legal priorities as the company and legal function evolve.

What We Are Looking For

  • A law degree and active membership in at least one applicable bar or equivalent authorization to practice law.
  • Meaningful experience advising technology companies on commercial transactions, including in-house experience or equivalent experience working closely with technology clients.
  • Experience helping a legal function, contracting program, or business process scale in a startup or high-growth environment.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to distinguish material business risk from issues that can be addressed through practical guardrails.
  • A record of leading negotiations with sophisticated customers, partners, vendors, or counterparties.
  • Clear, concise communication and the ability to build trust across Legal, Sales, Finance, Security, Product, and executive teams.
  • Comfort working independently, prioritizing competing demands, and making progress with incomplete information.
  • A collaborative approach that creates appropriate ownership and avoids making Legal an unnecessary bottleneck.

Nice to Have

  • Commercial work involving developer tools, cloud infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, software as a service, or open-source products.
  • Experience with enterprise sales, product-led growth, channel or technology partnerships, marketplaces, integrations, or application programming interfaces.
  • Familiarity with privacy, data protection, security, artificial intelligence, intellectual property, or product counseling issues that arise in technology transactions.
  • Experience supporting global customers or coordinating advice across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Experience selecting or implementing contract lifecycle management tools, workflow automation, or commercial legal metrics.
  • Experience mentoring colleagues or helping define the structure and priorities of a growing commercial legal capability.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

CAN Pay Range

$250,580—$313,560 CAD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Admin & IAM
jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer, Admin & IAM

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Admin & Identity and Access Management (Admin & IAM) team at Mural defines how users sign in, manage their identities, and access Mural's products, as well as how administrators configure and govern their organizations. We own authentication & authorization, Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), user provisioning (SCIM), session management, and the core permission model that powers roles and access control across companies and workspaces. We also own the enterprise administration experience; the configuration and controls that company and workspace admins use to manage their organizations and users. By providing secure, clear, and intuitive controls for users and administrators, we help organizations adopt Mural quickly and collaborate with confidence.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Admin & IAM team, you will design and ship these capabilities end-to-end, from identity primitives like the permission model and authentication flows to the admin surfaces enterprise customers use every day. Senior Engineers on Admin & IAM own complex technical initiatives, influence platform and security best practices, and collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Infrastructure to deliver secure experiences that feel simple and intuitive. You will report to an Engineering Manager and work with a small, focused team in a remote-first environment, with the option to work from our Buenos Aires office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and evolve core identity and access systems that power authentication & authorization, SSO, user provisioning, session management, and permissions across Mural

  • Build and evolve the enterprise administration experience, including company and workspace configuration, user and content administration, billing, and internal admin tooling

  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners to design and ship secure, intuitive access and administration experiences for users and administrators

  • Prototype, implement, and maintain Admin & IAM platform features, contributing as a technical expert and supporting teammates through collaboration and mentorship

  • Own technical initiatives from design through implementation, rollout, and operational support

  • Build flexible, observable and maintainable solutions while being accountable for security, quality, performance, and reliability

  • Use AI tools as a part of your fundamental workflows to improve productivity, code quality, and system understanding

  • Contribute to technical design discussions, provide thoughtful code reviews, mentor teammates, and continuously improve the quality of the team's engineering work

  • Contribute to continuously improving the team's processes and engineering best practices

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 4+ years building and shipping large-scale production software as part of an agile engineering team

  • Experience learning new technologies, platforms, and stacks, and getting productive quickly in large, existing codebases

  • An outcome-oriented and pragmatic interest in using AI-driven development practices to improve productivity, code quality, and system understanding

  • Strong experience building backend systems and APIs using Node.js, TypeScript / JavaScript, MongoDB, or comparable technologies

  • Hands-on experience building production user interfaces with React and modern frontend patterns

  • Proven ability to plan and deliver technical projects iteratively, balancing speed, quality, and long-term maintainability

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across product, design, security, and engineering partners

  • Experience working in a fast-moving or growth-stage environment, adapting to evolving requirements and priorities

  • Domain experience with identity and access management concepts such as authentication flows, authorization models, roles and permissions, SSO, SCIM provisioning, or session management

  • Experience building enterprise administration or B2B SaaS configuration surfaces, such as org management, billing, or admin dashboards

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. .

Equal Opportunity

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

jobs.title: Territory Manager (Taranaki, Beef)
jobs.description:
Territory Manager (Taranaki, Beef)

About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role

Farmers with Halter are writing the playbook for a world-first farming system, they are paving a new way of managing their land and animals, and in doing so, are unlocking more productive and sustainable uses of the world's agricultural land along with driving optimal profitability outcomes.

We've recently launched into the Beef Market! This is an opportunity to build a new market from the bottom up. The Beef industry has not had a disruptive and influential product in years and this is your chance to make a huge impact.

As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will prioritise daily efforts that optimise growth performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and other regional sales teams, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of farmers. Your contributions will directly support Halter’s mission to support 50% of the world's habitable landmass to be more productive and sustainable. This role is based in the Taranaki/Whanganui region. Applicants must live within the region. Travel is required to meet with farmers daily.

Who are we looking for

  • Attitude: You naturally play for the front of the jersey. Make those around you better. Thrive under pressure and own your results. You bring authentic energy and passion to every interaction.

  • Sales & Customer Success Expertise: You will be a high-performing value-based salesperson, with a strong history of creating opportunities, closing deals, and building lasting customer relationships. You understand post-sales value building and have experience upselling to grow partnerships.

  • Beef Industry Experience: You know the ropes of beef operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. If you don’t, you will be deeply passionate about it, and willing to dive deep into the operations of a farm to learn rapidly.

  • Territory Management: Able to use critical thinking to manage a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, making the appropriate trade-offs.

  • Problem Solving & Collaboration: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

  • Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.

What your day could look like

  • Prospecting & Expansion: Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals, industry events, and other channels, as well as responding to inbound queries. You’ll manage the full sales pipeline from lead generation through to close.

  • Hitting Sales Targets: Manage your pipeline and meet high-growth sales targets by screening, qualifying, demonstrating the product, and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.

  • Customer Account Management: After the sale, maintain close relationships with customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

  • Territory Ownership: A high level of ownership in your territory working with regional agricultural groups to foster deep relationships across the beef industry.

  • Customer Onboarding: Assist in owning the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation.

  • Field Learnings & Feedback: Serve as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory. Work closely with Support, Product, and R&D teams to share insights from the field that can drive product improvements and innovations.

  • Collaborating with Support Teams: Partner with the Support Team to resolve any issues your customers encounter quickly. You’ll escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

Our Benefits

  • Healthy body, healthy mind. We’re partnered with Southern Cross Health Insurance to support your well-being.

  • We offer 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave and many other parental benefits that support you and your family.

  • Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual $1000 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.

  • Our time to recharge is valued, we’re offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.

  • Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

  • Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

  • You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

  • This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

Full-Time New Zealand

jobs.title: Director, Solutions Architecture EMEA
jobs.description:
Director, Solutions Architecture EMEA

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

As we continue to scale our business across EMEA, we are looking for an experienced Director, Solutions Architecture EMEA to lead our customer-facing Solutions Architecture organization across the region.

This is a leadership role responsible for building, developing and scaling a high-performing Solutions Architecture organization across multiple countries and markets. You will partner closely with EMEA Sales leadership, establish the operating model for the regional team, and ensure our Solutions Architects consistently deliver outstanding technical leadership and business value to customers. The scope of the role reflects where the business is today; as we scale, we expect the organization to specialize and subdivide, and this leader will help shape and staff that evolution.

We are looking for an experienced people leader who can build and empower strong teams while remaining close to customers, technology and our most strategic opportunities.

You’re welcome to work remotely from Europe.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Build, lead and coach a high-performing Solutions Architecture team across multiple countries and markets in EMEA
  • Own the Solutions Architecture engagement model for EMEA in close partnership with regional Sales leadership, including how coverage and ownership are divided as the team expands
  • Establish clear priorities, operating mechanisms and performance expectations across the regional Solutions Architecture organization
  • Develop and scale the organization as the business grows, including hiring, coaching and developing senior technical professionals and future leaders
  • Engage directly with CIOs, CTOs, Heads of Infrastructure, Heads of AI/ML, Business leaders and other senior stakeholders across strategic customers and partners
  • Champion the voice of EMEA customers internally and provide guidance for Nebius's Product and Technology roadmap

We expect you to have:

  • Proven people-management experience, including hiring, coaching and developing senior technical professionals and leaders
  • A strong track record of leading customer-facing technical teams across EMEA, with experience managing teams distributed across multiple countries and markets
  • Demonstrated experience building, scaling and operating regional Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, Customer Engineering or similar technical organizations
  • Strong player-coach mentality with the ability to operate effectively at both leadership and execution levels — from organizational strategy and talent development to direct engagement in strategic customer opportunities
  • Deep understanding of the EMEA technology market and the ability to operate effectively across different countries, cultures, customer segments and levels of market maturity
  • Ability to operate effectively across both the technical and business dimensions of complex customer engagements and influence C-level and senior stakeholders
  • Excellent executive communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-growing environment where team structures, coverage boundaries and scope of ownership will continue to evolve

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Strong understanding of cloud-native infrastructure, including compute, storage, networking, security and Kubernetes
  • Leadership experience within a public cloud, hyperscaler or rapidly scaling cloud infrastructure organization
  • Experience with GPU-based infrastructure workloads and accelerated computing
  • Experience designing or supporting machine learning and AI workloads, including training and inference
  • Understanding of distributed AI/ML infrastructure and the compute, networking and storage considerations associated with large-scale GPU workloads
  • Experience with Kubernetes-based AI/ML platforms, MLOps or AI infrastructure
  • Experience helping customers evaluate the economics of large-scale compute or GPU workloads #LI-PL1

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

(Senior) Paid Social Marketing Manager (w/m/x)

Über Patronus

Patronus entwickelt intelligente Notruf-Technologie, die Senior*innen mehr Sicherheit und Unabhängigkeit im Alltag gibt. Mehr als 25.000 Menschen verlassen sich bereits auf uns. Als Berliner Healthcare Start-up mit finanzstarken Investoren im Rücken wachsen wir schnell – und genau dieses Wachstum treibst du in deiner Rolle aktiv mit voran.

Als (Senior) Paid Social Marketing Manager (w/m/x) wirst du Teil unseres Marketing-Teams sein, das wir aktuell auf 6 Personen ausbauen und berichtest an unsere Head of Marketing. Diese Stelle entsteht durch den Aufbau einer dedizierten Paid-Social-Expertise mit stärkerem Fokus auf Creative Strategy, Testing und Skalierung. Was uns als Team ausmacht: Schnelle Umsetzung statt langer Freigabeschleifen, kurze Entscheidungswege und viel Raum, neue Ideen, Formate und AI-Tools auszuprobieren und direkt umzusetzen.

Deine Mission

  • Campaign & Funnel Optimization: Aufbau, Steuerung und kontinuierliche Optimierung von Kampagnen (Targeting, Bidding, Placements) sowie Testing von Creatives, Audiences und Landing Pages entlang des gesamten Funnels — mit klarem Fokus auf profitable Kundengewinnung und Lead-Qualität.

  • Performance Analytics: Analyse relevanter KPIs (z. B. CAC, Conversion Rate, CTR) und Ableitung datenbasierter Optimierungen entlang des gesamten Funnels

Dein Talent

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im eigenständigen Aufbau und der Skalierung profitabler Paid-Social-Kanäle – mit tiefgehender Expertise in Meta Ads und mindestens einem weiteren Kanal.

  • Starkes Full-Funnel- und Growth-Mindset: Du denkst ganzheitlich von Hook und Creative bis zur Conversion, bringst eigene Hypothesen ein und optimierst kontinuierlich.

  • Fundiertes Verständnis für Creative Strategy, Werbepsychologie, Tracking und Attribution (z. B. Pixel, CAPI, GA4).

  • Erfahrung im Einsatz von AI zur Beschleunigung von Creative Research, Variantenentwicklung und Marketing-Workflows.

  • Social-Media-native mit tiefem Verständnis für aktuelle Formate und Trends auf Meta, TikTok und YouTube

  • Erfahrung in einem dynamischen, wachstumsorientiertes Umfeld mit hoher Eigenverantwortung

  • Eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, mit der du Probleme eigenständig von der Identifikation bis zur Umsetzung durchdenkst

  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

⚖️ Fair von Anfang an: Du bekommst von uns direkt unser bestmögliches Angebot – wir gehen von Anfang an mit der Zahl rein, die woanders erst am Ende einer Verhandlung steht.

📚 Wachstum: 500€ jährliches Learning & Development-Budget, klarer Career Framework und 360°-Feedback für deine Weiterentwicklung
