🏖️ Urlaub: Bis zu 30 Tage Urlaub (nach Start mit 26 im 1. & 28 im 2. Jahr) 


🧘 Fitness & Freizeit: Bis zu 50% Rabatt auf Urban Sports Club, Corporate Benefits, Restaurant-Deals sowie Family & Friends Coupon auf die Patronus Uhr


🚲 Mobilität: 30% Rabatt aufs Job Ticket sowie vergünstigtes Fahrrad-Leasing


🥤 Verpflegung: Kostenfreie Softdrinks & Kaffeevollautomat, Müslibar, vierteljährliche Company Brunches sowie wöchentliche Healthy Snacks


💻 Hardware: Freie Wahl zwischen MacBook und Lenovo 


🌍 Impact: Ein Produkt mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Mehrwert plus ein Volunteering-Tag im Jahr

jobs.title: Capital Markets Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Capital Markets Manager (m/f/d)

𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗻𝘆

At NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift.

Many management companies (ManCos) excel at running traditional mutual funds, yet they struggle to enter the ETF market. Launching and operating ETFs adds a new layer of complexity: new partners, interfaces, processes, and systems that most existing setups weren’t built for.

NaroIQ gives ManCos a fast, reliable path into the ETF market. We provide the digital ETF infrastructure that reduces operational complexity, so our clients can launch and run ETFs at scale, helping broaden the access to the market beyond a small group of dominant, US-based providers.

𝘕𝘢𝘳𝘰𝘐𝘘 𝘪𝘴 𝘪𝘯𝘤𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘴𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘌𝘛𝘍 𝘎𝘋𝘗 𝘰𝘧 𝘌𝘶𝘳𝘰𝘱𝘦.

We are remote-first, with in-person collaboration opportunities. We work with international clients and have raised over $10m from top-tier investors and operators across finance and technology.

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗥𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲𝘀 𝗜𝘁 𝗦𝗽𝗲𝗰𝗶𝗮𝗹

You sit at the operational 𝘤𝘰𝘳𝘦 𝘰𝘧 𝘰𝘶𝘳 𝘌𝘛𝘍 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮. You will own end-to-end responsibility for the ETFs we run: smooth product launches, day-to-day execution and oversight, as well as continuous platform evolution in collaboration with our product team. This is a strongly hands-on role combining investment expertise, market microstructure understanding, operational excellence and cross-functional execution.

You will gain 𝘥𝘦𝘦𝘱 𝘦𝘹𝘱𝘰𝘴𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘵𝘰 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘧𝘶𝘭𝘭 𝘌𝘛𝘍 𝘷𝘢𝘭𝘶𝘦 𝘤𝘩𝘢𝘪𝘯, from investment implementation and market mechanics to operational and technology execution. You will have the opportunity to gradually expand your scope into platform building, process scaling, new strategic projects and service development.

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂’𝗹𝗹 𝗗𝗼

Capital Markets

  • Own end-to-end ETF delivery across capital markets, portfolio replication and platform operations

  • Implement and continuously improve replication models; execute index rebalances and support advisory mandates

  • Own ETF quality monitoring (tracking error/difference, liquidity/spreads, premiums/discounts, order books), run root-cause analyses and implement corrective actions

  • Manage creation/redemptions and associated cash flows; oversee daily ETF operations from a portfolio perspective

  • Support larger secondary market transactions, produce/interpret trade reporting and support ETF launches

Portfolio Management

  • Take investment ownership for assigned ETFs, actively optimizing portfolio construction, risk and execution to enhance tracking and liquidity

  • Execute portfolio replication and rebalancing

  • Run daily validation and reconciliation of key data outputs (pricing, holdings and reference data)

Clients and Ecosystem

  • Join client demos and workshops as our capital markets expert

  • Represent NaroIQ at industry events, roundtables and conferences together with our Growth team

  • Support our Growth and Clients teams on client-specific questions

Working with Product

  • Raise requirements from daily operations and give business sign-off on what Product delivers

  • Use and stress-test the AI-driven workflows we build for ETF operations, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗪𝗲'𝗿𝗲 𝗟𝗼𝗼𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗙𝗼𝗿

(𝘠𝘰𝘶 𝘥𝘰𝘯’𝘵 𝘯𝘦𝘦𝘥 𝘵𝘰 𝘬𝘯𝘰𝘸 𝘪𝘵 𝘢𝘭𝘭 – 𝘣𝘶𝘵 𝘺𝘰𝘶 𝘴𝘩𝘰𝘶𝘭𝘥 𝘣𝘦 𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘥𝘺 𝘵𝘰 𝘥𝘪𝘷𝘦 𝘪𝘯, 𝘭𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘯 𝘧𝘢𝘴𝘵 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘵𝘢𝘬𝘦 𝘪𝘯𝘪𝘵𝘪𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘷𝘦)

  • Experience in ETF operations, capital markets, trading, portfolio management, or fund operations

  • Strong understanding of ETF primary/secondary market mechanics

  • Hands-on experience running a portfolio management system, ideally to the point of owning its setup, data and daily use

  • Comfort with operational excellence: high ownership, detail orientation and reliability in a mission-critical operating environment

  • Experience working at the intersection of finance and tech

  • Analytical strength and ability to translate domain needs into clear product requirements

  • Comfortable being the external face of the function: with market makers, at industry events and in client demos

  • Fluent in English and German

  • CAIA/CFA is a plus

𝗪𝗵𝘆 𝗡𝗮𝗿𝗼𝗜𝗤

We’re building something ambitious – and we believe the only way to do that is with a team that’s 𝘭𝘰𝘸-𝘦𝘨𝘰, 𝘩𝘪𝘨𝘩-𝘪𝘮𝘱𝘢𝘤𝘵 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘨𝘦𝘯𝘶𝘪𝘯𝘦𝘭𝘺 𝘦𝘹𝘤𝘪𝘵𝘦𝘥 about what they’re doing.

🔑 𝗛𝗶𝗴𝗵 𝗢𝘄𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 We trust you to take full responsibility for your work. That means freedom – and also being the person others rely on when things get real.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Entwickler (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Embedded Software Entwickler (m/w/d)

Du möchtest nicht nur Software entwickeln, sondern direkt erleben, wie dein Code reale Systeme steuert und weiterentwickelt? 

Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für dich sein. 

Unser Kunde entwickelt und fertigt autonome Drohnensysteme, Einsatzsoftware und spezialisierte Lösungen für Industrie, Netzbetreiber, Behörden und maritime Anwendungen. Dabei entstehen hochspezialisierte Systeme, die Hardware, Software und autonome Technologien miteinander verbinden und bereits bei namhaften Kunden zum Einsatz kommen. 

Für die Weiterentwicklung der Drohnensysteme wird eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit gesucht, die Verantwortung für hardwarenahe Software übernimmt, bestehende Systeme weiterentwickelt und gemeinsam mit einem kleinen technischen Team neue Funktionen bis zum Flugtest bringt. 

Deine Benefits

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Ein leistungsgerechtes Fixgehalt, das deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation entspricht. 

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Hohe Eigenverantwortung bei der Weiterentwicklung zentraler Softwarekomponenten und technischen Strukturen. 

  • Entwicklungsperspektive: Perspektivisch besteht die Möglichkeit, fachliche Verantwortung für das Softwareteam zu übernehmen. 

  • Technologieumfeld: Arbeit an innovativen Drohnensystemen, Embedded Software und autonomen Technologien mit direktem Bezug zur Hardware. 

  • Praxisnähe: Kurze Wege von der Entwicklung zum Flugtest und die Möglichkeit, neue Funktionen direkt im realen System zu erproben. 

  • Flexibilität: Nach der Einarbeitung ist Homeoffice nach Absprache möglich, wobei die regelmäßige Arbeit an Hardware eine Präsenz vor Ort erforderlich macht. 

  • Arbeitsumfeld: Eigene Werkstatt und Testgelände sowie moderne Hard und Software für die Entwicklung und Erprobung. 

  • Unternehmenskultur: Kurze Entscheidungswege, direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und eine offene Du Kultur. 

  • Teamspirit: Regelmäßige gemeinsame Aktivitäten und Teamevents sorgen für ein persönliches und unkompliziertes Miteinander.  

  • Individuelle Benefits: Persönliche Wünsche und Vorschläge sind willkommen. Gemeinsam werden individuelle Benefits erarbeitet. 

Deine Aufgaben

Als Embedded Software Entwickler übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung der Flugsteuerungs- und Bedienersoftware unserer Drohnensysteme. 

  • Flight Control: Technische Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung der Flugsteuerungssoftware und deren zuverlässigen Betrieb auf der Zielhardware. 

  • Bodenkontrollsoftware: Weiterentwicklung einer modernen Bedienersoftware auf Basis von Qt und QML für Missionsplanung, Drohnenüberwachung und Nutzlaststeuerung. 

  • Codebasis: Einarbeitung in bestehende Softwarestrukturen, Dokumentation der Architektur sowie Aufbau sauberer Prozesse für Tests, Releases und Updates. 

  • Hardwareintegration: Anbindung und Integration von Sensoren, Funkmodulen, Kameras, Ladesystemen und weiteren Nutzlasten. 

  • Debugging: Analyse von Fluglogs, Auswertung technischer Daten und systematische Fehlersuche direkt auf der Zielhardware. 

  • Flugerprobung: Begleitung und Durchführung von Flugtests sowie technische Unterstützung bei Erprobungen und gelegentlichen Kundeneinsätzen. 

  • Technische Leitung: Fachliche Betreuung eines Auszubildenden und von Werkstudenten, Durchführung von Code Reviews und aktive Weitergabe von Wissen. 

  • Architektur: Mitarbeit an technischen Architekturentscheidungen in enger Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung. 

  • Zusammenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung mit Hardwareentwicklung, Konstruktion und Werkstatt, um Software und Gesamtsystem gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln. 

Dein Profil als Embedded Software Entwickler

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, davon überwiegend im Embedded Bereich oder in der hardwarenahen C und C++ Entwicklung. 

  • Sehr gute praktische Kenntnisse in modernem C++, Qt und QML. Sowie Linux und Git. 

  • Erfahrung darin, sich selbstständig in umfangreiche bestehende Codebasen einzuarbeiten und komplexe Softwarestrukturen schnell zu verstehen. 

  • Fundierte Erfahrung im hardwarenahen Debugging, insbesondere mit Sensoren, Schnittstellen wie UART, CAN, SPI oder I2C sowie der Analyse von Logs und Fehlerbildern auf Zielhardware. 

  • Strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise sowie die Bereitschaft, technische Lösungen und Wissen nachvollziehbar zu dokumentieren und weiterzugeben. 

  • Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Hardwareentwicklung und technischen Fachbereichen sowie Interesse daran, Software direkt am realen System zu testen. 

  • Bereitschaft zur regelmäßigen Arbeit vor Ort sowie zur Teilnahme an Flugtests und gelegentlichen Kundeneinsätzen. 

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse 

  • Nice to have 

    • Kenntnisse in ArduPilot oder PX4, MAVLink oder DroneCAN. 

    • Wissen in Regelungstechnik, Zustandsschätzung oder Navigation, beispielsweise mit EKF, GNSS oder RTK. 

    • Erfahrung mit Open Source Projekten und ein entsprechendes GitHub Profil. 

    • Erste Erfahrung als technischer Lead oder im Mentoring jüngerer Entwickler. 

    • Erfahrung mit Luftfahrt oder Verteidigungsprojekten sowie Kenntnisse relevanter Safety Standards. 

    • Praktische Drohnen Flugerfahrung oder EU Kompetenznachweis A1/A3 beziehungsweise A2. 

Klingt nach deiner nächsten Herausforderung? 

Wenn du Embedded Software nicht nur entwickeln, sondern direkt in innovativen Drohnensystemen zum Einsatz bringen möchtest und dabei echte technische Verantwortung übernehmen willst, freuen wir uns auf deinen Lebenslauf. 

In einem kurzen, unverbindlichen Telefonat geben wir dir anschließend alle weiteren Informationen zur Position und zum Unternehmen.

Trainee [*] Produktmanagement
Darauf kannst du dich freuen

⛱️ 30 Tage Urlaub  ⌛ Flexible Arbeitszeiten✨ Regelmäßiges Arbeiten aus dem HO✈️ Bis zu 4 Wochen im Jahr Work & Travel  ⭐ Events✔️ 20% Zuschuss zu bAV oder BU  ✔️ Jobrad  ✔️ Hansefit ✔️ Günstiges Deutschlandticket❤️ Wertschätzendes Miteinander  ⭐ Vielfalt & Offenheit


Vorabinformationen

Während des 12-monatigen Traineeprogramms bekommst du die Chance dich stetig neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, dein persönliches Netzwerk auszubauen und relevante Bereiche eines eCommerce-Unternehmens kennenzulernen (z.B. Produktmanagement, (Produkt-)Marketing, Vertrieb, HR, Logistik, Einzelhandel, etc.). Der Schwerpunkt deines Traineeships ist das Produktmanagement.

Deine Rotation in andere Fachbereiche passen wir genau auf deine Erfahrungswerte und Fähigkeiten an.

Nutze die Chance und entwickle dich zum fachlichen Experten oder optimiere im Anschluss an das Traineeship unsere Abläufe im Unternehmen.


Das ist deine Rolle in unserem Team

#Einkauf:
Du unterstützt bei der Abwicklung und Koordination von Einkaufs- und Beschaffungsaktivitäten. 
#Marktanalyse: 
Zahlen sind dein Ding! Du wirst lernen Kalkulationen oder Reports zu erstellen und die Konkurrenz sowie Preisentwicklungen stets im Auge zu behalten.
#Produktmanagement: 
Nach dem Traineeprogramm sollst du deinen ersten kleinen Bereich übernehmen, dabei wirst du zum Ansprechpartner für Kollegen aus anderen Fachabteilungen und arbeitest eng mit dem Produktmarketing bei der Steuerung von Produktkampagnen zusammen.
#Perspektiven:
Dich erwarten abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten, nutze die Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem Wachstumsunternehmen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Du bekommst von Tag 1 an einen Mentor an deine Seite gestellt, der dich auf deinem Weg begleitet.
#Team: 
Wir arbeiten auf allen Hierarchieebenen eng zusammen und sind vom Vorstand bis Azubi per ‚Du‘. Du kannst dich jederzeit auf dein Team verlassen. Dieses lernst du im digitalen Probearbeiten kennen.
#Weiterbildung: 
Vieles ist learning-on-the-job, aber wir schicken dich auch auf firmeneigene Fortbildungsprogramme.
#Steile Lernkurve:  
Du übernimmst schnell Verantwortung für Teilprojekte oder sogar kleine Hersteller. Wir geben dir die Tools an die Hand, sodass du nach einem Jahr eigenständig Produkte betreuen kannst. Und dein Einsatz bleibt nicht unbeachtet - wir sind stolz darauf, über 90% unserer Trainees in eine Festanstellung zu übernehmen.
#Arbeitsumfeld: 
Unser Arbeitskonzept sieht eine Mischung aus mobilem Arbeiten und Arbeiten aus dem Büro heraus vor. Je nach Einsatzbereich kann die Anzahl der Büroarbeitstage variieren. 


Was solltest du mitbringen?

#Background:
Du hast dein Studium abgeschlossen oder eine kaufmännische Ausbildung absolviert und möchtest nun ins Berufsleben starten. Vielleicht hast du sogar schon praktische Erfahrungen im eCommerce-Umfeld, Produktmanagement oder Marketing sammeln können?
#Leidenschaft: 
Technik lässt dein Herz höherschlagen - ein Expertenwissen rund um Elektronikprodukte musst du jedoch nicht mitbringen. Dank deiner sehr guten Auffassungsgabe findest du dich nämlich schnell in neue Produktbereiche ein und baust Fachwissen dazu auf.  
#Verhandlungsgeschick: 
Du bist aufgeschlossen und überzeugst deine Gesprächspartner mit deinem sicheren Auftreten und deinen sehr guten kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Dazu hast du noch ein Gespür für gute Deals und erreichst damit beste Einkaufspreise.
#Persönlichkeit:
Dich zeichnen eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Flexibilität und ein unternehmerisches Denken aus. Du arbeitest selbstständig und eigeninitiativ, bist aber auch ein echter Teamplayer.
#Was noch? 
Excel oder sogar Pivot sind für dich Tools, mit denen du schon gearbeitet hast. Dank deiner Englischkenntnisse könntest du auch in Terminen mit internationalen Lieferanten und Herstellern überzeugen.

Du findest dich nicht zu 100% in dieser Beschreibung wieder? Kein Problem - überzeuge uns, warum du dennoch der/die Richtige bist ;) 


Das wünscht sich dein Team:

"Teamarbeit steht im Vordergrund, man sollte sich immer auf das Team verlassen können."

– Christian

"Wer sich entwickeln will, der kann das hier bei uns, d.h. aber auch, dass man dies wollen und zeigen muss."

– Robert

"Mir ist es wichtig, dass man sich mit dem Job und NBB identifiziert und wir alle an einem Strang ziehen."

– Manuela

jobs.description:
(Senior) Finanzbuchhalter (m/w/d)
Ein erster Einblick:

Wir, die MIFCOM GmbH, bieten die besten Jobs in der Gaming-Branche. Als einer der führenden Hersteller persönlich konfigurierbarer PCs und Notebooks für Gamer und anspruchsvolle Nutzer sind wir immer auf der Suche nach neuen Talenten, mit einem Faible für Technik, die gemeinsam mit uns ihren nächsten Karriereschritt machen wollen.

Mit über 180 engagierten Mitarbeitern fertigen wir an 2 Standorten PCs, Workstations und Server nach Kundenwunsch. Egal ob Business-Laptop oder High-End Gaming PC, wir setzen alles daran die Vorstellungen unserer Kunden umzusetzen – „Geht nicht, gibt’s nicht!“

Dabei sind ein Höchstmaß an Flexibilität, bedingungslose Kundenorientierung und eine ausgesprochene Hands-On Mentalität die Grundpfeiler unserer täglichen Arbeit. Vielfach von der Fachpresse ausgezeichnet und mit besten Kundenbewertungen sind wir der führende PC-Systembuilder in Deutschland.

Wir sind aktuell auf der Suche nach einem (Senior) Finanzbuchhalter (m/w/d), der unsere Finanzabteilung mit fundierter Expertise im Hauptbuch und in sämtlichen Umsatzsteuerthemen verstärkt.


Deine Aufgaben:

Als (Senior) Finanzbuchhalter (m/w/d) bist Du Teil unserer Finanzabteilung und arbeitest eng mit Deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen sowie unserem CFO zusammen. Als erfahrener Profi in Sachen Finanzbuchhaltung übernimmst Du Verantwortung für zentrale Themen in unserem Team – mit einem klaren Fokus auf das Hauptbuch und die Umsatzsteuer.

Deine täglichen To-Dos umfassen vor allem die folgenden Tätigkeiten:

  • Du betreust das Hauptbuch inklusive der Abstimmung sämtlicher Sachkonten und der Anlagenbuchhaltung
  • Du bereitest die Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB vor und erstellst und verbuchst Rückstellungen und Abgrenzungen
  • Du behältst die Liquiditätssteuerung des Unternehmens im Auge gemeinsam mit unserem CFO und der Teamleitung Finance, das betrifft Zahlläufe, Cash-Prognosen und ggf. auch Bankenkommunikation
  • Du erstellst die Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen, zusammenfassende Meldungen und die Umsatzsteuerjahreserklärung in Abstimmung mit unserer Steuerkanzlei und stimmst diese ab
  • Du prüfst und beurteilst umsatzsteuerliche Sachverhalte, z.B. innergemeinschaftliche Lieferungen, Ausfuhren, Reihengeschäfte sowie Fernverkäufe über das OSS-Verfahren
  • Du begleitest die Umsetzung der E-Rechnungspflicht und stellst die umsatzsteuerliche Compliance in unseren Prozessen und Systemen sicher
  • Du bist Ansprechpartner für Steuerberater, Wirtschaftsprüfer und Finanzbehörden, u.a. bei Umsatzsteuer-Sonderprüfungen und Betriebsprüfungen
  • Du unterstützt bei Engpässen unsere Kreditoren-/Debitorenbuchhaltung und übernimmst die laufenden Buchungen im Tagesgeschäft
  • Du erstellst Reportings und Statistiken für Deine Stakeholder im Management
  • Zusätzlich treibst Du die Einführung neuer und die Verbesserung unserer aktuellen Prozesse aktiv voran bspw. die Einbindung von KI-Tools in die Finanzbuchhaltung


Dein Profil:

Bei MIFCOM hören wir nie auf zu lernen und uns weiterzuentwickeln. Wir glauben daran, dass eine perfekte Mischung aus technischem Fachwissen und Soft-Skills einen guten Kandidaten auszeichnen. Unser Anforderungsprofil ist eine erste Richtlinie, aber wir sind immer auf der Suche nach neuen Mitarbeitern, die ihre eigene Perspektive und den Willen, etwas zu bewegen mitbringen.

Als unser idealer Kandidat bringst Du folgende Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen mit:

  • Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Steuerfachangestellten / Steuerfachgehilfen (m/w/d) oder eine Qualifikation zum Finanzbuchhalter (m/w/d) – idealerweise hast Du zusätzlich die Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter (m/w/d) abgeschlossen
  • Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung, bestenfalls hast Du einen Teil davon in einer Steuerkanzlei gesammelt
  • Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in der Hauptbuchhaltung sowie in der Vorbereitung von Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen mit
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse im Umsatzsteuerrecht – nationale wie grenzüberschreitende Sachverhalte sind für Dich kein Neuland
  • Du bist versiert im Umgang mit Tools wie Datev und Excel und KI-Tools wie Claude
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und sorgfältig, gehst Dinge proaktiv an und bringst Dich aktiv in die Verbesserung und Einführung von Prozessen ein
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab


Warum MIFCOM?

Performance steht bei allem, was wir tun, im Mittelpunkt. Unsere Produkte erfüllen die höchsten Anforderungen unserer Kunden; der Name MIFCOM steht für Zuverlässigkeit, Präzision und ein Maximum an Leistung.

Bei uns erwartet Dich ein spannendes und dynamisches Umfeld mit einer Vielfalt an verschiedenen Aufgaben und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten, sowie ein umfassendes Benefits Paket, das Dir unter anderem folgendes bietet:

  • Ein spannender, anspruchsvoller und abwechslungsreicher Job in einem engagierten Team mit einer "Du"-Kultur und familiärer Atmosphäre
  • Ein unbefristeter Vertrag mit attraktiver Vergütung, sowie flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und all das beim führenden PC-Systemintegrator
  • Eine Home-Office-Möglichkeit und individuelle Gestaltung des Arbeitsplatzes sowie technischer Ausstattung (PC, Monitore, Peripherie, etc.)
  • Viel Freiraum und Möglichkeiten, Deine Ideen einzubringen und umzusetzen
  • Individuelle Weiterbildungen, je nach persönlichen Interessen & Schwerpunkten samt zahlreichen Entwicklungs- und Aufstiegschancen
  • Arbeit mit neuester Computerhardware und neuesten Technologien - mache Dein Hobby zum Beruf
  • Kostenfreier Kaffee & Getränke sowie fußläufig gut erreichbare Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Foodtrucks und Restaurants
  • Nach der Probezeit: z.B. betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Jobrad, attraktive Mitarbeiterkonditionen, uvm.
  • Sonstige Benefits, wie z.B. 30 Tage Urlaub, Fitness-Abo (EGYM Wellpass), Corporate Benefits, etc.
  • Eine große Dachterrasse für ein gemütliches Miteinander, Firmenevents, regelmäßige Grillpartys, Tischtennis, uvm.
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
Du hast es bis hierher geschafft, was nur eines bedeuten kann – Du bist zu 100% bereit, den nächsten Schritt zu machen, um Teil unseres fantastischen Teams zu werden.

Wir bei MIFCOM leben unsere Core Values jeden Tag. Wir lieben, was wir tun, und das spiegelt sich auch in unserem Handeln, Mindset und dem Umgang mit Kollegen und Kunden wider.

Wir sind stolz darauf, was wir bisher erreicht haben und freuen uns auf Dich als neuestes Mitglied unseres fantastischen Teams.

Deine zukünftige Rolle

Als Commercial Finance Controller (m/w/d) steuerst du unsere wachstumsstarken Bereiche Membership und Consumer Finance und schaffst Transparenz über Wachstum, Profitabilität, Cash-Bedarf und zentrale Werttreiber.
Als Sparringspartner für Management und Fachbereiche entwickelst du die Geschäftsmodelle mit fundierten Analysen, Business Cases und klaren Empfehlungen weiter.
Das erwartet Dich:

  • Business Partnering: Kaufmännische Begleitung der Geschäftsbereiche Membership und Consumer Finance sowie Beratung des Managements in allen steuerungsrelevanten Fragestellungen.
  • Planung & Forecasting: Verantwortung für Budget, Forecast und Mehrjahresplanung einschließlich P&L-, Bilanz- und Cash-Planung sowie Analyse und Kommentierung wesentlicher Abweichungen.
  • KPI- & Performance-Steuerung: Weiterentwicklung der finanziellen und operativen Steuerung mit Fokus auf Wachstum, Umsatz, Marge, Profitabilität und Cash-Bedarf.
  • Membership Controlling: Analyse der wesentlichen Werttreiber wie Neukunden, Pricing, Customer Acquisition Costs, Retention, Reparatur-/Produktkosten und Partnerprovisionen.
  • Consumer Finance Controlling: Steuerung von Finanzierungsvolumen, Receivables, Unit Economics, Contribution Margin, Ergebnisentwicklung sowie Funding- und Cash-Bedarf.
  • Business Cases & Analysen: Erstellung von Business Cases, Szenario- und Sensitivitätsanalysen für neue Produkte, Kooperationen, Vertriebskanäle und Wachstumsinitiativen.
  • Management Reporting: Erstellung adressatengerechter Management- und Board-Reportings sowie Ableitung konkreter Handlungsempfehlungen aus KPIs, Abweichungen, Chancen und Risiken.


Dein Profil

  • Sehr gutes Verständnis von P&L, Cashflow, Business Cases sowie operativen und finanziellen Werttreibern
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse von MS365 (insbesondere Excel & Powerpoint) sowie Erfahrung mit gängigen ERP- und Reporting-Systemen (Lucanet von Vorteil)
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau und Englisch auf C1-Niveau
Zudem zeichnet Dich folgendes aus: 
  • Ausgeprägte analytisch-konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten und strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise
  • Starkes Business-Partner-Mindset mit ausgeprägtem kommerziellem und unternehmerischen Verständnis
  • Kommunikationsstärke und souveränes Auftreten gegenüber Management und Fachbereichen
  • Hoher Qualitätsanspruch sowie pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise


Über uns

HomeServe wurde vor mehr als 30 Jahren in Großbritannien gegründet und ist heute einer der weltweit führenden Dienstleister im Bereich Sanitär, Heizung und Klima (SHK) und Elektro mit einem Umsatz von ca. 100 Millionen Euro.  Als deutschlandweite Handwerksgruppe mit regional starken und eigenständigen Betrieben sind wir stolz darauf, technisch die Nase vorn zu haben. jobs.title: Associate Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Associate Sales Engineer

InfluxData is the creator of InfluxDB, the leading time series platform used to collect, store, and analyze all time series data at any scale. Developers can query and analyze their time-stamped data in real-time to discover, interpret, and share new insights to gain a competitive edge. InfluxData is a remote-first company with a globally distributed workforce. For more information, visit www.influxdata.com.

Are you fascinated by the Internet of Things (IoT), real-time analytics, and the systems that keep factories, vehicles, energy grids and software infrastructure running? Are you a recent graduate who loves to code, learns fast, and wants to work at the intersection of engineering and customers? InfluxData is looking for an Associate Sales Engineer to join our EMEA team — someone with a love of technology and a passion for helping customers discover what's possible.

This is an early-career role. We don't expect you to have done this job before. We will teach you the craft of sales engineering; you bring the technical curiosity, the coding ability, and the appetite.

This is a remote position based in the UK. Unlike our senior Sales Engineers, this role does not require regular customer site visits. You will work with customers remotely and alongside senior Sales Engineers, often building solutions on a customer's behalf — with occasional travel for team meetings, conferences and meetups.

What you'll be doing

  • Develop deep, hands-on expertise in InfluxDB and the wider InfluxData platform — including our APIs, client libraries, and integrations with tools like Telegraf, Grafana, MQTT and industrial protocols

  • Partner with senior Sales Engineers on active opportunities: building demos, proof-of-concept environments, sample integrations and scripts on behalf of prospects and customers

  • Provide responsive technical coverage across the sales team — answering product questions, running standard demos, and unblocking opportunities so senior SEs can focus on complex deals

  • Contribute to formal RFx responses and informal prospect Q&A/workshop sessions

  • Be an advocate for prospects and customers with our Engineering, Product and Support teams — relaying what you hear on the front line

  • Write content for blogs, community forums and sample-code repositories

  • Learn the mechanics of enterprise software sales (discovery, qualification, MEDDIC) from an experienced team

What we're looking for

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics or a related discipline — or equivalent demonstrable technical ability.

  • Comfortable writing code in at least one of Python, Go, JavaScript/Node.js or Java — enough to build working examples, integrations and small tools. Show us something you've built: side projects, hackathon entries, open-source contributions or coursework you're proud of all count. If you have supporting material, please submit that as part of your application.

  • Familiarity with Linux fundamentals and the command line

  • Some exposure to working with data — SQL, NoSQL, CSVs and scripts, or data coursework

  • Excellent communication skills: you can explain a technical concept simply, to a technical or non-technical audience, in writing and in person

  • Curiosity about how businesses and physical operations work — one week you might be learning about battery telemetry, the next about network monitoring

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias for figuring things out: the best people in this role treat "I don't know yet" as the start of the fun

  • Fluent written and spoken English

Bonus points if you have

  • Tinkered with hardware, sensors or microcontrollers — Raspberry Pi, Arduino, home automation, robotics, vehicles

  • Any exposure to IoT or industrial technologies: MQTT, OPC-UA, SCADA, PLCs, telemetry

  • Used monitoring or observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus or InfluxDB itself

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes or a cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Built anything with LLMs or AI developer tools

  • Spoken/written fluency in other European languages

  • If you’ve recently graduated, an internship or placement year is viewed very favourably

How you'll grow

You will be paired with senior Sales Engineers who will mentor you on both the technical and commercial sides of the role. Expect a structured ramp: product training and certification first, then shadowing live deals, then owning your own technical engagements. The path from Associate SE leads to Sales Engineer and beyond — into senior pre-sales, solutions architecture, product or engineering, depending on where your strengths take you.

Interview Information:

Our interview process begins remotely. Interviews are typically conducted via Zoom. To ensure every candidate can participate, please let us know if you are unable to access Zoom. Some roles may require an in-person meeting with a team member as part of the final stage.

Our Core Values

Our employees are the heart of the company and only by having a core set of beliefs and values will we be successful. We hire and live by these core values:

  • We value each other

  • We get stuff done

  • We believe humility drives learning

  • We embrace failure

  • We are committed to open source

Visit our careers page to learn more about working at InfluxData.

You can request reasonable accommodations by reaching out to the recruiting team by emailing InfluxData does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters and recruitment agencies through our website, job board or directly to employees. InfluxData will not pay fees to any third-party agency, headhunter or company that does not have a signed agreement for this position in place.

Lead of Partnerships & Operations

Who we are

Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.

Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.

For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.

Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.

We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.

Today, Lemrock is already:

  • 100M+ conversations per month

  • 150+ brand clients

  • a $100B market structuring at high speed

The role

The product works, clients renew, and the partners we work with are what make it scale. As our Lead of Partnerships & Operations, you take ownership of those partnerships, make them perform, and run the operations behind them: contracts, launches, numbers, processes.

You work directly with the founders. Your scope starts with partnerships and operations, and it grows with what you show you can carry.

Strategic partnerships

  • Identify, negotiate and close the partnerships that change our trajectory: technology platforms, payment and distribution partners, AI players

  • Own the terms: revenue share, minimum guarantees, integration scope, timelines

  • Run each partnership after signature: launch plan, regular business reviews, next step always dated

  • Follow each partner's numbers closely, know why they moved before anyone asks, and decide with the team what to scale and what to stop

Operations

  • Run partner and advertiser launches end to end with Product and Tech: requirements, go-live, follow-up

jobs.title: Product Designer - Paris
jobs.description:
Product Designer - Paris

As a Product Designer, you'll work on the H Platform, where our users create and run agentic AI workflows powered by our models. Nobody has written the playbook for designing these experiences yet. Our next stage is making the platform truly useful for its users and levelling it up, in design as much as in technology, and you'll build the product experiences that deliver real value in organisations.

At H Company, we believe AI should take action in the real world, and our mission is to make agentic AI genuinely useful for large organisations. We're pioneers in computer use: our own vision-language models power agents that see, click and type their way through the software businesses already run, with no integrations or rebuilds, and we own the whole stack, from research and models to the products built on top of them.

What you'll be doing

  • Talking to our users constantly to understand their needs and figure out what will make the platform truly useful for them.

  • Turning those insights into research and explorations, looking at problems from different angles before settling on a direction.

  • Picking the right tool for each task: a Figma design, a prototype, or a small PR when a quick change is the fastest way to ship.

  • Testing what you build with users, measuring its impact (A/B testing, user interviews, users daily use data...) and iterating quickly based on what you learn.

  • Shaping the roadmap together with the whole team, engineers and PMs alike.

Who you'll work with

The role sits in our Product team, which is responsible for product direction, strategy and design. You'll join the product designer who owns design and UX today, and work closely with product, engineering and forward deployed engineers.

What we think it takes

Above all, we want someone who cares deeply about users, has great product taste and can explain it, moves fast while keeping quality high, leaves their ego at the door and welcomes feedback.

Likely a good fit if you

  • Have 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer at tech companies.

  • Have excellent UX, UI and interaction design skills, and can make complex, technical flows, like building and running AI agent workflows, feel simple and intuitive.

  • Have a portfolio that shows your latest work.

  • Have hands-on experience running user tests and A/B tests.

  • Know when a proven solution is good enough and when a problem deserves something new.

  • Have designed complex data or ML/AI-driven products: you know how to make complex systems understandable and how to design for AI behaviour that isn't always predictable, building trust and keeping users in control.

  • Are comfortable in technical discussions: you can dig into constraints and trade-offs with engineers and ramp up quickly on technical topics to discuss them with our researchers and more technical engineers.

  • Are fluent in Figma.

  • Can work within a design system and contribute to it.

Stronger still if you

  • Have designed platforms: complex B2B web or desktop software used by professionals, whether that's tools to build and run workflows, big data and analytics software, operational dashboards or other data-dense interfaces.

  • Are curious about code and AI in your design workflow. Every design team is still figuring out how AI changes the way we work, and we're no different, so we'd love someone who has started experimenting, whether by prototyping in code, building small tools or bringing AI into their process, and who wants to keep exploring with us.

If you match most of this but not every point, apply anyway. We care far more about how you think, your curiosity and your care for users than a perfect match.

How we hire

Four stages: a 30-minute call with our Talent team, a 60-minute portfolio review, a 60-minute design interview in person at our Paris office, and a closing 30-minute conversation.

The portfolio review and design interview are built around your own work and how you design. Please apply with your CV and a link to your portfolio showing your latest work.

jobs.title: Characterization Lead
jobs.description:
Characterization Lead

At Kandou, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

As Characterization Lead, you will own performance characterization of Zinal retimer silicon and the Randa Active Electrical Cable (AEC) channel. This is a Principal / Senior Staff individual contributor role with hands-on technical leadership. Your measurements will establish datasheet limits, channel classes and guard-bands for validation, manufacturing and customer specifications. Based primarily in Lausanne, you will work with silicon, signal integrity and validation teams, including channel characterization partners in Taiwan.

Responsabilities

· Lead silicon and channel characterization from measurement planning and bench setup through analysis, limit derivation and documented hand-off to validation.

· Characterize TX/RX SerDes performance across process, voltage and temperature: swing, jitter, sensitivity, equalization, adaptation, CDR lock, BER bathtubs and shmoos.

· Own channel measurements to at least 50 GHz, including de-embedding, insertion/return loss, mixed-mode S-parameters and common-mode and mode-conversion behavior.

· Establish reference-paddle baselines and channel classes by gauge, reach and frequency; correlate HTDR-derived metrics with calibrated VNA measurements.

· Derive datasheet limits and guard-bands from measured distributions, accounting for uncertainty, sample coverage and aging; maintain traceable datasets and limit revisions.

· Assess carrier-loading and forwarded-clock tradeoffs using measured channel data and simulation, and translate the findings into supported configurations and characterization limits.

· Characterize power, energy per bit and thermal behavior across operating modes and corners; investigate equalizer noise amplification and channel/thermal interactions.

· Coordinate shared laboratory equipment and characterization milestones with validation teams; lead technical reviews and deliver limits in time for downstream qualification and screening.

Essential Experience

· 10 to 14 years of experience in SerDes/silicon characterization and/or high-speed channel and signal integrity characterization following degree completion.

· Direct ownership of a characterization program whose results became datasheet limits or qualification thresholds for a shipping product.

· Strong VNA measurement experience to 50 GHz or beyond, including de-embedding, mixed-mode S-parameters (Sdd/Scc/Scd/Sdc) and insertion/return-loss mask interpretation.

· Hands-on TX/RX SerDes characterization, jitter decomposition, BER bathtubs, PVT shmoos and equalization/adaptation analysis.

· Demonstrated common-mode and mode-conversion measurement depth, with the ability to distinguish channel behavior from fixture and calibration artifacts.

· Statistical characterization and guard-band derivation across corners, with clear treatment of measurement uncertainty, sample size and aging.

· Experience with VNAs, oscilloscopes of at least 50 GHz bandwidth, BERTs, jitter instrumentation, thermal forcing and ATE characterization load boards.

· BS in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with the technical communication and coordination skills to hand off defensible limits to validation and manufacturing teams.

Essential Experience

· Characterization leadership for shipping 100G/lane or 200G/lane retimers, PHYs, AECs or AOCs.

· Deep mixed-mode characterization where common-mode behavior affects information transport and link margin.

· Experience producing datasheet limits that a separate validation team independently qualified.

· Multi-carrier or proprietary coding schemes, including OFDM-style subcarriers and space-time coding, and their characterization implications.

· Published work or patents in channel modeling, de-embedding or SerDes characterization.

· MS or PhD with a concentration in communications, RF/microwave engineering or signal integrity.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Technical Program Manager

Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things, so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition.

Now, we’re entering our next chapter, defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm.

About the Role

As a Technical Program Manager at Able, you'll drive the execution of AI and software programs across engineering, product, and partner teams. You'll keep work moving — owning timelines, dependencies, and communication for one or more programs — while working closely with senior TPMs and the hiring manager on the harder tradeoff calls. This is a technical role: you should be comfortable following a system design discussion, understanding the dependencies between services and teams, and asking the right questions when an estimate or integration doesn't line up. You don't need to architect the system yourself, but you do need to understand enough of how it's built to keep delivery on track and spot risk early.

You'll thrive here if you're organized, proactive, comfortable with ambiguity, and eager to grow your technical depth in a fast-moving, AI-native delivery environment.

What We’re Looking For

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

Program Execution

  • Drive one or more AI and software delivery programs through planning, execution, and launch.
  • Own program schedules, execution plans, and cross-functional alignment to ensure delivery commitments are met.
  • Maintain roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, and status; keep plans current as priorities shift.
  • Contribute to design and planning discussions — understand the technical scope well enough to track it accurately.

Engineering Coordination & Delivery

  • Coordinate work across backend, frontend, ML/AI, and data workstreams, keeping handoffs and interfaces clear.
  • Identify and escalate technical blockers, dependencies, and integration gaps before they slip the schedule.
  • Track and report program health using sprint progress, milestones, delivery metrics, risks, dependencies, and launch readiness indicators and keep them visible to the team.

Risk & Communication

  • Track risks and dependencies; flag issues early and help drive them to resolution with engineering leads.
  • Communicate clear, accurate program status to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Keep documentation, action items, and decisions organized and accessible.

Stakeholder Support

  • Support partner and stakeholder communication alongside senior TPMs.
  • Translate program plans into clear updates and help keep business goals and technical execution aligned.
  • Contribute to improving team rituals, documentation, and delivery processes.
  • Drive delivery while helping maintain a high technical bar across the team.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5 years in Technical Program Management, project coordination, or a related cross-functional role on software teams.
  • Able to engage in technical discussions, read architecture diagrams and tickets, ask clarifying questions, and identify execution risks.
  • Working familiarity with modern software development: APIs, cloud basics, version control, CI/CD, and Agile delivery.
  • Baseline understanding of AI/ML product concepts — LLMs, generative AI, and how AI features move from prototype toward production.
  • Track record keeping software programs organized and on track, ideally in startup or consulting environments.
  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve, ambiguity is common, and processes are still being developed.
  • Solid risk and dependency tracking; able to surface issues early and clearly.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong English verbal and written communication.
  • Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies and modern collaboration tools.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to AI systems — RAG, agentic workflows, vector databases, or prompt/eval workflows.
  • Experience supporting AI, ML, or data-driven product delivery.
  • Background in technical consulting or client-facing project work.
  • A technical foundation in software engineering, computer science, or a related field.
  • Experience with Jira, Linear, Notion, Asana, or similar tools.
  • Scrum Master or Agile certifications.

What Success Looks Like

  • Programs stay organized and on track, with clear status and dependencies always visible.
  • Blockers and risks are surfaced early and escalated to the right people.
  • Engineering and stakeholder communication is timely, accurate, and clear.
  • The TPM grows in technical depth and progressively takes on more program ownership.
  • Delivery processes and documentation improve through consistent, reliable execution.

Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement. As a team member, you can expect:

  • To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed.
  • Payments made in USD.
  • 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years.
  • Wellness + Remote Stipend
  • AI Voucher

About Able

Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth.

We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster.

Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you.

Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!

Who we're looking for.

jobs.title: Detection & Response Engineer
jobs.description:
Detection & Response Engineer

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Detection and Response

The Detection and Response team is responsible for detection engineering, threat intelligence, and incident response across Nebius Cloud. Its goal is to improve and maintain Nebius's security monitoring capabilities, as well as to build and maintain an end-to-end Security Incident Response program - people, processes, and tools.

The Role

We're hiring a Detection & Response Engineer to build and run our D&R capability from the ground up. You'll work on detection engineering, threat intelligence, and incident response functions across Nebius Cloud.

You'll be responsible for detection development, handling complex security incidents, forensics, and shaping the D&R strategy.

What you’ll do

  • Detection development: maintain low false-positive and false-negative rates. Work closely with alerts consumers (20+ teams) to keep noise low and signal high, ensuring they can act quickly without missing genuine threats.
  • Architect and operate detection coverage across our cloud and bare-metal environments
  • Build and extend our internal D&R tools and pipelines - onboard new logs, build and automate response runbooks.
  • Integrate threat intelligence into detection logic and IR playbooks, tracking adversary TTPs relevant to Cloud infrastructure
  • Lead incident response end-to-end: scoping, containment, root cause analysis, post-incident reviews and controlling critical action items are closed to prevent future possible incidents.
  • Partner with Compliance and Engineering teams to detect real threats while meeting the needs of both engineers and regulators.
  • Define and report on D&R metrics: MTTD, MTTR, detection coverage, false positive rates, etc.
  • Build and maintain Security Incident Response program: people, processes, tools.
  • Build tools, runbooks, and on-call processes that scale as the company grows.

What we look for

  • 6+ years in security operations, detection engineering, or incident response.
  • Deep hands-on experience with cloud-native environments (Kubernetes, Linux workloads, container-based infrastructure).
  • Strong detection engineering skills: writing and tuning rules/detections in SIEM platforms (e.g., Chronicle, Splunk, Elastic) and SQL.
  • Experience building or operating SOAR workflows and automating response at scale (ideally with Golang and Temporal).
  • Working knowledge of threat intelligence frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, Pyramid of Pain, Kill Chain) and how to operationalize them in detections.
  • Solid IR fundamentals: memory forensics, log analysis, network traffic analysis, and post-incident reporting.
  • Stakeholder management: able to coordinate across engineers, compliance, legal, executives during active incident phase. Serve as the primary owner and driver for complex changes, as a result of incidents post-mortem.

Nice to have

  • Experience with AI/ML and GPU clusters related threats.
  • Familiarity with eBPF-based detection or runtime security tooling (Falco, Tetragon).
  • Background in threat hunting.

Why this role at Nebius

  • Build D&R at a company scaling from startup to global infrastructure provider in real time.
  • Ability to evolve our internal D&R platform into a new cloud security product, delivering novel security observability for a range of neocloud customers - from big tech to AI startups.
  • Work alongside world-class engineers on infrastructure that powers frontier AI.
  • Competitive compensation with equity upside in a Nasdaq-listed, high-growth company.
  • Flexible, remote-first culture.

Hiring Process

  • Recruiter's chat (30mins)
  • Live-coding interview (60mins) to asses basic coding skills
  • Security interview (60mins) to asses domain expertise
  • Incident Response interview (90mins) to assess practical experience
  • Final interview to close the hiring process (45mins)

#LI-CP1

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. jobs.title: Compliance Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Compliance Engineer Intern

About the Company

Born from groundbreaking research at Columbia University and Yale University, CertiK is a leading Web3 security company focused on securing blockchain protocols, smart contracts, and decentralized applications through cutting-edge security research, formal verification, and AI-powered technology. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City, CertiK provides end-to-end security solutions including smart contract audits, penetration testing, on-chain monitoring, incident response, and compliance services for some of the largest projects in the digital asset ecosystem.

Today, CertiK supports thousands of enterprise clients and Web3 projects globally, with a distributed international team spanning North America, Asia, and Europe. The company is backed by leading investors including Coatue, Goldman Sachs, Insight Partners, and Sequoia Capital, and has been recognized by organizations such as the World Economic Forum and CB Insights for its contributions to blockchain security innovation.

About You
You are a detail-oriented self-starter with a strong interest in regulatory compliance, digital assets, and AI. You are comfortable researching unfamiliar regulatory topics, organizing complex information, and producing clear first drafts. You are eager to learn how licensing applications and compliance reviews work in practice and can support both structured audit requests and fast-changing client-facing needs.

About the Role
You will support the Engineering team in regulatory research, licensing analysis, AI output review, and client-deliverable preparation. You will work with client-facing teams, compliance reviewers, and Engineering to organize regulatory knowledge, prepare initial drafts, and convert recurring compliance work into reusable mappings, templates, and workflows. All material regulatory conclusions and client deliverables will be reviewed by an experienced compliance professional.

Responsibilities

  • Research and summarize regulatory frameworks and licensing requirements.
  • Support licensing and regulatory-readiness projects, including applicability research, gap analysis, evidence requests, policy review, and application-document preparation.
  • Organize regulatory requirements into structured modules, evidence categories, checklists, and mappings.
  • Review AI outputs for factual consistency, source traceability, missing information, and formatting issues.
  • Prepare initial drafts of compliance analyses, evidence guidance, client reports, pitch-deck content, and review materials.
  • Support the maintenance of regulation-to-service mappings, evidence checklists, and submission-material reuse mappings.
  • Organize customer-provided materials and identify potential evidence gaps for reviewer confirmation.
  • Record reviewer feedback and update templates, evaluation cases, and compliance knowledge assets.
  • Support coordination and request tracking across client-facing teams, compliance reviewers, and Engineering.
  • Escalate unclear regulatory interpretations and unsupported conclusions to experienced reviewers.

Requirements

  • Current enrollment in or recent graduation from a program in law, finance, accounting, risk management, public policy, business, computer science, or a related field.
  • Strong research, analytical, and structured-writing skills.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when reviewing regulatory sources, citations, and customer materials.
  • Ability to organize complex information into clear checklists, summaries, presentations, and reports.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.
  • Strong written and spoken English; professional Chinese proficiency is preferred but not required.
  • Interest in digital-asset regulation, financial compliance, licensing, or AI-assisted compliance workflows.
  • Familiarity with digital-asset regulation, VASP licensing, or similar regulatory frameworks is preferred.
  • Previous internship, coursework, or project experience in compliance, law, audit, fintech, digital assets, or regulatory research is preferred.
  • Basic understanding of LLM limitations, hallucination risk, source traceability, and human-in-the-loop review is preferred.

Compensation

Additional Information

This role must be performed outside the United States. We are unable to consider candidates who will work from within the U.S.

jobs.title: Senior Manager / Lead FP&AI (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Senior Manager / Lead FP&AI (m/w/d)

About ALVA Energie

At ALVA Energie, we’re driving the energy transition forward! With solar operator models for apartment buildings and commercial properties, we offer a comprehensive, worry-free package: from installation and management to the operation of PV systems as an energy supplier. Our goal is to make the decentralized energy transition simple and accessible. 🌞

As a growing startup in Berlin, we value teamwork, responsibility, and active participation. Everyone has the opportunity to actively contribute to our growth and share their ideas. Together, we’re working toward a sustainable future. 🚀

About your role

We think: impact over headcount! At our company, FP&A doesn't grow with the volume of work, but with its impact on the business. Data preparation, variance commentary and standard reports belong to automation and agents. Our people's time belongs to what machines can't do: judgment, model logic, challenge and decisions. If an additional hire enables significantly more impact, we grow. But never to absorb manual work that is better built than distributed.

You are the first dedicated hire in FP&A, start as an Individual Contributor and work directly with the CFO and management. Our existing models and tools have grown organically and are partly manual. You understand them, keep what works, rebuild the rest and automate consistently. With AI agents, you build the leverage that elsewhere would take an entire team.

Outlook: The path to Head of FP&A is open, but not planned for the short term. Your responsibility grows with the impact you create, not with team size.

Your responsibilities

As the Senior Manager / Lead FP&AI (m/w/d), you will drive financial planning, analysis, and artificial intelligence initiatives to support our growing operations.

  • Rebuild the FP&A foundation: current-state assessment, target architecture, budget, rolling forecast and multi-year planning

  • Build and maintain integrated, driver-based financial models (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) for projects, the portfolio and the group, including multi-entity planning and intercompany

  • Develop the KPI framework and prepare management, board, investor and bank reporting with clear recommendations for action

  • Run scenario and sensitivity analyses and conduct deep dives on investments, financing, pricing and portfolio prioritization

  • Build and operate agentic AI workflows for forecasting, anomaly detection, variance commentary and reporting, incl. guardrails and governance

  • Close collaboration with the Data Team: you bring the finance logic and are the most demanding user of the data

  • Evaluate and implement suitable FP&A tools and manage tool and AI costs (FinOps)

Preferred Qualifications

  • At least 5+ years of experience in FP&A, controlling or strategic finance, ideally in a high-growth, complex environment

  • Very good financial modeling skills (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) and understanding of complex financial and intercompany structures

  • Experience in rebuilding or redesigning planning and reporting processes, as well as with planning and BI tools

  • Hands-on mentality and enjoyment in building structures yourself

  • Strong communication skills: you convince management, investors, banks and business functions

Ideally you bring:

  • Energy sector experience, ideally solar/renewables, or other project-based business models

  • Multi-entity planning, intercompany and investor/bank reporting

  • Good German language skills

  • Experience with Claude or other AI coding tools and agentic workflows

In addition, we value the following skills:

  • Tech affinity: You see new tools and AI as leverage, not as a threat

  • Openness to change: You approach change positively and with agility

  • Impact mindset: For every analysis, you ask which decision it enables, and for every task: "Does a human need to do this, and where does it create the greatest impact?"

  • Entrepreneurial thinking: You always consider financial decisions in the context of growth, market opportunities and overall strategy

  • Drive to shape: You look at an organically grown Excel model and know what to keep, what to rebuild and what an agent can take over

  • You are motivated by the mission to advance the energy transition

Here’s what you can expect from us:

With your ideas, you’ll have the chance to enrich our dynamic team and actively help shape the future of solar energy at a rapidly growing startup!

  • A modern office in the heart of Berlin with excellent BVG transit connections (e.g., Nordbahnhof, Rosenthaler Platz)

  • A fully stocked kitchen with coffee, soft drinks, and snacks available around the clock

  • Regular team lunches and other team events

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Location AI
jobs.description:
Senior AI Engineer, Location AI

Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What you'll do

This role is scoped by skill rather than by product. The problems below span multiple departments and show up across our Search and Places data work, our Location and Navigation Intelligence work, and the Platform work that makes Mapbox usable by agents. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands.

At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area.

In this role, you will:

  • Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. Formulate hypotheses around the products we build and seek the signal needed to validate them. Define what a correct result is for a given input and state, determine whether to assemble datasets from real usage or hand-written cases, and gate changes on regression results.

  • Run continuous evaluation of the products we build, whether APIs, SDKs, data representations, or reference applications, from the position of the end user, whether developer, agent, or consumer. Assess the gaps such as misuse of parameters or integration anti-patterns, recommend the fixes, and make sure they land.

  • Own the MVP against an agreed north star technical design, and balance technical perfection against shipping useful increments.

  • Build data pipelines and the tooling around them: ingestion, conflation, entity resolution, quality checks, and the batch and streaming jobs that keep a large dataset current.

  • Track and pull external datasets, models, and benchmarks from published research and open-source releases. Evaluate what fits the problem and constraints , and decide when to adopt what exists versus build your own.

  • Design feedback loops so that using a product generates data that improves it. Instrument systems so failures arrive with enough context to reproduce, then turn the recurring ones into evaluation cases.

  • Design the boundary between a model and the tools it calls. Build or improve the model harness, decide what the model handles, what it delegates, and how to keep it working from the state it actually fetched.

  • Work to a latency and cost target per request: streaming, partial results, caching, model routing, prompt structure.

  • Build the internal harnesses and tools (CLI, MCP, and others) your team needs to iterate quickly, and share the parts that generalize with other teams.

  • Raise the bar on your team through code and design review, and bring other engineers up on eval practice.

  • Some of the technical questions in this area are still open. You will help answer them.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • Required Education/Certification:

    • Bachelors Degree in STEM discipline and 5+ years of software engineering experience, with production ownership of services, pipelines, or SDKs.

  • Technical Skills & Tools (Must-Haves):

    • 2+ years shipping LLM-backed features to real users, in systems that carried error budgets, on-call rotations, and customers who noticed regressions.

    • Data engineering depth: SQL, at least one distributed processing framework, and experience with pipelines where a wrong record mattered more than a slow one.

    • Fluency with tool calling and agent orchestration, including the failure modes: stale context, hallucinated arguments, silent partial success, unbounded loops.

    • Strong Python or TypeScript, and comfort reading code in whatever language the caller happens to be written in.

  • Core Competencies & Scope:

    • Direct experience or deep understanding of designing evaluations for non-deterministic systems. You can describe a dataset you built and the failure it caught.

    • Working knowledge of more than one agent harness, and opinions about where each of them is weak.

    • Experience diagnosing latency in a distributed request path.

    • Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to ship something narrow that works while the general solution is still unclear.

Nice to Have Traits for this Role

  • Geospatial data experience: routing, geocoding, POI or address data, OpenStreetMap, or conflation of overlapping sources.

  • Public API or SDK design experience, particularly for developers you never talk to.

  • Experience building against MCP or similar tool transports.

  • Experience running evals in CI, with a commercial harness or one you built.

  • Automotive, in-vehicle infotainment, CarPlay, or Android Auto experience.

  • Voice pipeline experience: streaming ASR, TTS, barge-in, endpointing, wake word.

  • Work under constrained compute, offline, or intermittent connectivity.

  • Experience operating a product through its first external integrations, where the customer finds the gaps before you do.

Employment Requirements

  • Employment Type: Full-time

  • Weekly Hours: 40 h per week

  • Location/Hybrid Policy: Remote (from any city in Germany)

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

 

How we support you

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.

  • Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth

  • Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

  • Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application.

We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Engineering Manager

About Stora

Stora is building the operating platform for modern self-storage businesses.

Our software helps operators manage bookings, payments, customers, facilities and day-to-day operations from one place, while automating much of the work that traditionally makes running a self-storage business unnecessarily complicated.

In just over five years, Stora has grown from an early-stage product into a platform used by more than 500 operators.

We’re a product-led, remote-first company with an experienced engineering team and ambitious plans for what comes next.

Now, as the engineering organisation grows, we’re hiring an Engineering Manager to make sure the way we lead, develop and support engineers grows with it.

The Role

This is a genuine people leadership role.

You’ll manage approximately 12 engineers working across three product teams, with the team expected to continue growing.

Each product team has a Tech Lead responsible for technical direction, alongside Product and Design. Your focus is different: the engineers themselves.

This isn’t a role for somebody looking to move away from engineering completely, though. You’ll need enough technical depth to understand the work, follow engineering discussions and ask good questions without needing to be the person making every technical decision.

You’ll work closely with our Head of Engineering and have support from People, but you’ll have meaningful autonomy to improve how engineering management works at Stora.

What Else You’ll Own

Engineering Management

  • Manage engineers across multiple product teams through regular, useful 1:1s, coaching and clear feedback.

  • Make expectations clear and help engineers understand what good performance looks like.

  • Identify performance issues early and handle difficult conversations properly when needed.

  • Support engineers in progressing from junior through senior and beyond.

  • Build strong relationships with engineers without creating unnecessary management overhead.

Performance & Progression

  • Own the engineering performance and progression approach.

  • Review and improve our existing career levels, expectations and review processes.

  • Make promotion and progression decisions that are consistent, evidence-based and understood by the team.

  • Create a culture where feedback happens throughout the year rather than being saved for formal reviews.

Hiring & Team Development

  • Own engineering hiring alongside the relevant Tech Leads and wider team.

  • Help define what we need before a search begins, assess candidates properly and maintain a high hiring bar.

  • Ensure new engineers have a structured and useful onboarding experience.

  • Think proactively about team composition, capability gaps and future hiring needs.

Team Health

  • Pay attention to engagement, retention, collaboration and emerging people issues across the engineering organisation.

  • Work with Tech Leads when team problems sit somewhere between technical delivery, behaviour and team dynamics.

  • Help maintain a strong remote engineering culture as Stora grows.

Technical Context

  • Stay close enough to the engineering work to understand what the team is solving and the environment they’re working within.

  • Be comfortable reading code, following pull requests and participating intelligently in technical conversations.

  • Partner with Tech Leads without competing with them for technical ownership.

What Success Looks Like

After your first year, we’d expect:

  • Engineers to have a clear understanding of what is expected of them and how they can progress.

  • Managers and engineers to be having better, more useful conversations about performance and development.

  • Performance issues to be addressed early rather than becoming surprises.

  • A progression framework that works for the engineering organisation Stora has become, not the company we were several years ago.

  • Stronger and more consistent hiring and onboarding.

  • The Head of Engineering spending less time acting as the default people manager for the entire engineering organisation.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager, rather than somebody taking their first step into management.

You’ll ideally have:

  • Previous experience directly managing software engineers across more than one team or product area.

  • A strong track record of developing engineers at different stages of their careers.

  • Hands-on experience managing performance, including difficult or underperformance situations.

  • Experience making promotion and progression decisions.

  • Experience running or improving engineering career frameworks, review cycles or progression processes.

  • Previous experience hiring software engineers and building effective interview processes.

  • An engineering background that allows you to understand code and contribute meaningfully to technical conversations.

  • The judgement to know when to get involved and when to leave technical decisions with the Tech Leads.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly in a remote environment.

  • A practical understanding of how AI tools are changing software engineering and experience using them in your own work.

Experience with Ruby or Rails would be useful, but it isn’t essential.

We’re much more interested in whether you can lead engineers well.

What This Role Isn’t

It’s worth being clear that this isn’t:

  • a Tech Lead role with some people management added on;

  • a delivery or project management position;

  • a Product Manager role;

  • a hands-on engineering role where you’ll spend most of your week writing production code;

  • a first Engineering Manager opportunity.

Technical leadership already exists within the product teams.

We’re hiring you because engineering management itself deserves dedicated ownership.

Our Technology

You won’t be expected to spend most of your time writing production code, but you should be comfortable working around our stack.

Backend: Rails, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, TimescaleDB

Frontend: Turbo, React, ViewComponents, Sass

Testing: Minitest, Playwright

Deployment: GitHub Actions, Heroku

Salary & Benefits

  • Salary: Highly competitive and depending on experience

  • Location: Fully remote within the UK or Ireland

  • Belfast office: Available for anyone who wants to use it

  • Private health insurance for you and your family

  • Company pension

  • 35 days’ annual leave inclusive of applicable public/statutory holidays, depending on location

  • Learning and development support

  • Share options

  • Work-from-home budget

Our Hiring Process

We’re reviewing applications as they arrive rather than waiting for a closing date.

If your experience looks like a strong match, we’ll explain the process clearly from the outset and move quickly.

Equal Opportunities at Stora

Stora is an equal opportunities employer.c

We want to build a workplace where people are treated fairly, with dignity and respect, and where different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are valued.

We welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religious belief or political opinion, or sexual orientation.

Recruitment and employment decisions are based on merit, competence and business need, and we promote equality of opportunity and fair participation in line with our responsibilities under Northern Ireland equality legislation.

If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

You will partner with senior executives to design AI roadmaps, collaborate with the Applied AI team to deliver production solutions, and ensure smooth transitions from pre-sales to post-sales.

The Applied AI for Critical and Sovereign Institutions team is Mistral's specialized unit dedicated to delivering high-impact, secure AI solutions for institutions operating in highly regulated and strategic environments, including on-premise, disconnected, and air-gapped deployments. In this role, you will drive adoption inside sovereign institutions and critical infrastructure across the UK, partnering with senior leaders and mission owners under real operational, security, and compliance constraints to deliver projects with significant societal, operational, and strategic impact.

  • Proactively identify expansion opportunities across use cases and units, building on initial successes to drive long-term partnerships.

You will play a pivotal role in shaping how enterprises adopt and deploy AI, ensuring Mistral’s solutions deliver measurable impact.
