jobs.title: AI Support Engineer Lead
jobs.description:
AI Support Engineer Lead

About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

 

At Dust, we're building for a new kind of AI Operator: people who rethink and rebuild how their teams work around AI. Not “how can AI help us do this faster?” but “if AI existed from day one, would we even do this the same way?”

 

As our AI Support Engineering Lead, you'll own how Support is built and scaled at Dust. This is a deeply hands-on role. You'll take on the hardest customer issues when our agents fall short, but your job isn't simply to resolve them. You'll look for the pattern behind each issue and turn what you learn into better agents, automation, tooling, documentation, and product improvements. Over time, you'll help grow the team and shape how Support Engineering operates as Dust scales.

 

You'll define, ship, and continuously iterate on the systems that make this possible: AI agents, automation workflows, classification systems, knowledge systems, and tooling built on top of Dust itself. You'll dogfood the product harder than almost anyone at the company and set the standard for how the rest of the Support Engineering team does the same.

 

We're looking for someone who wants to lead from the work: technically strong, obsessed with building better systems, and excited to shape both the team and the function as we grow.

 

What you'll do

 

Build the AI systems that do the work

  • Set the technical direction for the support stack: what gets automated, in what order, and to what standard. You make the calls, not just the builds.

  • Design, ship, and maintain AI agents and automation workflows that reduce manual support load: think ticket classification, acknowledgment automation, response drafting, incident detection, and proactive user outreach.

  • Identify recurring categories of issues and engineer them out of existence through automation, documentation, prompt iteration, or product feedback.

  • Build and maintain tooling (MCP integrations, Dust agents, internal scripts) that increase the team's capacity without increasing headcount.

  • Define and own the "Support as a Product" backlog. You decide what goes on it, coach the team to execute it, and hold the bar on what shipped means.

 

Run support when the systems fall short

  • Hire, onboard, and develop the support engineers around you. You're not just resolving tickets and building systems, you're growing the people who will.

  • Set the standard for how complex issues get handled at Dust. You take the hardest tickets yourself. The team knows what good looks like because they've watched you do it.

  • Investigate complex issues across logs, code, and internal tooling to identify root causes and provide clear answers to customers.

  • Handle escalated cases with precise, accessible communication for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Systematically analyze agent-generated responses for inconsistencies and iterate on prompts, documentation, and tooling until human intervention is minimal.

 

Bridge customer pain to product improvements

  • Represent support at the engineering and product level. You synthesize signal, prioritize it, and push it through with enough context that it actually moves things, not just relays it.

  • Build strong working relationships with engineers and customer-facing teams to ensure efficient, high-context escalations.

  • Own the feedback loop end-to-end: when agents fail due to missing or incorrect information, close the gap across engineering, product, and documentation.

 

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions: Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

 

Aptitude

  • Function-building experience: You've defined or significantly shaped a support engineering function before: built the operating model, set the standards, hired into the team, or rebuilt a broken process from scratch.

  • High technical aptitude: comfortable reading code, analyzing logs, navigating codebases, and troubleshooting distributed systems. You're not stopped by a stack trace.

  • AI fluency at builder level: track record of building custom agents, automations, or workflows using AI tools (Dust, Cursor, Claude Code, n8n, etc.); not just prompting.

  • Exceptional prioritization: You know what to solve immediately, what to automate, what to escalate, and, critically, what to delegate and to whom. You make these calls for yourself and for the team, fast and without second-guessing.

  • People leadership: You've coached and developed engineers and know how to set expectations, give direct feedback, and raise the performance of the people around you.

  • Bidirectional communication: can translate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and speak technical language fluently with engineers.

  • Build/Run mindset: You believe the best Support Engineering teams don't just resolve issues. They build systems that prevent those issues from recurring.

 

Attitude

  • Builder mentality: You instinctively automate repetitive work rather than accepting inefficient systems, and you hold your team to the same standard.

  • Resilience-empathy paradox: You can absorb customer frustration without taking it personally while still deeply caring about the user experience.

  • Leads by example: You're not above the queue. When something is hard, you take it.

  • Exceptional prioritization: You know what to solve immediately, what to automate, and what to escalate.

  • Thrives in ambiguity: You enjoy building systems from scratch in environments where many processes are still undefined.

  • Low ego, team player: You share knowledge freely and care about the success of the broader team.

 

Agency

  • High ownership: You define what needs to be done as often as you execute it. You don't wait for someone to tell you the function has a gap.

  • Systems-first thinking: You focus on eliminating categories of work, not simply resolving tickets faster. You hold yourself and the team accountable to that distinction.

  • Pattern recognition to repeatability: You turn recurring issues into scalable systems, automations, workflows, or documentation that eliminate future occurrences.

  • Deep investigation instincts: You investigate as far as possible before escalating, providing engineering teams with thoughtful, high-context information when collaboration is needed, and you coach the team to do the same.

 

Even if you don’t meet every requirement above, we still encourage you to apply. We care deeply about curiosity, potential, and determination, and we know exceptional people don’t always fit neatly into a checklist.

 

Benefits & Compensation

  • Competitive compensation based on level and experience

    • 100,000€ - 160,000€

  • Significant equity package at a Sequoia-backed startup

  • Health benefits for you and your dependents

  • New MacBook Pro or Linux machine, monitor, keyboard, etc.

  • Opportunity to travel between our Paris and San Francisco offices

  • Regular team events and off-sites

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
DevOps Engineer

Join our mission

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. jobs.title: Afstudeerstage IT
jobs.description:
Afstudeerstage IT

Bij BAS, Europa’s grootste dealer in commerciële voertuigen én officieel Volvo en Renault Trucks dealer, krijg jij de kans om je te ontwikkelen binnen IT in de automotive branche. Ben jij op zoek naar een afstudeerstage vanaf januari/ februari 2027? Dan is dit iets voor jou!

BAS World groeit hard, en IT speelt daarin een sleutelrol. Binnen ons IT-team liggen verschillende afstudeeropdrachten klaar die elk een echt vraagstuk uit ons IT-landschap aanpakken. Elke opdracht heeft een eigen team dat je dagelijks begeleidt. Zo breng je je kennis in de praktijk en kickstart je samen met ons jouw carrière.

Mogelijke afstudeeropdrachten

1. Continuous performance & load testing (Engineering)
BAS World wil het aantal voertuigadvertenties online ongeveer 20 keer zo groot maken. In deze opdracht zorg je dat onze websites en systemen die groei aankunnen. Je onderzoekt welke (AI-gedreven) testtools passen bij onze stack. Daarna bouw je samen met het IDP-team een testsuite die dagelijks automatisch draait in de pipeline. Het resultaat is een productieklare testopzet en een advies over knelpunten en capaciteit.
Past bij: Software Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure.

2. Kleine AI-agents voor de business (Data / AI engineering)
In deze opdracht werk je als interne consultant binnen één afdeling, bijvoorbeeld Logistiek. Je spreekt gebruikers, brengt hun processen en knelpunten in kaart en bepaalt waar AI het meeste oplevert. Daarna bouw je één of meer kleine AI-agents op basis van de services en data die we al hebben. Je test ze en verbetert ze tot ze echt gebruikt worden in het dagelijkse werk.
Past bij: AI, Data Science, Business IT, Software Engineering, als je graag dicht op eindgebruikers werkt.

3. Realtime monitoring & bottleneck-analyse voor Thinkwise-applicaties (Engineering)
Verschillende kernapplicaties draaien op het low-code platform Thinkwise. Als gebruikers traagheid melden, kost het nu weken om de oorzaak te vinden. In deze opdracht bouw je monitoring die de performance over de hele stack realtime inzichtelijk maakt: van UI en applicatielaag tot database en netwerk. Die performance komt live op een scherm op de werkvloer van onze developers. Daarnaast ontwikkel je rapportage- en analysetooling waarmee developers bottlenecks precies kunnen aanwijzen en oplossen waar ze ontstaan. Zo vinden we problemen in uren in plaats van weken.
Past bij: Software Engineering, Infrastructure, DevOps, met interesse in performance en observability.

4. Problem management & ITSM-procesoptimalisatie (System & Application Management)
Onze Servicedesk en het S&AM-team krijgen veel meldingen binnen in Jira. Terugkerende problemen worden nog te weinig bij de bron opgelost. In deze opdracht breng je de ITSM-processen in kaart en leg je ze vast: processtromen, werkinstructies en rollen. Je toetst ze aan good practices zoals ITIL. Daarna ontwerp en implementeer je problem management als een vast proces, zodat terugkerende issues structureel verdwijnen.
Past bij: Business IT & Management, IT Service Management of verwant.

5. Datagedreven leadgeneratie met FleetCareXL & BAS World (Product)
Via FleetCareXL weten we precies hoe voertuigen onderhouden worden en wat dat kost. De verkoophistorie van BAS World vertelt ons veel over restwaardes. In deze opdracht combineer je deze twee databronnen in een proof of concept. Die berekent het ideale vervangmoment: wanneer onderhoudskosten gaan stijgen terwijl de restwaarde nog hoog is. Dat levert kostenbesparing op voor klanten en leads voor in- en verkoop. De opdracht kan ook andersom worden ingevuld. Dan onderzoek je hoe we FleetGuide selfservice of fullservice actief kunnen aanbieden aan klanten van BAS World.
Past bij: Data Science, Business Analytics, Software Engineering, met commerciële interesse.

Kortom: veel verantwoordelijkheid, veel samenwerking en een opdracht met echte impact.

Wij bieden jou

  • Een stagevergoeding van €500,- bruto per maand voor een fulltime stage én reiskostenvergoeding;

  • Een inhoudelijke en uitdagende afstudeeropdracht met zichtbare impact;

  • Dagelijkse begeleiding vanuit het team dat jouw opdracht host;

  • De mogelijkheid om onderdeel uit te maken van ons gedreven en enthousiaste IT-team;

  • Bij goede prestaties uitzicht op een vaste functie binnen BAS. Bij BAS zeggen we namelijk niet voor niets: “Bij BAS heb je geen baan maar een carrière!”;

  • Een vaste kruk bij de VrijMiBo en jouw naam op de gastenlijst voor onze bedrijfsuitjes en feestjes.


  • Je volgt een HBO-opleiding richting Software Engineering, DevOps, Data Science, AI, Business IT & Management, IT Service Management of een gerelateerde opleiding;

  • Je vindt het leuk om systemen en processen te verbeteren en oplossingen te bouwen die echt gebruikt worden;

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig en hebt de drive om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen.

Wij zijn BAS!

We zijn actief sinds 1962. Sindsdien vestigden wij onze naam als een betrouwbare kracht in de Automotive. Als familiebedrijf zijn wij wereldwijd actief in kopen, onderhouden en verkopen van vrachtwagens, trekkers, trailers, bouwmachines, bedrijfswagens en landbouwmachines.

Al onze kennis en ervaring verwerkten we daarnaast in de ontwikkeling van basworld.com. Hier verbinden we kopers en verkopers met elkaar en helpen we hen om snel, gemakkelijk en veilig te handelen. Onze ambitie voor BAS kent geen grenzen. Rijd jij voorop om BAS naar het volgende niveau te brengen?

Samengevat: bij BAS gaan we altijd vol gas en is geen dag hetzelfde. Met meer dan 1.000 collega’s proberen wij onszelf iedere dag een stukje beter te maken voor onze klanten. Daarbij staan Brabantse nuchterheid, passie, teamwork en ondernemerschap voorop.

Kom ons team versterken als Maintenance Supervisor in Zaandam. In deze functie ben je verantwoordelijk voor het voorbereiden, bewaken en coördineren van dagelijkse correctieve en preventieve onderhoudswerkzaamheden.   • Aantoonbare ervaring in een leidinggevende maintenancefunctie,

Conversational Designer, APAC

Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the Role

As the Founding Conversational Designer for APAC, you will play a pivotal role in shaping how Cresta delivers conversational AI solutions across the region. You’ll lead the design and deployment of best-in-class AI conversation models that power real-time coaching and assistance for contact center agents, as well as virtual agents across voice and chat experiences.

This is a highly strategic, customer-facing role that combines conversational design expertise with strong project ownership and regional influence. As one of the first hires focused on Conversation Design in APAC, you will help establish delivery best practices, scale customer impact, and serve as a key partner in expanding Cresta’s presence across international markets.

You will manage complex AI delivery engagements from initial discovery through deployment and optimization, ensuring projects stay on track, stakeholders remain aligned, and outcomes drive measurable business value.

You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Machine Learning, Data Science, Engineering, Product, Project Management, and Customer Success, while acting as a trusted advisor to customers throughout implementation. You’ll also help customers design, build, and maintain their own models using Cresta Opera, our proprietary self-service platform.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end AI delivery projects across APAC, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, build, deployment, QA, and post-launch optimization
  • Serve as a founding regional expert in conversational design, helping shape scalable delivery frameworks and best practices for international customers
  • Manage multiple concurrent customer implementations while balancing timelines, priorities, and stakeholder expectations
  • Partner cross-functionally to define scope, track milestones, mitigate risks, and ensure successful execution
  • Translate customer business objectives into scalable conversational AI solutions across sales, retention, collections, and customer service use cases
  • Drive alignment with customer stakeholders through regular working sessions, solution reviews, and executive-level presentations
  • Lead model maintenance and performance tuning efforts to ensure ongoing quality and measurable impact
  • Deliver Cresta’s Opera Enablement Program to key stakeholders, empowering customers to independently design, build, and QA their own AI models
  • Design and develop virtual agent solutions using flow-based, prompt-based, and hybrid architectures
  • Contribute to internal documentation, implementation standards, and repeatable delivery methodologies as Cresta scales globally

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer – Platform & Reliability
jobs.description:
Senior Backend Engineer – Platform & Reliability

About Maesn

Want to join a growing European startup early and be part of an epic journey?

At Maesn we build software for other software companies. We provide an integration platform that lets B2B software companies add integrations to their platforms in hours and days instead of weeks and months. Our customers love us because we are innovative, quick, friendly and provide integrations for systems that others dare not touch.

We are a young dynamic SaaS Startup born in Düsseldorf who believe in working hard and having fun while doing it. You will have the chance to work on all parts of our technology stack and in close collaboration with our customers, to understand their needs and get direct feedback on the changes you ship.

The role

Our platform sits between our customers and dozens of third-party accounting and ERP systems. That makes reliability part of our product. When a call is slow or fails, our customers need to know why, and so do we. You’ll be the senior engineer who owns how our platform runs in production, and you’ll keep building the product alongside the team. You’ll work directly with our CTO, Lennart Svensson, and the wider founder team.

What you will do

Own our Azure infrastructure end-to-end

You know every service, how it’s deployed and what it costs. You’ll tighten what’s there and codify what isn’t. As we scale, you’ll keep the architecture simple: we run on managed services and plan to keep it that way.

Bring real observability to the platform

Metrics, logs, traces and alerts, across our services and the third-party APIs we call. You’ll define what “healthy” means, build the dashboards, and set up alerting and on-call so we catch problems before our clients do. When a mysterious timeout appears, you’re the one who can trace it to its source.

Raise the bar on security and reliability

Fintechs trust us with sensitive financial data. You’ll harden the platform, make sure we can deliver on incident response and SLAs, and keep us audit-ready as customers ask for certifications like SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

Build product and level up the team

You’ll ship features and integrations with the rest of the engineering team. You’ll also be the go-to person for production debugging, and you’ll mentor our engineers so the whole team gets better at running what we build.

What you bring

  • Experience: 5+ years building and running backend services in production, including real ownership of infrastructure, deployments and incidents.

  • Production debugging: You’ve chased down latency spikes, timeouts and flaky dependencies, and you know how to go from “something is slow” to the root cause.

  • Azure: Solid hands-on experience running production workloads on Azure.

  • Observability: Experience instrumenting services with tracing, structured logging and metrics, ideally with OpenTelemetry or similar.

  • Infrastructure-as-code mindset: You codify infrastructure rather than clicking through consoles.

  • Security by default: You think about secrets, access management, and compliance as part of the work, not as an afterthought.

  • Backend skills: You’re comfortable writing production code in TypeScript/Node.js and enjoy shipping features, not only keeping the lights on.

  • Pragmatism and mentoring: You pick the simplest setup that works. You enjoy helping less experienced engineers grow, and you’re excited to set the standards for how we run our platform.

What we offer

  • First-hand experience building a fast-growing tech startup

  • Kind teammates and great collaborative atmosphere

  • Steep learning curve and a varied job with interesting projects and technologies

  • Work fully remote or in our office in Düsseldorf

  • Fun offsites where the team gets together to work and play

  • One-time allowance for improving your home office

  • Subsidized Urban Sports Club membership

  • Laptop and work equipment

  • 30 days of PTO + Local holidays

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - (Ruby)
jobs.description:
Software Engineer II - (Ruby)

Stora is building the operating platform for modern self-storage businesses.

Our software helps operators manage bookings, payments, customers, facilities and day-to-day operations from one place, while automating much of the work that traditionally makes running a self-storage business unnecessarily complicated.

In just over four years, we’ve helped more than 300 operators process tens of millions in automated payments. We’re recognised as innovators in our space, and we’re a fast-growing, product-led team focused on making self-storage better for everyone.

About the role

We’re hiring a mid-level Software Engineer to join our growing product team.

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers to build and improve our Rails-based platform, contributing to customer-facing features, internal tools and the ongoing stability and performance of the product.

This role is well suited to someone with solid Ruby on Rails experience who is comfortable working across the stack, including JavaScript and CSS when needed.

We work best with self-starting team players: people who take ownership, communicate clearly and enjoy working in small, focused teams. You’ll have support from senior engineers, but you should also be comfortable working independently on well-defined tasks.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and maintain product features, taking ownership from initial discussion through to deployment.

  • Collaborate with Product and other stakeholders to define and refine the scope of new features.

  • Contribute to app maintenance. We aim to spend at least 20% of our time improving stability, performance and developer experience.

  • Write and maintain tests so we can confidently deploy to production multiple times per day.

  • Investigate, debug and resolve issues to keep the system stable as we scale.

  • Act on monitoring insights to keep the app performant and reliable.

  • Contribute to code reviews and team discussions.

  • Learn from senior engineers and continue developing your skills in a collaborative environment.

Our technology stack

Backend: Rails 7, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq
Frontend: Hotwire/Turbo 8, targeted React, ViewComponents, Sass, BEM
Testing: Minitest, Capybara, Selenium
Payments: Stripe Connect and Billing
Deployment: GitHub Actions, Heroku

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years of professional software development experience, including at least 2 years working with Ruby on Rails.

  • Solid understanding of Rails and its ecosystem, including ActiveRecord, background jobs and the request/response cycle.

  • Ability to work independently on well-defined tasks while collaborating effectively with the wider team.

  • Comfortable working across the stack, including JavaScript and CSS when needed.

  • Familiarity with writing tests using Minitest, RSpec or similar.

  • Comfortable debugging and troubleshooting production issues.

  • Good communication skills, with the ability to discuss technical challenges, trade-offs and blockers clearly.

  • Excited to work in a small, fast-moving product team alongside experienced engineers.

Why join us?

Stora offers a collaborative environment where you’ll have room to grow, contribute and do meaningful product work.

We value honesty, humility and responsibility. We encourage everyone to contribute ideas, take ownership of their role and help us improve the way we build.

As part of Stora, you’ll have the opportunity to make a direct impact on our product and play an important role in a rapidly evolving industry.

 

Benefits and compensation

  • Competitive salary: From £50,000 (or Euro equivalent)

  • Remote work: Fully remote within the UK or EU. Candidates must be based in either the United Kingdom or the European Union.

  • Office access: Use of our Belfast office for those who live locally.

  • Health and wellness: Private health insurance for you and your family.

  • Retirement: Company pension plan.

  • Leave: 35 days paid annual leave inclusive of public holidays (dependent on location)

  • Professional growth: Share options, WFH budget and opportunities for in-person meetups.

Next steps

We’re actively reviewing CVs on an ongoing basis and will reach out if your profile feels like a good match for the role.


Equality, diversity and inclusion

At Stora, we’re committed to building a team where everyone feels welcome, respected and able to do their best work.

We value different perspectives, backgrounds and experiences, and we’re committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital or family status, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or socio-economic background.

  • You're a fast learner. You may specialise in one growth channel or work across many, but you pick up new skills quickly and enjoy figuring things out.

Facharzt/Fachärztin mit interdisziplinärem Schwerpunkt Sportmedizin (SEMS)

Bei Oviva und Ovivamed Clinic verfolgen wir die Mission, nachhaltige, personalisierte und klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu machen, während wir Europas führende KI-gestützte Plattform für die Behandlung chronischer Krankheiten aufbauen. Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen dabei, gewichtsbedingte Erkrankungen in den Griff zu bekommen. Dabei konzentrieren wir uns auf das, was am wichtigsten ist: die Gesundheit zu verbessern, das Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und die Lebensqualität zu steigern.

Bis heute haben wir über eine Million Menschen in Großbritannien, der Schweiz und Deutschland unterstützt. Hinter unserer Mission steht ein engagiertes Team, das in vier Ländern tätig ist, einschließlich unseres Hubs in Polen. Jedes Gespräch, jede Coaching-Session und jede Zeile Code bringt uns einer gesünderen Zukunft näher.

Komm zu uns und werde Teil des Teams, das diese Zukunft möglich macht!

Die Rolle

Als Facharzt/Fachärztin mit Fähigkeitsausweis Sportmedizin bringst du deine Expertise sowohl in der Telemedizin als auch ggf. vor Ort in unsere interdisziplinäre Versorgung ein. Du unterstützt Patient:innen bei der Rückkehr in ein aktives Leben und trägst zu einer sicheren Adipositastherapie bei. Gemeinsam mit Kolleg:innen aus Medizin, Ernährung, Psychologie und Physiotherapie entwickelst du den sportmedizinischen Behandlungspfad bei Ovivamed weiter – digital, evidenzbasiert und patientenzentriert.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Durchführung sportmedizinischer Konsultationen per Video und ggf. vor Ort

  • Mitwirkung beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung des sportmedizinischen Behandlungspfads

  • Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit mit medizinischen Fachbereichen

  • Nutzung digitaler Tools, Wearables & Scorings zur individualisierten Betreuung

  • Dokumentation im PIS sowie Kommunikation mit Zuweiser:innen und Spezialist:innen

  • Teilnahme an Team- und Fallbesprechungen

Dein Profil

  • Facharzttitel in Allgemeiner Innerer Medizin oder Orthopädie (FMH)

  • Fähigkeitsausweis Sportmedizin (SGSM)

  • Erfahrung oder hohe Motivation zur Arbeit in digitalen Versorgungssystemen

  • Patientenorientierte und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1); Englisch oder Französisch wünschenswert

  • Idealerweise Berufsausübungsbewilligung für Zürich oder Bern

Was Ovivamed Dir bietet

  • Pionierarbeit in der Digitalisierung der medizinischen Arbeit: Arbeite in einem hochspezialisierten Team, das sich der Verbesserung der Lebensqualität von Menschen mit Adipositas verschrieben hat.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Hybride Tätigkeit: Nutze die Möglichkeit, dir deinen Alltag flexibel einzuteilen und hybrid zu arbeiten, was eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance fördert.

  • Innovative Unternehmenskultur: Werde Teil eines der führenden Digital Health Unternehmens von Europa.

  • Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen: Profitiere von konkurrenzfähigen Gehältern und fortschrittlichen Konditionen bei der Pensionskasse, wie die Übernahme von 60% der Beiträge durch Ovivamed.

Es ist uns sehr wichtig, eine Kultur zu haben, in der die Menschen gerne arbeiten wollen. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir unsere Werte bei allem, was wir tun, in den Vordergrund stellen:

Patient*innen stehen bei uns an erster Stelle, Wir befähigen unsere Teams, Wir machen es möglich

Ovivamed engagiert sich leidenschaftlich dafür eine inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, die die unterschiedlichen Stimmen unserer Mitarbeiter*innen ermutigt, unterstützt und feiert. Wir sind ein wirklich inklusiver Arbeitsplatz, an dem man man selbst sein kann und alle willkommen sind.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
jobs.description:
Business Development Representative (BDR)

About Rivia

Rivia is a data engine for clinical trial intelligence. It provides data infrastructure and AI-driven workflows for clinical trial teams, enabling biotechs to run studies more efficiently and to demonstrate which patients derive the greatest benefit from new therapies. Biopharma companies are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is frequently slowed by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia delivers a real-time, integrated view across clinical trial data, improving both trial execution and the evaluation of new treatments.

 

Our goal is for Rivia to become the new standard infrastructure for modern drug development, bringing new therapies to market more successfully at a fraction of the cost.

 

We seek highly driven, motivated and talented professionals to contribute to our growing startup.

 

About Rivia's Sales Team

Our Sales team is at the forefront of Rivia's growth, bringing innovative clinical trial technology to biotech and pharmaceutical companies across Europe and the US.

We operate in a complex, high-value B2B environment, where understanding customers, building trust, and creating meaningful relationships are essential to success.

As we scale, we're building a high-performing commercial organization that combines ambition, strategic thinking, and relentless execution.

The Role

As a Business Development Representative at Rivia, you will be a driving force behind our growth, identifying, engaging, and creating opportunities with biotech and pharmaceutical companies across Europe.

This is not a role where you'll simply follow a predefined playbook. You'll help build and continuously improve our outbound engine, experimenting with new approaches, identifying untapped opportunities, and finding creative ways to connect with the right decision-makers.

You'll own your prospecting activities from initial research and outreach through qualification and handover to our Account Executives. You'll develop a deep understanding of the clinical trials industry, our customers' challenges, and how Rivia can create meaningful value for their organizations.

We're looking for someone who is ambitious, commercially sharp, and relentless in pursuing results. Someone who moves fast, takes ownership, learns quickly, and isn't discouraged by rejection. You'll need to be comfortable navigating complex organizations, engaging senior stakeholders, and finding ways to open doors that others can't.

You'll work closely with our Account Executives and commercial leadership, contributing directly to our pipeline generation strategy and the evolution of our go-to-market approach.

If you're excited by the opportunity to build, experiment, exceed ambitious targets, and have a direct impact on the growth of a Series A startup, we'd love to meet you.

Working Model: This role is based on-site in our Zürich office.

What Excites You

  • Building something from the ground up. You enjoy creating and improving outbound strategies rather than simply executing an established playbook.

  • The challenge of opening doors, engaging hard-to-reach decision-makers, and turning cold prospects into meaningful business opportunities.

  • Working in a fast-paced, high-performance environment where ambitious targets, ownership, and measurable results drive your success.

  • Understanding complex industries, learning about customers' challenges, and connecting innovative technology to real business needs.

  • Experimenting with different prospecting approaches, messaging, and channels to discover what works and continuously improve results.

  • Working closely with Account Executives and commercial leadership, contributing ideas and challenging assumptions to improve our go-to-market strategy.

  • Being part of an ambitious startup where your individual contributions directly influence company growth and commercial success.

  • Taking ownership of your results, pushing through challenges, and continuously raising the bar for yourself and the team.

Responsibilities

Outbound Prospecting & Pipeline Generation

  • Own outbound prospecting activities, identifying and engaging potential customers across biotech and pharmaceutical companies in Europe.

  • Build and execute targeted, multichannel outbound campaigns through email, LinkedIn, cold calling, and other creative approaches.

  • Research target accounts, map key stakeholders, and identify relevant decision-makers and influencers within complex organizations.

  • Generate and qualify high-quality sales opportunities, ensuring a consistent pipeline of relevant prospects for our Account Executives.

  • Develop personalized outreach strategies that connect Rivia's value proposition to prospects' business challenges and priorities.

  • Take accountability for individual activity, meeting, and qualified pipeline generation targets.

Commercial Strategy & Market Intelligence

  • Contribute to building, testing, and optimizing our outbound strategy, identifying new segments, opportunities, and approaches to improve pipeline generation.

  • Collaborate with Account Executives to define target accounts, qualification criteria, and effective handover processes.

  • Develop a strong understanding of the clinical trials landscape, including biotech business models, clinical development challenges, and industry trends.

  • Gather insights from prospect conversations to identify market opportunities, refine messaging, and strengthen our commercial positioning.

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Product teams to improve campaigns, customer understanding, and go-to-market effectiveness.

Execution & Continuous Improvement

  • Own and maintain accurate prospecting data, activities, and pipeline information in our CRM.

  • Track and analyze prospecting performance, including outreach effectiveness, conversion rates, and pipeline contribution.

  • Continuously experiment with new messaging, tools, and outreach strategies to improve results and increase efficiency.

  • Proactively identify bottlenecks, challenge ineffective approaches, and implement improvements.

  • Contribute to building a high-performance sales culture based on ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and accountability.

What Excites Us

  • At least 2 years of experience in B2B outbound sales, business development, or sales development, ideally in a SaaS or technology-driven environment.

  • Proven track record of consistently achieving or exceeding prospecting, meeting generation, or qualified pipeline targets.

  • Strong outbound prospecting skills, with experience using cold calling, personalized email outreach, LinkedIn, and other channels to generate opportunities.

  • A relentless, results-oriented mindset, with the resilience to navigate rejection, persistence to pursue opportunities, and drive to exceed ambitious goals.

  • Strong commercial judgment and curiosity, with the ability to understand business challenges and translate them into relevant sales conversations.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, including the confidence to engage senior stakeholders and decision-makers.

  • A proactive, independent, and resourceful approach to problem-solving, with the ability to take initiative and deliver results without constant direction.

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage a high volume of outreach while maintaining quality and personalization.

  • A data-driven mindset, with the ability to analyze performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and adapt strategies quickly.

  • Experience working with CRM systems and modern sales prospecting tools.

  • A genuine interest in innovative technology, biotech, and the opportunity to make an impact on how clinical trials are conducted.

  • Professional fluency in English.

Bonus Points

  • Experience selling into biotech, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences organizations.

  • An existing understanding of clinical trials, drug development, or the pharmaceutical industry.

  • Experience prospecting into complex enterprise organizations with multiple stakeholders and long sales cycles.

  • Previous experience helping build or scale outbound sales processes in an early-stage startup.

  • Experience working with complex technical SaaS products.

  • Familiarity with sales engagement, automation, and AI-powered prospecting tools.

Hiring Process

Our hiring process typically takes 2–4 weeks and includes four stages:

  • Meet and Greet: A 30-minute conversation with our People team to get to know each other, your experience, and what motivates you.

  • Sales Deep Dive: A conversation with our Sales team to explore your prospecting experience, commercial mindset, and approach to generating opportunities.

  • Practical Assessment: A sales-focused exercise to understand how you research accounts, build outreach strategies, and engage potential customers.

  • Meet the Team: Join us at our Zürich office to meet the team, learn more about Rivia, and explore our mutual fit.

 

Our Values

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team. If you are driven to exceed targets, eager to shape the future of clinical trials, and passionate about making a meaningful difference in the biotech industry, Rivia is the place for you.

  • In it to Win it: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive, aiming for the best outcomes and solutions.

  • Embrace change: We see change as an opportunity for growth, innovation, and improvement, continuously evolving to stay one step ahead

  • Why not?: Asking why not, instead of why, allows us to show our curiosity, allowing us to challenge assumptions and explore new possibilities.

  • Find the gap: We are curious and we proactively approach identifying opportunities and solving problems before they arise.

  • Collective accountability: We are one team, on one mission and we are committed to shared responsibilities and mutual support, enabling trust and collaboration.

jobs.title: Commercial Director - Bern (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Commercial Director - Bern (m/f/d)
Intro

Willkommen bei Sanoptis – einem führenden Netzwerk moderner Augenkliniken und augenärztlicher Praxen mit über 580 Standorten in ganz Europa. Unsere Vision ist es, Wohlbefinden und Lebensqualität durch erstklassige augenärztliche Behandlung zu verbessern. Unser innovatives, dezentrales Modell ermöglicht es unseren Partnerstandorten, unabhängig zu operieren und sich auf die individuellen Bedürfnisse ihrer Patienten zu konzentrieren. Gleichzeitig sind sie Teil eines größeren Netzwerks mit starken Partnern, das ihnen Synergieeffekte, modernste Technik und viele weitere Vorteile bietet.

Dich begeistert ein Mix aus strategischem Gestaltungsspielraum und operativ-kommerzieller Optimierung und Du willst Deine wirtschaftliche Expertise bei einem dynamisch wachsenden Player der Augenheilkunde unter Beweis stellen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

In dieser Rolle wirst Du zur Führung und Optimierung der kaufmännischen Aktivitäten mehrerer Augenzentren in Bern die kaufmännische Geschäftsführung übernehmen. Dein Verantwortungsbereich umfasst die strategische Überwachung, das Leistungsmanagement, die Teamführung und die Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams. Dein Engagement für hervorragende Leistungen wird dazu beitragen, die Geschäftsziele zu erreichen, die Patientenzufriedenheit zu erhöhen und das Wachstum der Präsenz von Sanoptis in der Region zu fördern.


In dieser Rolle wirst Du

  • Unsere Augenzentren kaufmännisch leiten: Du wirst den Betrieb mehrerer Zentren wirtschaftlich leiten und dabei die Einhaltung der Sanoptis-Standards in den Einrichtungen sicherstellen.
  • Betriebsergebnisse und Geschäftsziele verantworten: Die betrieblichen Leistungskennzahlen zu Patientenzufriedenheit, Finanzindikatoren, Einnahmen, Ausgaben und Rentabilität wirst Du überwachen. Ferner wirst Du mit den Finanz- und Buchhaltungsteams bei der Entwicklung und Verwaltung von Budgets, Finanzprognosen und Kostenkontrollmaßnahmen zusammenarbeiten.
  • Leistungsziele definieren: Du wirst Leistungsbewertungen durchführen und Ziele definieren. Es ist Dir ein wesentliches Anliegen, für Deine Mitarbeiter und Teams ein positives Arbeitsumfeld zu gewährleisten, das Leistung durch effektive Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit fördert.
  • Die regionale Strategie planen: Die Formulierung regionaler, strategischer Pläne im Einklang mit unseren übergeordneten Geschäftszielen erarbeitest Du. Hierfür wirst Du eng mit dem Head of Operations sowie Ärzten und Fachkräften vor Ort arbeiten und netzwerken.
  • Wachstum durch Standortentwicklung vorantreiben: Du siehst Wachstumschancen in Deiner Region und erkennst sie frühzeitig, um sie gewinnbringend zu nutzen. Du wirst durch effektive Marketing- und Werbestrategien zur Steigerung des Patientenaufkommens in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketingteam beitragen. Dein Ziel ist es, einen Ausbau des Marktanteils zu erreichen.


Du wirst zusammenarbeiten mit

  • Einem starken Operationsteam, bestehend aus vielen Ex-Beratern (Bain, BCG, Roland Berger, Oliver Wyman).
  • Leitenden Angestellten und Führungskräften bei Sanoptis, darunter der Head of Operations und das Führungsteam, das für klinische Innovation und hervorragende Dienstleistungen verantwortlich ist.
  • Renommierten Spezialisten und führenden Experten auf dem Gebiet der Augenheilkunde.
  • Einem engagierten und qualifizierten Team von medizinischen Fachkräften und Assistenzärzten.
  • Interdisziplinären Teams in unserem gesamten Netzwerk, einschließlich Technologieexperten, die an den neuesten Fortschritten in der augenmedizinischen Behandlung und digitalen Gesundheitslösungen arbeiten.


Dein Profil überzeugt durch

  • Einschlägige Berufserfahrung in einem anspruchsvollen Umfeld, z. B. in der Strategieberatung (McKinsey, Bain, BCG o.Ä.) oder in ähnlich schnelllebigen Unternehmen.
  • Die nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Geschäfts- und Finanzanalysen auf Führungsebene zu erstellen und zu kommunizieren. Du erstellst Analysen akribisch und detailorientiert.
  • Unternehmerisches Denken mit der Fähigkeit, große Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Problemlösungen unabhängig voranzutreiben. Eine eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit wenig Anleitung ist essenziell.
  • Nachgewiesene Erfolge im Umgang mit Interessensgruppen, einschließlich der Fähigkeit, ohne formale Autorität Einfluss zu nehmen und Dir eine wichtige Rolle bei der Entscheidungsfindung zu sichern. Du besitzt die Fähigkeit, auch in schwierigen Situationen Konflikte konstruktiv zu lösen und Durchsetzungsstärke zu behalten.
  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Bereich Organisation und Prozessmanagement.
  • Exzellente Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau), Französischkenntnisse von Vorteil sowie Englischkenntnisse.
  • Die Bereitschaft, Ergebnisse zu erzielen und Dich in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld mit hoher Verantwortung zu entfalten.


Sanoptis bietet Dir

  • Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung: Ein äußerst attraktives Gehaltspaket, ergänzt durch einen jährlichen, leistungsabhängigen Bonus, der an individuelle und unternehmensspezifische Leistungsziele gebunden ist.
  • Eigenständigkeit und kreative Freiheit: Die Möglichkeit, Dich zu beweisen, indem Du selbstständig arbeitest und eigene, innovative Ideen umfassend einbringst als Führungspersönlichkeit.

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Vergünstigte Konditionen auf zahlreiche ausgewählte Markenprodukte und Dienstleistungen über unseren Partner Corporate Benefits.

Bei Sanoptis schätzen wir Talent, Leidenschaft und Einstellung über spezifische Erfahrungen. Wir begrüßen Bewerber aus verschiedenen Hintergründen und priorisieren gleiche Chancen für alle.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist

Do you love connecting great people with great opportunities? As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will be part detective, part storyteller, and part matchmaker.

Every day, you will search for exceptional talent, build meaningful relationships, and help shape the future of the organization one hire at a time. You will partner with leaders to understand what success looks like, create an outstanding candidate experience, and bring our employer brand to life.
You will:

  • Discover hidden talent and turn conversations into career opportunities
  • Partner with hiring managers to find the right people, not just fill positions
  • Create memorable candidate experiences that leave a lasting impression
  • Use creativity, data, and market insights to attract top talent
  • Champion diversity, inclusion, and innovative hiring practices
  • Help build teams that drive growth, innovation, and success

Strategic Account Executive

CoderPad's mission is to create a more inclusive and strong tech community.

How? By improving the technical interviewing experience with tools that allow for standardization and consistency, while reducing bias and increasing equality of opportunity.

CoderPad’s Strategic Account Executive oversees account expansion through the engagement of key Talent Acquisition and Engineering stakeholders as a part of our mission to better the technical interview process for everyone.

As the global leader in the technical interview space (3,800+ customers in 165+ countries), it is our Strategic Account Executive’s goal to identify technical hiring challenges and drive the CoderPad value proposition for a book of target accounts.

You’ll report to our Sales Manager and own the sales process from start to finish while also regularly engaging on customer calls.

  • Outbound prospecting (call, email, LinkedIn, etc.) into a triaged list of target accounts and engaging Talent Acquisition/HR and Engineering stakeholders with CoderPad’s value proposition

  • Achieve pre-defined outbound activity, pipeline, and revenue targets

  • Engage with a value-based selling approach to delight our customers!

At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible.

About the Role

ClickUp is hiring a Strategic Solutions Engineer to accelerate partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue across the APAC region. This role sits at the intersection of enterprise pre-sales, partner enablement, and solution architecture. You will serve as the technical force multiplier that enables upmarket partners (Solution Partners, GSIs, and enterprise resellers) to independently acquire, implement, and expand ClickUp within their customer base, driving ARR growth and net retention.

Your primary mandate is to increase the volume and quality of revenue that flows through partners, working alongside Partner Managers and Account Executives. You are a builder-scaler: standing up enablement programs from a proven playbook, iterating on them, and scaling them to drive repeatable partner-led revenue.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner Enablement & Technical Development: Design and deliver structured enablement programs (workflow mapping, narrative decks, AI Agents, AI workflows, business process mapping, competitive positioning), coach partners on discovery, demos, solution design, and pricing, and drive partner certification and self-sufficiency across APAC.

  • Co-Selling & Revenue: Serve as technical lead on partner-sourced deals from discovery through POC to post-sales handoff, coach partners to run standard deals independently, and tie all activities to measurable revenue outcomes (partner-sourced and partner-influenced iARR, win rate, deal velocity).

  • Direct Customer Engagement: Support Account Executives on strategic direct opportunities, leading discovery, solution design, demos, and technical evaluations alongside the partner motion.

  • Partner Acquisition & Development: Lead technical demonstrations and deep-dives for prospective partners, support recruitment as the technical closer, and elevate existing partners by showcasing new platform capabilities that expand their practice opportunity.

  • AI & Certified Agents: Enable partners to identify, scope, and sell Certified Agent opportunities, deliver AI transformation workshops, and serve as the regional bridge between the internal AI/Agent team and the partner ecosystem.

  • Events & Marketing: Lead or support partner-driven events (workshops, in-market tours, executive dinners), develop enablement content, and contribute to partner case studies and proof points.

  • Reseller-Model Support: Support partner-owned billing, procurement, and renewal workflows, enable partners on expansion motions, and coordinate with Professional Services on co-delivery oversight and escalation paths.

  • Internal Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with Professional Services, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and global Solutions Engineering teams to resolve technical questions, assist with RFPs, and feed partner insights back into product and process improvements.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise pre-sales, solutions engineering, sales engineering, solutions consulting, or a comparable customer-facing technical role.

  • 2+ years supporting or enabling channel partners, VARs, system integrators, or working in a partner-led go-to-market motion.

  • Demonstrated ability to build programs from scratch (not just execute existing ones).

  • Strong presentation, storytelling, and workshop facilitation skills, with the ability to connect product capabilities and technical details to business outcomes for different audiences.

  • Experience designing or explaining solutions involving APIs, web services, automation, integrations, workflow configuration, or lightweight technical validation.

  • Strong background in business process mapping, including the ability to analyse, document, and improve complex business processes across diverse environments.

  • Ability to create credibility with partners, AEs, and customers, handle objections thoughtfully, and act as a trusted advisor.

  • Strong commercial judgment, structured problem-solving, and comfort managing multiple concurrent priorities with urgency and limited supervision.

  • Up to 50% of travel is required for this role.

  • This role is open to candidates across Australia, with Sydney, Melbourne or Brisbane preferred.

jobs.title: Performance Creative Manager
jobs.description:
Performance Creative Manager

About Solace

Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here.

About the Role

As the Performance Creative Manager at Solace, you'll build and lead the creative engine behind an eight-figure monthly paid media program.

You'll craft a performance creative system — channel-dedicated pods of creative strategists, designers, and video editors working alongside media buyers across our full stack of acquisition channels — and own creative-driven CPA improvement across all of it.

This is a builder's role for someone who speaks both craft and performance fluently: you'll define the testing frameworks, develop the team, negotiate the brand guardrails, and create the systems that turn creative production into a compounding performance advantage.

What You'll Own

  • Build, hire, and mentor the performance creative organization — creative strategists, designers, video editors, and creative operations — embedded in channel pods alongside media buyers across Meta, TikTok/AppLovin, and YouTube.

  • Own creative-driven CPA improvement across all pods.

  • Define and run the creative testing framework: concept, variant, and iteration definitions; weekly production quotas per pod; hit-rate targets; and the kill/iterate/scale decision system.

  • Own the creative analytics foundation: naming conventions and tagging taxonomy that make winning patterns searchable, measurable, and repeatable across channels.

  • Stand up and govern the content library — raw UGC and branded shoot footage, finished-asset archive with performance data, and the approved-claims and copy library — as the infrastructure layer for pod velocity.

  • Own the shoot roadmap and external creator/contractor budget: quarterly branded production planning, the UGC creator program, and the production partner ecosystem.

  • Negotiate and own the brand guardrails system — codified rules that let pods ship at velocity inside clear boundaries, with defined review lanes for net-new territory.

  • Own regulatory and legal compliance systems for creative: the approved-claims library and review-lane process, built with legal, appropriate to a healthcare environment.

  • Run the cross-pod creative review cadence so learnings transfer between channels — a winning Meta hook becomes a TikTok hypothesis becomes a CTV script.

What Success Looks Like

A creative organization that ships winning ads on a weekly cadence — on brand, compliant, channel-native, and relentlessly tested — where creative is the growth lever: rising hit rates, falling CPAs, and a library of compounding creative intelligence.

Who You Are

  • A builder who has stood up teams, systems, and processes from scratch — and knows the difference between an org chart and an operating system.

  • A leader fluent in both creative craft and performance data; you can give an editor frame-level feedback and defend a testing budget in the same meeting.

  • A systems thinker who believes velocity comes from infrastructure — taxonomies, libraries, briefs, and cadences — not heroics.

  • Excited to contribute hands-on in a high-growth, mission-driven startup.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Direct experience managing creative on $50M+/year in paid media spend.

  • Proven track record building and managing creative teams (strategists, designers, editors) of 5+ people, ideally in a pod or embedded model.

  • Deep fluency in creative testing at scale: concept/variant frameworks, hit-rate measurement, creative fatigue diagnosis, and iteration systems on Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.

  • Experience running UGC creator programs and branded production — briefing, shoot planning, usage rights, and turning raw footage into high-velocity variant production.

  • Strong command of creative analytics: tagging taxonomies, creative reporting, and connecting asset-level data to CPA outcomes.

  • Experience partnering with brand and legal teams to build guardrails and claims-review systems that protect the brand without killing velocity.

  • Exceptional organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • A bias for action — you move fast, make sound decisions, and thrive under tight timelines.

  • Bonus: experience in healthcare or other regulated industries, a marketplace business, or a fast-paced startup environment.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge?

We look forward to meeting you.

Who We Are

Cobalt was founded on the belief of a fundamental human aspiration: the desire to live better and safer. It all started in 2013, when our founders realized that pentesting can be better. Today our diverse, fully remote team is committed to helping organizations of all sizes with seamless, effective and collaborative Offensive Security Testing that empower organizations to OPERATE FEARLESSLY and INNOVATE SECURELY.

Our customers can start a pentest in as little as 24 hours and integrate with advanced development cycles thanks to the powerful combination of our SaaS platform coupled with an exclusive community of testers known as the Cobalt Core. Accepting just 5% of applicants, the Cobalt Core boasts over 500 closely vetted and highly skilled testers who jointly conduct thousands of tests each year and are at the forefront of identifying and helping remediate risk across a dynamically changing attack surface.

Cobalt is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive workforce at our company. At Cobalt we aspire to engage with diverse individuals, communities, and organizations in order to continue to nurture our unique rich diverse culture. Join our team, and be your true self to do your best work.

Description

We are looking for a Senior GTM Systems & AI Specialist to own and scale the technology infrastructure that powers Cobalt’s go-to-market organization.

Reporting to the Sr. Director of Revenue Operations, this role will serve as the technical owner of our GTM technology ecosystem, with deep hands-on responsibility for Salesforce, HubSpot, integrations, enrichment, automation, and the systems supporting our customer lifecycle.

This is a highly cross-functional individual contributor role for someone who combines deep GTM systems expertise with a strong understanding of how modern B2B SaaS revenue organizations operate. You won’t just administer tools — you’ll partner with Revenue Operations, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Analytics to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions and identify opportunities to leverage automation and AI to improve how our GTM teams operate.

Success in this role means our GTM teams have reliable systems, connected and trustworthy data, scalable automation, and an increasingly AI-enabled technology ecosystem that helps the business operate more efficiently.

What You'll Own

GTM Systems & Architecture

  • Serve as the primary technical owner and administrator of Salesforce, including architecture, objects, Flows, automation, permissions, integrations, data model, release management, reporting infrastructure, and system governance.
  • Own the broader GTM technology ecosystem, including integrations and data flows between Salesforce, HubSpot, Customer Success platforms, enrichment providers, prospecting and sequencing tools, and other GTM applications.
  • Partner closely with Revenue Operations to translate GTM strategy and business requirements into scalable technical solutions across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
  • Evaluate, implement, and optimize GTM technologies with a focus on business impact, scalability, usability, and reducing operational complexity.

HubSpot & Marketing Technology

  • Serve as the primary technical owner and administrator of HubSpot, including workflows, lifecycle stages, lead scoring and routing, forms, campaign infrastructure, attribution configuration, integrations, automation, and data synchronization with Salesforce.
  • Partner with Marketing and Revenue Operations to ensure our marketing technology infrastructure supports lead management, campaign execution, attribution, intent signals, funnel measurement, and Marketing-to-Sales handoffs.
  • Maintain alignment between Salesforce and HubSpot data models, lifecycle definitions, routing logic, campaign data, and reporting requirements.

Data, Enrichment & GTM Signals

  • Own the technical infrastructure supporting GTM data quality and enrichment, including enrichment providers, field mapping, matching logic, deduplication, normalization, data governance, and ongoing monitoring.
  • Design and maintain reliable enrichment and data orchestration workflows that ensure GTM teams have accurate, complete, and actionable account and contact data.
  • Build scalable processes for activating intent signals, engagement data, enrichment signals, and buying triggers across GTM systems.
  • Proactively monitor data and integration health, identify gaps or failures, and implement solutions that improve data accuracy, coverage, reliability, and usability.

Customer Success Technology

  • Support the administration and integration of Customer Success platforms and the data infrastructure supporting the post-sale customer lifecycle.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations and Customer Success to enable processes such as customer health scoring, segmentation, account planning, renewals, expansion, churn risk, and lifecycle management.
  • Ensure customer and commercial data flows reliably across Salesforce, Customer Success platforms, and the broader GTM ecosystem.

Automation, AI & Innovation

  • Identify, design, and implement opportunities to automate repetitive GTM workflows across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations.
  • Build scalable workflow automation using native platform capabilities, APIs, webhooks, and tools such as n8n, Zapier, or similar technologies.
  • Evaluate and implement practical AI-powered solutions that improve GTM productivity, research, data quality, prioritization, customer insights, or operational efficiency.
  • Build and experiment with AI-enabled workflows and agents where they can deliver measurable business value.
  • Stay current on emerging GTM and AI technologies and proactively recommend opportunities to improve how our revenue organization operates.

Systems Governance & Operational Excellence

  • Own system health, integrations, permissions, release management, documentation, and technical governance across the GTM technology ecosystem.
  • Establish monitoring and controls to proactively identify integration failures, data issues, workflow errors, and system risks.
  • Maintain clear documentation of architecture, integrations, workflows, business rules, and system dependencies to support scalability and business continuity.
  • Own technical initiatives end-to-end, from discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.

You Must Have

  • 7+ years of experience in GTM Systems, Revenue Operations, Marketing Operations, Salesforce Administration, GTM Engineering, or a related field within B2B SaaS.
  • Advanced hands-on Salesforce administration expertise, including Flows, automation, permissions, integrations, data architecture, reporting, dashboards, and governance.
  • Advanced hands-on HubSpot administration expertise, including workflows, lifecycle management, lead scoring and routing, forms, campaigns, attribution, automation, integrations, and reporting.
  • Experience serving as a primary technical owner of Salesforce and HubSpot, including managing the integration and data flow between the two platforms.
  • Strong understanding of the end-to-end B2B SaaS GTM lifecycle across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, with the ability to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
  • Strong experience with GTM data enrichment and governance, including enrichment providers, matching and mapping logic, deduplication, normalization, data quality monitoring, and CRM data management.
  • Experience designing and maintaining cross-platform integrations using APIs, webhooks, middleware, or workflow automation platforms.
  • Experience building scalable workflow automation using native GTM platforms and tools such as n8n, Zapier, Make, or similar technologies.
  • Experience administering or integrating Customer Success platforms and supporting post-sale customer data and workflows.
  • Experience applying AI and automation to GTM workflows, with an understanding of where AI can create meaningful business value and where traditional automation is the better solution.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently own business-critical GTM systems, troubleshoot complex issues, and drive technical initiatives from requirements through deployment.
  • Strong communication and partnership skills, with the ability to work effectively with Revenue Operations, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Analytics, and technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with GTM technologies such as Apollo, Clay, LeanData, ZoomInfo, 6sense, Gong, Outreach, Qualified, Clari, UserGems, Planhat, or similar platforms.
  • Experience designing signal-based GTM workflows using intent, engagement, enrichment, product, or customer data.
  • Experience building or deploying AI-powered workflows or agents within GTM systems.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or similar technologies used to extend and automate GTM systems.
  • Experience supporting a scaling SaaS organization through systems transformation, technology consolidation, or process redesign.

Why You Should Join Us

  • Grow in a passionate, rapidly expanding industry operating at the forefront of the Pentesting industry
  • Work directly with experienced senior leaders with ongoing mentorship opportunities
  • Earn competitive compensation and an attractive equity plan
  • Save for the future with a 401(k) program (US) or pension (EU)
  • Benefit from medical, dental, vision and life insurance (US) or statutory healthcare (EU)
  • Leverage stipends for:
    • Wellness
    • Work-from-home equipment & wifi
    • Learning & development
  • Make the most of our flexible, generous paid time off and paid parental leave

Pay Range Disclosure (For US openings only)

Cobalt is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this role is ($135,000 - $160,000) + equity + benefits. A candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, and certifications. The salary range may differ in other states and may be impacted by proximity to major metropolitan cities.

It is the Company's policy to prohibit discrimination in any employment opportunity (including but not limited to recruitment, employment, promotion, salary increases, benefits, termination and all other terms and conditions of employment) based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, pregnancy, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical/mental disability, medical condition, marital/domestic partner status, military and veteran status, height, weight or any other such characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. The Company is committed to complying with all applicable laws and providing equal employment opportunities. This commitment applies to all persons involved in the operations of the Company regardless of where the employee is located and prohibits unlawful discrimination by any employee of the Company.

jobs.description:
Sr. Forward Deployed AI Engineer (Remote Eligible in the UK)

For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

You independently lead the most complex AI deployments Smartsheet undertakes. You own the full engagement lifecycle from technical discovery through production deployment through solutions org handoff. You architect multi-agent solutions, design client-personalized MCP resource packs, and build the Deployment Kits that transform how 200+ solutions consultants and partners operate. You mentor junior FDEs, drive the intelligence loop, and present field findings at weekly Applied AI strategy sessions. You are building a function, not filling a role.

What You Will Do

  • Lead complex, multi-system AI deployments end-to-end scope, architect, build, validate, and manage the customer relationship throughout.
  • Own the AI workshop program for your pod, customize modules per customer, lead technical sessions, translate outputs into production requirements, evolve content from field learning.
  • Architect multi-agent solutions selecting the right coordination pattern for each customer’s workflow characteristics and compliance requirements.
  • Design client-specific and industry-specific MCP resource packs that serve personalized intelligence from the server so every connected AI surface gets smarter for that customer automatically.
  • Own Deployment Kit quality for your pod. If a kit is not documented well enough for a solutions consultant with no engineering background to follow, it isn’t done.
  • Lead Solutions Enablement Sprints: transfer AI deployment patterns to solutions consultants and partners with training materials and certification criteria.
  • Drive the intelligence loop: author strategic memos, present field findings weekly, contribute Agent Bricks and Skills, file RFCs for platform improvements.
  • Mentor junior FDEs on customer engagements, code reviews, and Deployment Kit quality.

Required

  • 6–10+ years production software engineering, including 3+ years deploying AI/ML to production. Deep Python; strong TypeScript/JavaScript.
  • Proven track record leading complex enterprise technical engagements. You’ve managed customer relationships, navigated security reviews, and delivered production systems organisations depend on.
  • Deep production LLM experience: multi-agent orchestration, MCP/tool-use, RAG optimisation, evaluation frameworks, agent deployment at scale.
  • System architecture expertise spanning enterprise systems, cloud infrastructure, and AI services explainable to a CIO and a junior engineer.
  • Demonstrated ability to create reusable technical assets that others use in production. You think in platforms, not projects.
  • Strong written and verbal communication. Architecture documents, runbooks, strategic memos, training materials. Your Deployment Kits are your portfolio.
  • You leave teams better than you found them. You make sure the people you work with understand what was built, why it works, and how to own it without you.
  • Ability to travel. This role requires domestic and international travel approximately 25–50% of the time.
  • Elligible to work in the UK on an ongoing basis
  • BS or MS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent industry experience

Nice to Have:

  • Experience founding or scaling an FDE/solutions engineering function.
  • Technical founder background. Databricks, AWS Bedrock, or Temporal experience.
  • Deep domain knowledge in healthcare, financial services, or government. Agent framework contributions (Strands SDK, LangChain, open-source MCP servers).
  • Proficiency in German/French language will be an added advantage
  • Familiarity of AI governance, ethics, and regulatory requirements (e.g. GDPR, UK/EU AI Act)

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.
